=== src/infoplus.mjs
import { DOMParser } from '@xmldom/xmldom';
import { parse } from 'parse5';

const children = element => Array.from(element?.childNodes ?? []).filter(node => node.nodeType === 1);
const child = (element, name) => children(element).find(node => node.tagName === name);
const attr = (element, name) => element?.getAttribute(name) ?? '';
const attrs = element => Object.fromEntries(Array.from(element.attributes, a => [a.name, a.value]));
const body = (element, name) => child(element, name)?.textContent.trim() ?? '';
const types = {
  steps: '办理', autoSteps: '自动步骤', decisions: '判断',
  splits: '分流', joins: '合并', subs: '子流程',
};

export function entity(response) {
  if (response?.errno !== 0 || response.entities?.length !== 1) return;
  return response.entities[0];
}

export function parseWorkflow(response, project, source) {
  const record = entity(response);
  if (record?.success !== true || typeof record.guiDefinition !== 'string') return;
  const xml = record.guiDefinition;
  if (/<!DOCTYPE|<!ENTITY/i.test(xml)) throw new Error('工作流 XML 含不受支持的文档类型');
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml').documentElement;
  if (root.tagName !== 'workflow' || (project.projectCode && attr(root, 'code') !== project.projectCode)) {
    throw new Error('工作流响应的项目代码与项目索引不一致');
  }
  const rootEvidence = source + '#/entities/0/guiDefinition';
  const nodes = Object.entries(types).flatMap(([container, type]) =>
    children(child(root, container)).map(node => {
      const id = attr(node, 'seqNo');
      const permissions = children(child(node, 'perms'));
      const executorGroups = permissions.filter(perm => attr(perm, 'type') === 'E').flatMap(children)
        .filter(group => group.tagName === 'posts');
      const actor = executorGroups.map(group => {
        const roles = children(group).filter(item => item.tagName === 'post').map(post => post.textContent || attr(post, 'id'));
        const limits = children(group).filter(item => item.tagName !== 'post').flatMap(item =>
          children(item).map(limit => `${item.tagName}=${attr(limit, 'value')}（类型 ${attr(limit, 'type')}）`));
        return [...roles, ...limits].join('；');
      }).filter(Boolean).join(' / ');
      return {
        id, name: (attr(node, 'displayName') || attr(node, 'name')).trim(), code: attr(node, 'name'), type,
        view: attr(child(node, 'displayView'), 'id'), printView: attr(child(node, 'printView'), 'id'),
        x: attr(node, 'x'), y: attr(node, 'y'), actor,
        attributes: attrs(node), script: body(node, 'script'),
        permissions: permissions.map(perm => perm.toString()),
        fieldPermissions: children(child(node, 'powers')).map(attrs),
        notifications: children(child(node, 'notifications')).map(item => item.toString()),
        evidence: `${rootEvidence} /workflow/${container}/${node.tagName}[@seqNo='${id}']`,
      };
    }));
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map(node => [node.id, node]));
  const transitions = children(child(root, 'edges')).map(edge => {
    const id = attr(edge, 'seqNo');
    const from = attr(edge, 'source');
    const code = attr(edge, 'name');
    const parent = byId.get(from);
    const restrict = body(edge, 'restrictScript');
    return {
      id, source: from, target: attr(edge, 'target'), name: attr(edge, 'displayName') || code, code,
      condition: restrict || (parent?.script && parent.type === '判断' ? `节点 ${from} 返回 ${code}` : ''),
      conditionSource: parent?.type === '判断' && parent.script ? parent.evidence + '/script' : undefined,
      script: body(edge, 'script'), restrictScript: restrict, attributes: attrs(edge),
      evidence: `${rootEvidence} /workflow/edges/edge[@seqNo='${id}']`,
    };
  });
  const externalEvents = children(child(root, 'events')).map(event => ({
    name: attr(event, 'name'), enabled: attr(event, 'enabled') === 'true',
    steps: children(event).map(binding => attr(binding, 'step')).filter(Boolean),
  }));
  return {
    nodes, transitions, externalEvents, description: body(root, 'description'),
    startView: attr(child(root, 'startView'), 'id'), form: attr(root, 'form'),
    released: record.released === true, lastModify: record.lastModify,
  };
}

function* descendants(node, tag) {
  for (const item of node.childNodes ?? []) {
    if (item.tagName === tag) yield item;
    yield* descendants(item, tag);
  }
}
const htmlAttr = (node, name) => node?.attrs?.find(a => a.name === name)?.value ?? '';
const htmlText = node => node.nodeName === '#text' ? node.value :
  (node.childNodes ?? []).map(htmlText).join('');
const hasClass = (node, name) => htmlAttr(node, 'class').split(/\s+/).includes(name);

export function parseFieldIndex(html, origin, views) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const row of descendants(parse(html), 'tr')) {
    const id = htmlAttr(row, 'data-value');
    const uuid = htmlAttr(row, 'title');
    if (!/^[\w.-]+$/u.test(id) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(uuid)) continue;
    const cells = row.childNodes.filter(node => node.tagName === 'td');
    if (!cells.length) continue;
    const link = [...descendants(cells[0], 'a')].find(node => hasClass(node, 'btn-nav'));
    const url = link && new URL(htmlAttr(link, 'href'), origin);
    const match = url?.pathname.match(/\/view\/([0-9a-f-]{36})\/field\/([0-9a-f-]{36})$/i);
    if (!match || url.origin !== origin || match[2] !== uuid || !views.has(match[1])) continue;
    const spans = [...descendants(row, 'span')];
    const type = htmlAttr(spans.find(node => hasClass(node, 'data-type')), 'data-value');
    const control = htmlAttr(spans.find(node => hasClass(node, 'bound-type')), 'data-value');
    if (!type) continue;
    const label = [...descendants(cells[0], 'b')].map(htmlText).find(text => text.trim())?.trim();
    const required = [...descendants(cells[0], 'span')]
      .some(node => hasClass(node, 'color-red') && htmlText(node).trim() === '*') ? true : null;
    rows.push({ id, uuid, viewId: match[1], label, type, control, required });
  }
  return rows;
}

// Keep only the table's view records. The page head contains session metadata.
export function parseViews(html, origin, workflowId) {
  const document = parse(html);
  const views = [];
  for (const row of descendants(document, 'tr')) {
    const cells = row.childNodes.filter(node => node.tagName === 'td');
    const id = htmlAttr(cells[0], 'title');
    if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id)) continue;
    const links = [...descendants(row, 'a')];
    const sameOriginPath = (link, expected) => {
      if (!link) return;
      const url = new URL(htmlAttr(link, 'href'), origin);
      if (url.origin === origin && url.pathname.endsWith(expected)) return url.pathname;
    };
    const xsn = sameOriginPath(links.find(a => htmlAttr(a, 'title') === 'Download as XSN'), `/template/${id}/xsn`);
    const json = sameOriginPath(links.find(a => htmlAttr(a, 'title') === 'Download as JSON'), `/template/${id}/json`);
    const page = sameOriginPath(links[0], `/project/${workflowId}/view/${id}`);
    if (!page || (!xsn && !json)) continue;
    views.push({ id, name: htmlText(cells[0]).trim(), created: htmlText(cells[2]).trim(),
      updated: htmlText(cells[3]).trim(), xsn, json, page });
  }
  return views;
}

=== src/linked-dashboard.mjs
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { findCachedProject } from './project-input.mjs';
import { saveWorkflowInput } from './workflow-inputs.mjs';

const dashboard = '/dashboard/flow/index';
const monitor = '/dashboard/flow/im';
const query = '/dashboard/api/processes/query';
const fieldId = /^field\w+$/;

export function selectDashboardRecord(rows, criteria) {
  const matches = rows.filter(row => row.status === '已完成' && /^\d+$/.test(row.serial) &&
    (!criteria.serial || row.serial === criteria.serial) &&
    row.path === `/infoplus/form/e${row.serial}/render`);
  return matches.length === 1 ? { status: 'matched', row: matches[0] } :
    { status: matches.length ? 'ambiguous' : 'not-found' };
}

export function checkLinkedDetail(detail, predecessor, criteria, serial) {
  if (!detail || String(detail.serial) !== serial || detail.definitionId !== predecessor.workflowDefinitionId ||
      detail.release !== true || detail.status !== 4 || detail.account !== criteria.applicantAccount) return false;
  return typeof detail.value === 'string' && detail.value.trim() !== '' && detail.value !== serial;
}

export async function discoverDashboardValue(context, predecessor, criteria) {
  const origin = URL.parse(predecessor?.source ?? '')?.origin;
  if (!origin?.startsWith('https://') || !predecessor.workflowDefinitionId || !predecessor.projectCode ||
      criteria?.predecessorCode !== predecessor.code || !fieldId.test(criteria.fieldId ?? '') ||
      !fieldId.test(criteria.applicantFieldId ?? '') || typeof criteria.applicantAccount !== 'string' ||
      !criteria.applicantAccount.trim() || (criteria.serial !== undefined && !/^\d+$/.test(criteria.serial))) {
    return { status: 'needs-context' };
  }
  let detailPath;
  let phase = '打开办事中心';
  const page = await context.newPage();
  try {
    const session = await context.newCDPSession(page);
    await session.send('Network.setBypassServiceWorker', { bypass: true });
    await page.route('**/*', route => {
      const request = route.request(), url = new URL(request.url());
      const asset = ['script', 'stylesheet', 'image', 'font'].includes(request.resourceType());
      const readable = url.pathname === query ||
        (detailPath && url.pathname === '/infoplus/interface/render');
      const document = [dashboard, monitor, detailPath].includes(url.pathname);
      if (url.origin === origin && (readable && ['GET','POST'].includes(request.method()) ||
          request.method() === 'GET' && (asset || document))) return route.continue();
      return route.abort();
    });
    await page.goto(origin + dashboard + '#im', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 15000 });
    phase = '读取已完成记录查询结果';
    const listed = await page.evaluate(async ({ route, keyword, app }) => {
      const url = new URL(route, location.origin);
      url.search = new URLSearchParams({ keyword, app, timestamps: '', milestones: '', statuses: 'done',
        draft: 'false', timestampStart: '', timestampEnd: '' }).toString();
      const result = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', redirect: 'error', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) });
      if (!result.ok) return null;
      const parsed = await result.json();
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed.data) || parsed.error) return null;
      const rows = parsed.data.flatMap(record => {
        const uri = URL.parse(record.uri, location.origin);
        if (record.app?.code !== app || record.status !== 'done' || uri?.origin !== location.origin || uri.search || uri.hash) return [];
        return [{ serial: String(record.entry), status: '已完成', path: uri.pathname }];
      });
      return { rows, complete: Number(parsed.recordsFiltered) === parsed.data.length };
    }, { route: query, keyword: criteria.serial ?? criteria.applicantAccount, app: predecessor.projectCode });
    if (!listed) return { status: 'query-unavailable' };
    if (!listed.complete && !criteria.serial) return { status: 'ambiguous' };
    const rows = listed.rows;
    const selected = selectDashboardRecord(rows, criteria);
    if (selected.status !== 'matched') return selected;
    detailPath = selected.row.path;
    phase = '读取原申请详情';
    const open = context.pages().find(candidate => candidate !== page && candidate.url() === origin + detailPath);
    const detailPage = open ?? page;
    if (!open) await page.goto(origin + detailPath, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 15000 });
    if (detailPage.url() !== origin + detailPath) return { status: 'detail-unavailable' };
    await detailPage.waitForFunction(() => Boolean(window.$$?.entity?.step && window.$$?.entity?.data), null, { timeout: 12000 });
    const detail = await detailPage.evaluate(({ field, account }) => {
      const form = window.$$?.entity, step = form?.step, data = form?.data;
      return { serial: step?.entryId, definitionId: step?.definitionId, release: step?.entryRelease,
        status: step?.entryStatus, account: data?.[account], value: form?.fields?.[field]?.bound ? data?.[field] : undefined };
    }, { field: criteria.fieldId, account: criteria.applicantFieldId });
    if (!checkLinkedDetail(detail, predecessor, criteria, selected.row.serial)) return { status: 'detail-mismatch' };
    return { status: 'found', value: detail.value, evidence: { source: '办事中心已完成历史申请详情',
      predecessorCode: predecessor.code, definitionId: detail.definitionId, serial: selected.row.serial,
      fieldId: criteria.fieldId, applicantFieldId: criteria.applicantFieldId, applicantMatched: true, verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString() } };
  } catch {
    return { status: 'unavailable', reason: `${phase}未完成` };
  } finally {
    await page.close();
  }
}

export function linkedFieldCandidates(bundle) {
  const candidates = new Map();
  for (const field of bundle.fields ?? []) {
    if (field.id && /团组编号|原申请编号|关联.*(?:流水号|编号)|前置.*编号|合同编号/.test(field.name ?? '')) {
      candidates.set(field.id, { fieldId: field.id, name: field.name, evidence: '字段名称提示，关联关系待核实' });
    }
  }
  return [...candidates.values()];
}
export async function recoverLinkedInput(context, project, configuredInputs) {
  if (!/^Z\d+$/.test(project.code)) return;
  let criteria;
  try { criteria = JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL(`../config/workflow-inputs/${project.code}-linked.json`, import.meta.url), 'utf8')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return; throw error; }
  if (configuredInputs.some(item => item.fieldId === criteria.targetFieldId)) return;
  if (criteria.targetVersion !== project.version || criteria.targetDefinitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId ||
      !/^Z\d+$/.test(criteria.predecessorCode ?? '') || criteria.predecessorCode === project.code) return { status: 'needs-context' };
  const cache = await findCachedProject(criteria.predecessorCode);
  if (!cache) return { status: 'predecessor-unavailable' };
  const predecessor = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(cache, 'project.json'), 'utf8'));
  if (URL.parse(project.source)?.origin !== URL.parse(predecessor.source)?.origin) return { status: 'needs-context' };
  const result = await discoverDashboardValue(context, predecessor, criteria);
  if (result.status !== 'found') return result;
  const item = linkedTestInput(criteria, result);
  await saveWorkflowInput(project, item);
  return { status: 'found', item };
}

export function linkedTestInput(criteria, result) {
  return {
    fieldId: criteria.targetFieldId, fieldName: criteria.targetFieldName, nodeIds: criteria.nodeIds,
    value: result.value, source: '关联流程', validationStatus: '待验证',
    requiredApplicant: { account: criteria.applicantAccount, fieldId: criteria.targetApplicantFieldId },
    upstreamWorkflow: criteria.predecessorCode, predecessorSerial: result.evidence.serial, evidence: result.evidence,
  };
}

=== src/linked-instances.mjs
// The caller supplies a verified predecessor definition, an explicit applicant,
// business name and status, and the exact business field ID. No fuzzy inference.
const uuid = /^[a-f\d]{8}(?:-[a-f\d]{4}){3}-[a-f\d]{12}$/i;
const fieldId = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$/;

export function selectLinkedInstance(rows, criteria) {
  if (!criteria || !criteria.applicant || !criteria.name || !criteria.status ||
      !fieldId.test(criteria.fieldId || '') || !criteria.predecessorCode) {
    return { status: 'needs-context', reason: '缺少已核实的前置流程、申请人、业务名称、状态或字段 ID' };
  }
  const matches = rows.filter(r => r.applicant === criteria.applicant && r.name === criteria.name &&
    r.status === criteria.status && typeof r.dataPath === 'string');
  if (matches.length !== 1) return { status: matches.length ? 'ambiguous' : 'not-found', count: matches.length };
  return { status: 'matched', candidate: matches[0] };
}

export function extractLinkedBusinessValue(fields, requestedFieldId) {
  if (!fieldId.test(requestedFieldId || '')) return { status: 'invalid-field' };
  const matches = fields.filter(f => f.id === requestedFieldId && typeof f.value === 'string' && f.value.trim());
  if (matches.length !== 1) return { status: matches.length ? 'ambiguous-field' : 'field-unavailable' };
  return { status: 'found', value: matches[0].value };
}

// Read-only browser access. Every document is an explicitly validated same-origin
// GET, all scripts, subresources, navigations and non-GET requests are blocked.
// The candidate's numeric platform step/instance identifiers are never used as
// the requested business value. No applicant name or field value is logged.
export async function discoverLinkedBusinessValue(context, predecessor, criteria) {
  const source = URL.parse(predecessor?.source || '');
  const definition = predecessor?.workflowDefinitionId;
  if (!source || source.protocol !== 'https:' || source.username || source.password || !uuid.test(definition || '') ||
      !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(predecessor?.code || '') || criteria?.predecessorCode !== predecessor.code ||
      !criteria.applicant || !criteria.name || !criteria.status || !fieldId.test(criteria.fieldId || '')) {
    return { status: 'needs-context', reason: '缺少可核对的前置流程、申请人、业务名称、状态或字段 ID' };
  }
  const mode = criteria.release === false ? 'false' : criteria.release === true ? 'true' : null;
  if (mode === null) return { status: 'needs-context', reason: '须明确前置实例为 RELEASE 或 DEBUG' };
  const list = new URL(`/infoplus/ide/project/${definition}/instances`, source.origin);
  list.searchParams.set('release', mode);
  const page = await context.newPage();
  let allowed = list.href;
  await page.route('**/*', route => {
    const request = route.request();
    return request.method() === 'GET' && request.url() === allowed && request.resourceType() === 'document'
      ? route.continue() : route.abort();
  });
  try {
    const response = await page.goto(list.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 15000 });
    if (!response?.ok() || page.url() !== list.href) return { status: 'unavailable', reason: '前置流程实例列表不可读取' };
    const rows = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const table = [...document.querySelectorAll('table')].find(t => {
        const headings = [...t.querySelectorAll('th')].map(e => e.textContent.trim());
        return ['Name', 'User', 'Status'].every(h => headings.includes(h));
      });
      if (!table) return [];
      const headings = [...table.querySelectorAll('th')].map(e => e.textContent.trim());
      return [...table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].flatMap(row => {
        const cells = [...row.cells];
        const data = [...row.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(a => new URL(a.getAttribute('href'), location.href))
          .filter(u => u.origin === location.origin && /^\/infoplus\/form\/e?\d+\/data\/?$/.test(u.pathname) && !u.search && !u.hash);
        if (data.length !== 1) return [];
        return [{name:cells[headings.indexOf('Name')]?.textContent.trim(), applicant:cells[headings.indexOf('User')]?.textContent.trim(),
          status:cells[headings.indexOf('Status')]?.textContent.trim(), dataPath:data[0].pathname}];
      });
    });
    const selection = selectLinkedInstance(rows, criteria);
    if (selection.status !== 'matched') return selection;
    const dataUrl = new URL(selection.candidate.dataPath, source.origin);
    allowed = dataUrl.href;
    const dataResponse = await page.goto(allowed, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 15000 });
    if (!dataResponse?.ok() || page.url() !== allowed) return { status: 'unavailable', reason: '前置申请数据页不可读取' };
    const values = await page.evaluate(id => [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name], textarea[name], select[name]')]
      .filter(e => e.name === id).map(e => ({id:e.name,value:String(e.value ?? '')})), criteria.fieldId);
    const value = extractLinkedBusinessValue(values, criteria.fieldId);
    if (value.status !== 'found') return value;
    return {...value, evidence:{predecessorCode:predecessor.code, definitionId:definition, fieldId:criteria.fieldId,
      release:criteria.release, match:'申请人、业务名称、状态精确匹配', source:'已授权的前置实例数据页', verifiedAt:new Date().toISOString()}};
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

=== src/live-options.mjs
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { isChoiceField } from './field-options.mjs';
import { isSuggest, matchSuggest, readFieldIndex, readOptionEvidence, saveOptionEvidence } from './option-evidence.mjs';

const renderPath = /^\/infoplus\/form\/[\w-]+\/render\/?$/i;
const renderApi = '/infoplus/interface/render';
const instanceIdPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{8}(?:-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i;
const progressPath = /^\/infoplus\/interface\/instance\/([a-f0-9-]+)\/progress$/i;
const safeId = /^[\w.-]{1,128}$/u;
const dropDownMenu = '[role="option"], .ui-autocomplete .ui-menu-item, .select2-results__option, .suggestion';
const delay = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const dedicatedEndpoint = 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/';
const chromeLauncher = fileURLToPath(new URL('../start-infoplus-chrome.ps1', import.meta.url));
const runFile = promisify(execFile);

function localChromeEndpoint(value) {
  const url = URL.parse(value);
  const validPath = url?.protocol === 'http:' && url.pathname === '/' ||
    url?.protocol === 'ws:' && /^\/devtools\/browser\/[\w-]+$/.test(url.pathname);
  if (!validPath || url.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' || !url.port ||
      url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash) {
    throw new Error('Chrome 调试端点必须是本机 HTTP 地址或浏览器级 WebSocket 地址');
  }
  return url.href;
}

export async function chromeEndpoint() {
  if (process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP && localChromeEndpoint(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP) !== dedicatedEndpoint) {
    throw new Error('本项目使用专用 Chrome 的固定端口 9222，请检查 INFOPLUS_CDP');
  }
  // V1.2：PowerShell -Check 在系统瞬时负载下可能超时误报，超时可配置并重试一次，
  // 仍以脚本退出码为准（退出码 2 仍表示专用 Chrome 未运行），不降低专用 Chrome 校验语义。
  const timeout = Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_CHROME_CHECK_TIMEOUT || 25000);
  const check = () => runFile('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-File', chromeLauncher, '-Check'],
    { timeout, windowsHide: true });
  try {
    await check();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 2) return;
    try {
      await check();
    } catch (retryError) {
      if (retryError.code === 2) return;
      throw new Error('无法确认端口 9222 由专用 Chrome 使用，请运行 start-infoplus-chrome.ps1 检查', { cause: retryError });
    }
  }
  return dedicatedEndpoint;
}

export async function attachChrome(endpoint) {
  endpoint ??= await chromeEndpoint();
  if (!endpoint) throw new Error('专用 Chrome 尚未启动，请运行 start-infoplus-chrome.ps1');
  const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(localChromeEndpoint(endpoint), { timeout: 25000, noDefaults: true })
    .catch(error => { throw new Error('无法连接 Chrome 调试会话，请检查专用 Chrome 是否仍在运行', { cause: error }); });
  return { context: browser.contexts()[0], close: () => browser.close() };
}

async function optional(path) {
  try { return JSON.parse((await readFile(path, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
}

async function inventory(directory, project) {
  const network = await optional(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', 'index.json'));
  const index = await readFieldIndex(directory, network);
  const known = await optional(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'));
  const fields = new Map();
  const add = (id, info) => {
    if (!safeId.test(id ?? '')) return;
    const field = fields.get(id) ?? { id, choice: false, sensitive: false, staticViews: [], uuids: [], aliases: [] };
    field.choice ||= info.choice;
    field.sensitive ||= info.sensitive;
    if (!field.name && info.name && info.name !== id) field.name = info.name;
    if (info.static && info.viewId) field.staticViews.push(info.viewId);
    if (info.uuid && safeId.test(info.uuid)) field.uuids.push(info.uuid);
    if (info.alias && safeId.test(info.alias)) field.aliases.push([info.viewId, info.alias]);
    fields.set(id, field);
  };
  for (const f of index.fields) add(f.id, {
    uuid: f.uuid, name: f.label, choice: isChoiceField({ ...f, apiType: f.type }), sensitive: ['User', 'Organize'].includes(f.type),
  });
  if (known?.project?.workflowDefinitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId) {
    for (const f of known.fields) add(f.id, {
      name: f.name, choice: isChoiceField(f), sensitive: ['User', 'Organize'].includes(f.apiType),
      viewId: f.viewId, static: f.optionSets?.some(set => set.kind === 'xsn' && set.completeness === 'complete'),
    });
  }
  for (const view of project.views ?? []) {
    if (!/^[\da-f-]{36}$/i.test(view.id)) continue;
    const xsn = await optional(join(directory, 'views', view.id, 'xsn.json'));
    for (const panel of xsn?.views ?? []) {
      for (const control of panel.controls ?? []) {
        const id = control.binding.split('/').at(-1).split(':').at(-1);
        add(id, { viewId: view.id, alias: control.id, choice: isChoiceField({ usages: [control] }) });
      }
    }
  }
  return [...fields.values()];
}

async function targets(context, project, supplied) {
  const origin = new URL(project.source).origin;
  const possible = value => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(value);
      return url.origin === origin && renderPath.test(url.pathname) && !url.username && !url.password;
    } catch { return false; }
  };
  if (supplied) {
    if (!possible(supplied)) throw new Error('申请页必须是同源的 InfoPlus render 页面');
    return [supplied];
  }
  const code = project.code.toLowerCase();
  const pages = await Promise.all(context.pages().filter(page => possible(page.url())).map(async page => {
    const title = await page.title().catch(() => '');
    return title.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9_]+/).includes(code) ? page.url() : undefined;
  }));
  const selected = pages.filter(Boolean);
  if (selected.length) return [...new Set(selected)];
  const ide = new Set([project.source, project.editor].filter(Boolean));
  const links = await Promise.all(context.pages().filter(page => ide.has(page.url())).map(page =>
    page.locator('a[href]').evaluateAll(anchors => anchors.map(anchor => anchor.href)).catch(() => [])));
  return [...new Set(links.flat().filter(possible))];
}

// The probe uses a separate tab. Only same-origin read routes are reachable from it.
export function permittedProbeRequest(url, method, resource, renderUrl, { formBody, instanceId } = {}) {
  if (url.origin !== renderUrl.origin) return false;
  if (isSuggest(url)) return ['GET', 'POST'].includes(method);
  if (method === 'POST' && ['xhr', 'fetch'].includes(resource) && formBody && formBody.length <= 32768 &&
      renderPath.test(renderUrl.pathname) && !url.search) {
    const step = renderUrl.pathname.split('/')[3];
    const params = new URLSearchParams(formBody);
    if (params.getAll('stepId').length !== 1 || params.get('stepId') !== step) return false;
    if (url.pathname === renderApi) {
      return params.getAll('admin').length === 1 && params.get('admin') === 'false' &&
        params.getAll('instanceId').length <= 1 && (!params.get('instanceId') || params.get('instanceId') === step);
    }
    return instanceIdPattern.test(instanceId ?? '') && progressPath.exec(url.pathname)?.[1].toLowerCase() === instanceId.toLowerCase() &&
      !params.has('admin') && !params.has('instanceId');
  }
  if (!['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(method)) return false;
  if (resource === 'document') return url.href === renderUrl.href;
  if (['stylesheet', 'image', 'font', 'script'].includes(resource) &&
      /\.(?:m?js|css|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|webp|ico|woff2?|ttf|otf)$/i.test(url.pathname) &&
      !/\/(?:start|apply|submit|save|draft|delete|withdraw|doAction)(?:\/|\.|$)/i.test(url.pathname)) return true;
  return /\/(?:findFormTemplate|findWorkflowDefinition|getFormData|getFormFields|getFormControls|listCodes)\/?$/i.test(url.pathname);
}

function renderedForm(data, project) {
  const form = data?.entities?.[0];
  if (![0, '0'].includes(data?.errno) || !form?.step?.definitionId || form.step.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId ||
      !(project.views ?? []).some(view => view.id === form.viewId) ||
      !instanceIdPattern.test(form.step.instanceId ?? '')) return;
  return { viewId: form.viewId, instanceId: form.step.instanceId, fields: form.fields };
}

function identityFromPage({ code, definitionId, views, stageViews }) {
  const metadata = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-workflow-definition-id],[data-view-id],[data-form-view-id]')];
  const definitions = metadata.map(element => element.getAttribute('data-workflow-definition-id')).filter(Boolean);
  const title = document.title.toLowerCase();
  const titleMatch = title.split(/[^a-z0-9_]+/).includes(code);
  const stageName = document.title.split(/\s+-\s+/)[0]?.trim();
  const stageIds = [...new Set(stageViews.filter(node => node.name === stageName).map(node => node.view))];
  const ids = [...new Set(metadata.flatMap(element => [element.getAttribute('data-view-id'),
    element.getAttribute('data-form-view-id')]).filter(id => views.includes(id)))];
  return {
    valid: definitions.length ? definitions.every(id => id === definitionId) : titleMatch,
    versionVerified: definitions.includes(definitionId),
    viewId: ids.length === 1 ? ids[0] : stageIds.length === 1 ? stageIds[0] : undefined,
  };
}

function scanControls({ fields, viewId }) {
  const aliases = new Map();
  const collisions = new Set();
  const set = (name, id) => {
    if (aliases.has(name) && aliases.get(name) !== id) collisions.add(name);
    else aliases.set(name, id);
  };
  for (const field of fields) {
    set(field.id, field.id);
    for (const uuid of field.uuids) set(uuid, field.id);
    for (const [view, name] of field.aliases) if (viewId === view) set(name, field.id);
  }
  const result = [];
  for (const [index, element] of [...document.querySelectorAll('select,input,textarea,[role="combobox"]')].entries()) {
    const type = element.getAttribute('type')?.toLowerCase();
    if (['button', 'submit', 'reset', 'hidden', 'password', 'file', 'image'].includes(type)) continue;
    const wrapper = element.closest('[data-field-name],[data-field],[data-binding],[xd\\:binding]');
    const raw = [element.name, element.id, element.getAttribute('data-field-id'), wrapper?.getAttribute('data-field-name'),
      wrapper?.getAttribute('data-field'), wrapper?.getAttribute('data-binding'), wrapper?.getAttribute('xd:binding')];
    const keys = raw.filter(Boolean).flatMap(key => [key, key.split('/').at(-1).split(':').at(-1)]);
    const ids = [...new Set(keys.filter(key => aliases.has(key) && !collisions.has(key)).map(key => aliases.get(key)))];
    if (ids.length !== 1) continue;
    const id = ids[0];
    const select2 = element.tagName === 'SELECT' && element.nextElementSibling?.matches('.select2')
      ? element.nextElementSibling.querySelector('.select2-selection') : null;
    const target = select2 || element;
    const container = target.closest('.infoplus_control') || target;
    const visible = target.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(target).visibility !== 'hidden';
    const native = !select2 && (element.tagName === 'SELECT' || type === 'radio' || type === 'checkbox');
    const radioLabel = type === 'radio' && (element.labels?.[0]?.textContent ||
      element.getAttribute('aria-label') || (element.nextSibling?.nodeType === 3 && element.nextSibling.nodeValue));
    const radioValue = type === 'radio' && (element.getAttribute('value') ||
      element.getAttribute('data-value') || element.getAttribute('xd:onValue'));
    const options = native && element.tagName === 'SELECT'
      ? [...element.options].filter(option => !option.disabled && option.value && option.textContent.trim()).slice(0, 500)
        .map(option => ({ value: option.value, label: option.textContent.trim() }))
      : radioValue && radioLabel?.trim() ? [{ value: radioValue, label: radioLabel.trim() }] : [];
    const labelCell = element.closest('td')?.previousElementSibling;
    const labelText = element.labels?.[0]?.textContent || element.getAttribute('aria-label') ||
      (labelCell && !labelCell.querySelector('input,select,textarea,.infoplus_control') ? labelCell.textContent : '');
    const label = labelText?.replace(/[\s*：:]+$/u, '').trim();
    target.setAttribute('data-infoplus-prd-control', String(index));
    result.push({ id, index, visible, native, select2: !!select2, type, options, checked: element.checked,
      label: label && /^(?=.*\p{L})[\p{L}\p{N}（）()、/／· _-]{1,60}$/u.test(label) ? label : undefined,
      required: element.required === true || target.getAttribute('aria-required') === 'true' ||
      element.getAttribute('aria-required') === 'true',
    readOnly: element.readOnly === true || element.disabled === true || element.getAttribute('aria-readonly') === 'true' ||
      target.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || container.classList.contains('infoplus_readonly') ||
      element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' });
  }
  return result;
}

const controlAt = (page, index) => page.locator(`[data-infoplus-prd-control="${index}"]`);

function snapshots(rows) {
  const state = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const values = state.get(row.id) ?? { visible: false, required: false, readOnly: true };
    values.visible ||= row.visible;
    values.required ||= row.required;
    values.readOnly &&= row.readOnly;
    state.set(row.id, values);
  }
  return state;
}

function changedFields(before, after, fieldId) {
  const changes = [];
  const absent = { present: false, visible: false, required: false, readOnly: null };
  for (const id of new Set([...before.keys(), ...after.keys()])) {
    if (id === fieldId) continue;
    const old = before.has(id) ? { present: true, ...before.get(id) } : absent;
    const next = after.has(id) ? { present: true, ...after.get(id) } : absent;
    if (JSON.stringify(old) !== JSON.stringify(next)) changes.push({ fieldId: id, before: old, after: next });
  }
  return changes;
}

async function menuLabels(page) {
  return page.locator(dropDownMenu).filter({ visible: true }).allTextContents()
    .then(items => items.map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean));
}

async function collectPage(context, url, project, fields, bundle, driverHints, deadline) {
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const observations = [];
  try {
    const session = await context.newCDPSession(page);
    await session.send('Network.setBypassServiceWorker', { bypass: true });
    await page.routeWebSocket('**/*', socket => socket.close());
    const destination = new URL(url);
    let form;
    let renderRequested = false;
    await page.route('**/*', async route => {
      const request = route.request();
      const requestUrl = new URL(request.url());
      const formRead = request.method() === 'POST' && (requestUrl.pathname === renderApi || progressPath.test(requestUrl.pathname));
      const formBody = formRead && request.frame() === page.mainFrame() &&
        /^application\/x-www-form-urlencoded(?:;|$)/i.test(request.headers()['content-type'] ?? '')
        ? request.postData() : undefined;
      const permitted = permittedProbeRequest(requestUrl, request.method(), request.resourceType(), destination,
        { formBody, instanceId: form?.instanceId });
      if (!permitted) return route.abort();
      if (!formRead) return route.continue();
      const initial = requestUrl.pathname === renderApi;
      if (initial) {
        renderRequested = true;
        form = undefined;
      }
      let response;
      try {
        response = await route.fetch({ maxRedirects: 0, timeout: 10000 });
        if (response.status() >= 300 && response.status() < 400) return await route.abort();
        if (initial && response.ok()) form = renderedForm(await response.json().catch(() => undefined), project);
        await route.fulfill({ response });
      } catch { await route.abort().catch(() => {}); }
      finally { await response?.dispose(); }
    });
    const ready = async () => {
      await page.locator('input[name]:not([type="hidden"]):visible,select:visible,textarea:visible,[role="combobox"]:visible').first()
        .waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});
      if (form) await page.locator('.overlay.active').first().waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 6000 });
    };
    await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 12000 });
    await ready();
    const identity = renderRequested ? { valid: !!form, viewId: form?.viewId, versionVerified: !!form } : await page.evaluate(identityFromPage, {
      code: project.code.toLowerCase(), definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId,
      views: (project.views ?? []).map(view => view.id),
      stageViews: (bundle?.workflow?.nodes ?? []).filter(node => node.view).map(node => ({ name: node.name, view: node.view })),
    });
    if (!identity.valid) return { observations, reason: '申请页项目或版本无法核对' };
    const renderedFields = new Map(fields.map(field => [field.id, { ...field }]));
    for (const [id, metadata] of Object.entries(form?.fields ?? {})) {
      if (!safeId.test(id) || metadata?.name !== id) continue;
      const field = renderedFields.get(id) ?? { id, aliases: [], uuids: [], staticViews: [] };
      field.choice ||= isChoiceField({ apiType: metadata.type });
      field.sensitive ||= /^(?:User|Organi[sz]e|Department|Person)/i.test(metadata.type ?? '');
      renderedFields.set(id, field);
    }
    fields = [...renderedFields.values()];
    const describe = () => page.evaluate(scanControls, { fields, viewId: identity.viewId });
    const records = await describe();
    if (!records.some(row => row.visible)) return { observations, reason: '表单尚未显示可识别控件' };
    const state = snapshots(records);
    const relevant = new Map(fields.filter(field => !field.sensitive).map(field => [field.id, field]));
    const choiceIds = rows => [...new Set(rows.filter(row => row.visible && !row.readOnly &&
      relevant.has(row.id) && (row.native || row.select2 || relevant.get(row.id).choice)).map(row => row.id))];
    const choices = choiceIds(records);
    const known = fields.filter(field => !field.sensitive).flatMap(field =>
      [{ id: field.id }, ...field.uuids.map(uuid => ({ id: field.id, uuid }))]);
    const names = new Map(fields.filter(field => field.name).map(field => [field.id, field.name]));
    for (const row of records) if (row.label) names.set(row.id, row.label);
    const observe = (fieldId, item) => observations.push({
      fieldId, fieldName: names.get(fieldId), viewId: identity.viewId, versionVerified: identity.versionVerified, when: [], ...item,
    });
    for (const [id, properties] of state) observe(id, { kind: 'runtime-state', state: properties });

    const pending = [];
    page.on('response', response => {
      if (!isSuggest(new URL(response.url())) || !response.ok() || pending.length >= 60) return;
      const request = response.request();
      pending.push(response.text().then(text => ({
        request: { url: request.url(), method: request.method(), postData: {
          mimeType: request.headers()['content-type'], text: request.postData(),
        } },
        response: { status: response.status(), content: { text } },
      }), () => undefined));
    });
    async function probe(id, rows, when = []) {
      if (Date.now() >= deadline) return;
      const controls = rows.filter(row => row.id === id && row.visible && !row.readOnly);
      if (!controls.length) return;
      if (controls[0].label && !names.has(id)) names.set(id, controls[0].label);
      const options = controls.flatMap(control => control.options).filter(option => option.label).slice(0, 500);
      if (options.length) observe(id, {
        kind: 'runtime-dom', when, options, completeness: 'partial',
      });
      const first = controls.find(control => !control.native);
      if (!first || relevant.get(id).staticViews.includes(identity.viewId)) return [];
      const previous = new Set(await menuLabels(page));
      pending.length = 0;
      const locator = controlAt(page, first.index);
      if (!await locator.click({ timeout: 1100 }).then(() => true, () => false)) return [];
      await delay(450);
      const labels = (await menuLabels(page)).filter(label => !previous.has(label));
      const entries = await Promise.race([Promise.all(pending.splice(0)), delay(800).then(() => [])]);
      const interaction = { fieldId: id, viewId: identity.viewId, labels, when, versionVerified: identity.versionVerified };
      const matched = entries.filter(Boolean).map(entry => matchSuggest(entry, project, known, interaction)).filter(Boolean);
      for (const item of matched) observe(id, item);
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});
      return matched.flatMap(item => item.options).filter(option => labels.includes(option.label));
    }
    const custom = new Map();
    for (const id of choices) {
      const options = await probe(id, records);
      if (options?.length) custom.set(id, options);
    }

    let trials = 0;
    let reason;
    const drivers = [...choices].sort((a, b) => Number(driverHints.has(b)) - Number(driverHints.has(a)) ||
      Number(custom.has(b)) - Number(custom.has(a)));
    for (const id of drivers) {
      if (Date.now() >= deadline) break;
      const baseline = await describe();
      const before = snapshots(baseline);
      let previous = before;
      const rows = baseline.filter(row => row.id === id && row.visible && !row.readOnly);
      const native = rows.flatMap(row => row.options.map(option => ({ ...option, index: row.index, type: row.type })));
      if (rows.length === 1 && rows[0].type === 'checkbox') {
        native.push({ value: true, label: '勾选', index: rows[0].index, type: 'checkbox' },
          { value: false, label: '取消勾选', index: rows[0].index, type: 'checkbox' });
      }
      const first = rows.find(row => !row.native);
      const options = native.length ? native : first ?
        (custom.get(id) ?? []).map(option => ({ ...option, index: first.index, type: 'suggest' })) : [];
      if (options.length < 2 || options.length > 5) continue;
      const baseControl = controlAt(page, options[0].index);
      const original = options[0].type === 'checkbox' ? rows[0].checked :
        await baseControl.evaluate(element => element.type === 'radio'
          ? [...element.ownerDocument.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]')].find(item =>
            item.name === element.name && item.checked)?.getAttribute('value') : element.value,
        undefined, { timeout: 600 }).catch(() => null);
      for (const option of options) {
        if (Date.now() >= deadline) break;
        const current = await describe();
        const target = current.find(row => row.id === id && row.visible && !row.readOnly &&
          (option.type !== 'radio' || row.options.some(item => item.value === option.value)));
        if (!target) continue;
        const locator = controlAt(page, target.index);
        const when = [{ fieldId: id, value: option.value, label: option.label,
          state: option.type === 'checkbox' ? 'checked' : undefined }];
        try {
          if (option.type === 'radio') await locator.check({ timeout: 950 });
          else if (option.type === 'checkbox') await locator.setChecked(option.value, { timeout: 950 });
          else if (option.type === 'suggest') {
            if (await locator.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') await locator.click({ timeout: 950 });
            const exact = new RegExp(`^\\s*${option.label.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}\\s*$`);
            await page.locator(dropDownMenu).filter({ visible: true, hasText: exact }).click({ timeout: 1100 });
          }
          else await locator.selectOption(option.value, { timeout: 950 });
          if (target.select2 && !await locator.evaluate((element, value) =>
            element.closest('.select2')?.previousElementSibling?.value === String(value), option.value, { timeout: 950 })) continue;
          trials++;
          await delay(350);
          const updated = await describe();
          const currentState = snapshots(updated);
          const changes = [...new Map([...changedFields(previous, currentState, id), ...changedFields(before, currentState, id)]
            .map(change => [change.fieldId, change])).values()];
          previous = currentState;
          if (changes.length) observe(id, { kind: 'runtime-change', when, changes });
          const affected = new Set(changes.map(change => change.fieldId));
          for (const next of choiceIds(updated)) {
            if (next !== id && (affected.has(next) || updated.some(row => row.id === next &&
                !baseline.some(old => old.id === next && JSON.stringify(old.options) === JSON.stringify(row.options))))) {
              await probe(next, updated, when);
            }
          }
        } catch { /* The field could not be switched in this view. */ }
      }
      if (Date.now() < deadline) {
        // Reload the isolated probe when a custom or initially blank radio cannot be restored reliably.
        const current = await describe();
        const restore = current.find(row => row.id === id && row.visible && !row.readOnly &&
          (options[0].type !== 'radio' || row.options.some(item => item.value === original)));
        if (!native.length || !restore) {
          try {
            await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 8000 });
            await ready();
          } catch {
            reason = '恢复表单时超时，保留已采集结果';
            break;
          }
          if (renderRequested && form?.viewId !== identity.viewId) {
            reason = '恢复后的表单视图无法核对，保留已采集结果';
            break;
          }
        } else if (options[0].type === 'radio') {
          await controlAt(page, restore.index).check({ timeout: 750 }).catch(() => {});
        } else if (options[0].type === 'checkbox') {
          await controlAt(page, restore.index).setChecked(original, { timeout: 750 }).catch(() => {});
        } else if (original != null) {
          await controlAt(page, restore.index).selectOption(original, { timeout: 750 }).catch(() => {});
        }
        await delay(150);
      }
    }
    return { observations, controls: choices.length, trials, reason, timeLimitReached: Date.now() >= deadline,
      viewId: identity.viewId, versionVerified: identity.versionVerified };
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

export async function collectLiveOptions(context, directory, project, supplied) {
  const pages = await targets(context, project, supplied);
  if (!pages.length) return { pages: 0, added: 0, reason: '会话中没有可核对的同流程申请页' };
  const fields = await inventory(directory, project);
  const bundle = await optional(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'));
  const driverHints = new Set((await readOptionEvidence(directory, project))
    .filter(item => item.changes?.length).map(item => item.fieldId));
  const deadline = Date.now() + 75000;
  const runs = [];
  for (const url of pages) {
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) break;
    try { runs.push(await collectPage(context, url, project, fields, bundle, driverHints, deadline)); }
    catch { runs.push({ reason: '无法打开或读取受限申请页', observations: [] }); }
  }
  const observations = runs.flatMap(run => run.observations);
  return { pages: runs.length, captured: observations.filter(item => item.options?.length).length,
    ...await saveOptionEvidence(directory, project, observations), runs: runs.map(({ observations, ...run }) => run) };
}

=== END src/live-options.mjs
=== src/node-button-map.mjs
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 节点按钮 / Workflow 连线 / 分支映射（通用）
 *
 * 不硬编码任何流程；输入 workflow.mmd 与（可选的）实测页面按钮清单，
 * 输出每个节点的完整按钮清单、目标节点、分支条件与验证状态。
 * 验证状态严格区分：actual-verified（真实点击并核对流转） / config-confirmed（配置已确认、实际未验证）。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';

const AUTO_LABEL = /^(是|否|result|split\d*|true|false|yes|no)$/i;

export function parseWorkflowMermaid(text) {
  const nodes = new Map();
  const transitions = [];
  for (const raw of String(text || '').split('\n')) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    let m = line.match(/^(n\d+)\["(.+?)\s*\[(\d+)\]"\]\s*$/);
    if (m) {
      nodes.set(m[1], { key: m[1], nodeId: Number(m[3]), name: m[2].trim() });
      continue;
    }
    m = line.match(/^(n\d+)\s*-->\s*\|\s*"(.+?)\s*\[(\d+)\]"\s*\|\s*(n\d+)\s*$/);
    if (!m) m = line.match(/^(n\d+)\s*-->\s*\|\s*"(.+?)"\s*\|\s*(n\d+)\s*$/);
    if (m) {
      const transitionId = m.length === 5 ? Number(m[3]) : null;
      const label = m[2].trim();
      transitions.push({
        fromKey: m[1], toKey: m[4] ?? m[3], label, transitionId,
        automatic: AUTO_LABEL.test(label.replace(/\s*\[\d+\]\s*$/, '')),
      });
    }
  }
  return { nodes: [...nodes.values()], transitions, byKey: nodes };
}

/** 构建每节点按钮清单（含自动网关分支，单独标注） */
export function buildButtonMap(parsed, options = {}) {
  const byNodeId = new Map(parsed.nodes.map(n => [n.nodeId, n]));
  const map = new Map();
  for (const n of parsed.nodes) map.set(n.nodeId, {
    nodeId: n.nodeId, name: n.name, buttons: [], automaticBranches: [],
  });
  for (const t of parsed.transitions) {
    const from = parsed.byKey.get(t.fromKey);
    const to = parsed.byKey.get(t.toKey);
    if (!from || !to) continue;
    const entry = map.get(from.nodeId);
    if (!entry) continue;
    const item = {
      label: t.label.replace(/\s*\[\d+\]\s*$/, '').trim(),
      rawLabel: t.label, transitionId: t.transitionId,
      actionId: t.transitionId == null ? null : String(t.transitionId),
      targetNodeId: to.nodeId, targetName: to.name,
      condition: t.automatic ? t.label.replace(/\s*\[\d+\]\s*$/, '').trim() : '',
      verification: 'config-confirmed', verifiedAt: null, actualTargetNodeId: null,
    };
    if (t.automatic) entry.automaticBranches.push(item);
    else entry.buttons.push(item);
  }
  // 叠加实测页面按钮（含不在 Workflow 连线中的平台级按钮，如「终止」）
  for (const [nodeId, observed] of Object.entries(options.observedButtons || {})) {
    const entry = map.get(Number(nodeId));
    if (!entry) continue;
    for (const b of observed) {
      const rawActionId = b.actionId || null;
      const actionId = String(rawActionId || '').replace(/^.*action_(?:\d+_)?/, '');
      const label = b.kill ? '终止' : String(b.text || '').replace(b.tip || '\u0000', '').trim();
      const candidates = entry.buttons.filter(x => actionId
        ? String(x.actionId) === actionId : x.label === b.text);
      const found = candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : null;
      if (found) { found.observedOnPage = true; found.rawActionId = rawActionId; if (b.tip) found.condition ||= b.tip; }
      else entry.buttons.push({
        label, rawLabel: b.text, rawActionId, transitionId: /^\d+$/.test(actionId) ? Number(actionId) : null,
        actionId: actionId || null,
        targetNodeId: null, targetName: null, condition: b.tip || '',
        pageLevel: true, kill: !!b.kill, observedOnPage: true,
        verification: 'config-confirmed', verifiedAt: null, actualTargetNodeId: null,
      });
    }
  }
  // 叠加实测流转（来自逐节点 Debug 记录）
  for (const v of options.verifiedActions || []) {
    const entry = map.get(Number(v.nodeId));
    if (!entry) continue;
    const candidates = entry.buttons.filter(x => v.actionId ? String(x.actionId) === String(v.actionId) : x.label === v.label);
    const btn = candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : null;
    if (btn && v.instanceId && v.accepted && v.actualTargetNodeId == null) {
      btn.verification = 'actual-executed';
      btn.instanceId = v.instanceId;
      btn.actualResult = '提交响应成功，未返回新的办理节点；后续流转需结合汇合记录确认';
    }
    if (btn && v.instanceId && v.actualTargetNodeId != null) {
      btn.verification = 'actual-verified';
      btn.verifiedAt = v.at || null;
      btn.actualTargetNodeId = v.actualTargetNodeId ?? null;
      btn.actualTargetName = v.actualTargetName ?? null;
      btn.instanceId = v.instanceId || null;
      btn.actualTargets = v.actualTargets || [{ nodeId: v.actualTargetNodeId, name: v.actualTargetName }];
    }
  }
  return {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    nodeCount: parsed.nodes.length,
    transitionCount: parsed.transitions.length,
    nodes: [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => a.nodeId - b.nodeId),
  };
}

export function buttonMapToMarkdown(map) {
  const lines = ['| 当前节点 | 操作按钮/分支 | 类型 | 目标节点 | 连线ID | 验证状态 |',
    '|---|---|---|---|---|---|'];
  for (const n of map.nodes) {
    for (const b of n.buttons) {
      lines.push(`| ${n.name} [${n.nodeId}] | ${b.label}${b.kill ? '（平台级）' : ''} | ${b.pageLevel ? '页面按钮' : '人工动作'} | ${b.targetName ? `${b.targetName} [${b.targetNodeId}]` : '—'} | ${b.transitionId ?? '—'} | ${b.verification === 'actual-verified' ? '实际验证' : '配置已确认、实际未验证'} |`);
    }
    for (const b of n.automaticBranches) {
      lines.push(`| ${n.name} [${n.nodeId}] | ${b.label} | 自动网关条件 | ${b.targetName} [${b.targetNodeId}] | ${b.transitionId ?? '—'} | 配置已确认（自动流转） |`);
    }
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function writeButtonMap(map, directory, basename = 'button-branch-map') {
  fs.mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });
  const json = `${directory}/${basename}.json`;
  const md = `${directory}/${basename}.md`;
  fs.writeFileSync(json, JSON.stringify(map, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  fs.writeFileSync(md, `# 节点按钮与分支映射\n\n生成时间：${map.generatedAt}\n节点数：${map.nodeCount}，连线数：${map.transitionCount}\n\n${buttonMapToMarkdown(map)}\n`, 'utf-8');
  return { json, md };
}

=== src/node-evidence-content.mjs
/**
 * 从同一份标准化 bundle + 截图索引生成「节点图文说明」内容。
 * 不写死 Z1775：字段、按钮、角色、规则和截图均来自已采集证据。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { eligibleScreenshot } from './screenshot-quality.mjs';
import { workflowOrder, businessControl } from './workflow-order.mjs';
import { memberScopeDescription } from './debug-runtime.mjs';

const IMAGE_EXT = /\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$/i;
const importantField = /审核|审批|意见|负责人|公示|保险|取消|报销|航班|回访|附件|日期|团组|打印|签名|报告/;
const documentImage = image => eligibleScreenshot(image);
const categoryOrder = { 'full-page': 0, 'business-module': 1, 'action-buttons': 2, 'special-field': 3, validation: 4 };
const preferredModules = /审核意见|处理意见|审批意见|负责人|公示|保险/;

function loadJson(file) {
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8')); } catch { return null; }
}

function existingImage(directory, file, screenshotRoot = directory) {
  if (!file || !IMAGE_EXT.test(file)) return null;
  const root = path.resolve(screenshotRoot);
  const directoryRoot = path.resolve(directory);
  const absolute = path.isAbsolute(file) ? path.resolve(file) : path.resolve(directoryRoot, file);
  const allowed = [root, directoryRoot];
  if (absolute.split(path.sep).includes('original')) return null;
  if (!allowed.some(root => absolute.startsWith(root + path.sep)) || !fs.existsSync(absolute)) return null;
  return path.relative(directory, absolute).replace(/\\/g, '/');
}

function fieldName(bundle, id, fallback) {
  return bundle.fields?.find(f => f.id === id)?.name || fallback || id;
}

export function chooseFields(bundle, node, runtimeStages) {
  const ids = node?.fields || [];
  const details = new Map();
  for (const stage of runtimeStages) {
    for (const field of stage.fields || []) if (field.id) details.set(field.id, field);
  }
  const scored = ids.map(id => {
    const detail = details.get(id) || {};
    const name = fieldName(bundle, id, detail.name);
    const type = businessControl({ ...bundle.fields?.find(f => f.id === id), ...detail, name });
    const score = (importantField.test(name) ? 3 : 0) + (type === 'User' || type === 'Organize' ? 3 : 0) +
      (detail.required || detail.notNull ? 2 : 0) + (detail.fieldChanging ? 2 : 0) +
      (/w/.test(detail.permission || '') ? 1 : 0);
    const ruleParts = [];
    if (detail.required || detail.notNull) ruleParts.push('该次页面观测标记必填');
    if (!detail.readOnly && /w/.test(detail.permission || '')) ruleParts.push('该次页面观测可编辑；历史快照不能证明当前权限');
    if (detail.readOnly) ruleParts.push('只读');
    if (detail.fieldChanging) ruleParts.push('条件或联动字段');
    if (detail.settings?.userFilters) ruleParts.push(memberScopeDescription(detail.settings));
    if (type === '成员选择' && !detail.settings?.userFilters) ruleParts.push('候选人员范围待确认');
    if (!ruleParts.length) ruleParts.push('当前节点显示；详细规则见字段清单');
    const special = bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.special?.find(s => s.fieldId === id && s.stage === node.name);
    const relevant = detail.visible !== false && !/^fieldFZ|^_VAR_|Help|URL/i.test(id) &&
      ((!detail.readOnly && /w/.test(detail.permission || '')) || detail.fieldChanging ||
        special && /新增|首次|变为|变化/.test(special.rule));
    return { id, name, type, rule: ruleParts.join('；'), score, relevant };
  }).filter(f => f.relevant).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh'));
  return scored.map(({ id, name, type, rule }) => [{
    id,
    name,
    type,
    required: details.get(id)?.required || details.get(id)?.notNull ? true : undefined,
    stages: [node?.name].filter(Boolean),
    rules: [rule],
  }]);
}

function chooseScreenshots(directory, shot, screenshotRoot, maxPerCategory = { full: 3, buttons: 1, special: 2 }) {
  const out = [];
  const images = (shot.images || []).filter(image => documentImage(image) && existingImage(directory, image.file, screenshotRoot));
  const seen = new Set();
  const add = (image, kind, title, note) => {
    const file = existingImage(directory, image.file, screenshotRoot);
    if (!file || seen.has(file)) return;
    seen.add(file);
    out.push({ kind, file, width: image.width, height: image.height, title, note,
      source: image.quality?.category, sourceType: shot.source || '真实 Debug 页面' });
  };
  const full = images.find(i => i.category === 'full-page' && i.sourceVariant === 'masked');
  const allModules = images.filter(i => i.category === 'business-module')
    .sort((a, b) => (a.crop?.y ?? 0) - (b.crop?.y ?? 0))
  const keyModules = allModules.filter(i => preferredModules.test(i.title || i.purpose || ''));
  const modules = (keyModules.length ? keyModules : allModules)
    .slice(0, maxPerCategory.full ?? 3);
  for (const [index, image] of modules.entries()) {
    add(image, 'full', image.title || `业务模块 ${index + 1}`,
      `${shot.source || '真实 Debug 页面'}；${image.purpose || image.title || '按业务模块从完整表单原图裁剪'}；${shot.verificationNote || ''}。`);
  }
  const hasPageImage = (shot.images || []).some(i => ['full-page', 'business-module'].includes(i.category) && existingImage(directory, i.file, screenshotRoot));
  if (full && !modules.length) add(full, 'full', '真实页面完整图',
    `${shot.source || '真实 Debug 页面'}；已核对完整表单边界，字段值和身份信息已遮盖。`);
  const button = images.find(i => i.category === 'action-buttons');
  if (button) add(button, 'buttons', '节点底部操作按钮',
    button.purpose || '从同一实例真实办理页面采集的底部按钮证据。');
  const specials = images.filter(i => i.category === 'special-field')
    .sort((a, b) => (categoryOrder[a.category] ?? 9) - (categoryOrder[b.category] ?? 9))
    .slice(0, maxPerCategory.special || 0);
  for (const image of specials) {
    add(image, 'special', `${image.fieldName || image.title || '特殊字段'}（${image.reason || '条件证据'}）`,
      `${image.purpose || '真实页面局部证据'}；${shot.verificationNote || shot.source || ''}`);
  }
  const kindOrder = { full: 0, buttons: 1, special: 2 };
  return out.sort((a, b) => (kindOrder[a.kind] ?? 9) - (kindOrder[b.kind] ?? 9));
}

function buttonRows(shot, mapped) {
  if (mapped) return mapped.buttons.map(t => [
    t.label, t.condition || '具体执行条件待验证',
    t.targetName || (t.kill ? '平台终止操作，结果未验证' : '待按 Workflow 核对'),
    t.verification === 'actual-verified' ? '实际点击并核对流转' : t.verification === 'actual-executed' ? '提交成功；后续流转待核对' : '配置确认、未实际点击',
  ]);
  const transitions = new Map((shot.buttonTransitions || []).map(b => [b.label, b]));
  const detected = [...new Set(shot.buttonsDetected || [])];
  const labels = [...new Set([...detected, ...transitions.keys()])]
    .filter(label => !/调试窗口|我知道了|查看最新数据|本步骤可|撤回/.test(label))
    .filter(label => detected.includes(label) || transitions.has(label))
    .filter(label => detected.some(value => value === label || value.includes(label) || label.includes(value)));
  return labels.map(label => {
    const t = transitions.get(label);
    return [label, t?.condition || '具体执行条件待验证', t?.targetName || '待按 Workflow 核对',
      t?.verification === 'actual-verified' ? '实际流转验证' : '配置确认、未实际点击'];
  });
}

function descriptionFor(bundle, node, shot) {
  if (shot.pageType === 'live-debug') {
    return `已进入该节点并完成页面取证。${shot.buttonDetectionNote || '当前身份可读取页面，动作执行状态见按钮流转表。'}`;
  }
  return `本节页面来自同一实例的历史只读快照，仅证明页面观测；实际办理结果以关联的流转记录为准。`;
}

export function buildNodeEvidenceSections(bundle, directory, screenshotRoot = path.join(directory, 'debug-evidence')) {
  if (!path.resolve(screenshotRoot).startsWith(path.resolve(directory) + path.sep)) return [];
  const index = loadJson(path.join(screenshotRoot, 'screenshot-index.json'));
  if (index?.code && bundle.project?.code && index.code !== bundle.project.code) return [];
  if (index?.version && bundle.project?.version && index.version !== bundle.project.version) return [];
  if (!index?.nodes?.length) return [];
  const nodeEvidence = new Map((bundle.nodeEvidence || []).map(n => [Number(n.id), n]));
  const stages = bundle.debug?.runtime?.stages || [];
  const special = bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.special || [];
  const buttonMap = loadJson(path.join(directory, 'button-branch-map.json'));
  const order = new Map(workflowOrder(bundle.workflow || {nodes:[]}).map((n,i) => [String(n.id), i]));
  return [...index.nodes].sort((a,b) => (order.get(String(a.nodeId)) ?? Infinity) - (order.get(String(b.nodeId)) ?? Infinity)).map(shot => {
    const nodeId = Number(shot.nodeId);
    const node = nodeEvidence.get(nodeId) || {};
    const mapped = buttonMap?.nodes.find(n => Number(n.nodeId) === nodeId);
    const names = new Map((bundle.workflow?.nodes || []).map(n => [String(n.id), n.name]));
    const incoming = (bundle.workflow?.transitions || []).filter(e => String(e.target) === String(nodeId));
    const entry = incoming.map(e => `${names.get(String(e.source)) || '前置环节'}：${e.name}`).join('；') || '流程入口（按 Workflow 配置）';
    const relevantStages = stages.filter(s => Number(s.state?.nodeId) === nodeId);
    const ownSpecial = special.filter(s => String(s.stage || '').includes(shot.nodeName)).slice(0, 5)
      .map(s => `${s.name || s.fieldId}：${s.source || ''}${s.rule ? `；${s.rule}` : ''}`);
    return {
      nodeId, name: shot.nodeName || node.name || `节点 ${nodeId}`,
      role: node.role || '待确认',
      verified: (mapped?.buttons || shot.buttonTransitions || []).some(b => b.verification === 'actual-verified'),
      description: `进入条件（Workflow 配置）：${entry}。${descriptionFor(bundle, node, shot)}`,
      fields: chooseFields(bundle, node, relevantStages),
      screenshots: chooseScreenshots(directory, shot, screenshotRoot),
      buttons: buttonRows(shot, mapped),
      rules: ownSpecial,
      sourceNote: `${shot.source || '真实 Debug'}；${shot.pageType === 'live-debug' ? '采集时实际办理页面' : '历史只读快照'}`,
    };
  });
}

=== src/node-evidence.mjs
import { optionEvidence } from './option-evidence.mjs';

export const nodeEvidenceVersion = 2;

export function buildNodeEvidence(workflow, stagePages, fields, optionRows, debugRuntime) {
  const names = new Map(workflow.nodes.map(node => [node.id, node.name]));
  const stages = new Map(stagePages.map(stage => [stage.viewId, stage]));
  const fieldIds = new Map();
  for (const field of fields) {
    if (!field.usages?.length) continue;
    if (!fieldIds.has(field.viewId)) fieldIds.set(field.viewId, new Set());
    fieldIds.get(field.viewId).add(field.id);
  }
  const runtime = new Map();
  for (const row of optionRows) {
    if (row.file !== optionEvidence || !row.versionVerified || !row.viewId) continue;
    if (!runtime.has(row.viewId)) runtime.set(row.viewId, { options: new Set(), dependencies: new Set(), sources: new Set() });
    const view = runtime.get(row.viewId);
    if (row.options?.length) view.options.add(row.fieldId);
    if (row.changes?.length) view.dependencies.add(row.fieldId);
    view.sources.add(row.source);
  }
  const edgeRef = (edge, other) => ({ id: edge.id, label: edge.name, nodeId: other, nodeName: names.get(other),
    evidence: edge.evidence, conditionConfigured: Boolean(edge.condition || edge.restrictScript), verified: false });
  return workflow.nodes.map(node => {
    const stage = stages.get(node.view);
    const observed = runtime.get(node.view);
    const operations = workflow.transitions.filter(edge => edge.source === node.id).map(edge => edgeRef(edge, edge.target));
    const observedAtView = Boolean(observed || stage?.screenshot);
    const debugStages = debugRuntime?.stages?.filter(s => String(s.state.nodeId) === String(node.id)) ?? [];
    const debugActions = debugRuntime?.actions?.filter(a => String(a.nodeId) === String(node.id)) ?? [];
    return {
      id: node.id, name: node.name, type: node.type, category: stage?.category, viewId: node.view || undefined,
      role: node.actor?.replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+|\b\d{5,}\b/g, '（已脱敏）') || undefined,
      roleSource: node.actor ? node.evidence : undefined,
      incoming: workflow.transitions.filter(edge => edge.target === node.id).map(edge => edgeRef(edge, edge.source)),
      fields: [...fieldIds.get(node.view) ?? []],
      optionFields: [...observed?.options ?? []], linkedFields: [...observed?.dependencies ?? []],
      operations, returns: operations.filter(action => /退回|退给|返回|重新办理/.test(action.label)),
      screenshot: debugStages.at(-1)?.screenshot ?? stage?.screenshot ?? stage?.staticScreenshot,
      debugStages, observedActions: debugActions,
      evidence: [
        { source: 'IDE 流程配置', reference: node.evidence },
        ...debugStages.map(s => ({ source: '后台 Debug 实际观察', reference: 'raw/debug-runs.json', instanceId: s.instanceId, flowStepId: s.state.flowStepId })),
        ...(stage?.staticScreenshot ? [{ source: 'XSN 模板', reference: stage.staticScreenshot }] : []),
        ...(stage?.manifest ? [{ source: '前台 Chrome 实际观察', reference: stage.manifest, scope: '视图' }] : []),
        ...[...observed?.sources ?? []].map(reference => ({ source: '前台 Chrome 实际观察', reference, scope: '视图' })),
      ],
      verification: { page: debugStages.length ? 'debug-node' : observedAtView ? 'front-view' : stage?.staticScreenshot ? 'static-template' : 'configuration',
        role: debugStages.some(s => s.state.executable) ? 'debug-permission-verified' : 'configuration',
        transition: debugActions.length ? 'observed-actions-only' : 'not-verified' },
    };
  });
}
