=== src/online-evidence.mjs
import { probeDebug, saveDebugProbe } from './debug-probe.mjs';
import { captureStagePages } from './capture-stage.mjs';
import { collectLiveOptions } from './live-options.mjs';
import { readDebugRuns, captureDebugStep, runtimeSummary, actDebugStep, resumeDebugTask, debugTaskLinks, appendDebugEvent } from './debug-runtime.mjs';
import { readDebugStep, redactDebugText } from './debug-session.mjs';
import { verifyDebugInstance } from './debug-verification.mjs';
import { launchDebug } from './debug-launch.mjs';
import { loadDebugPolicy, debugAvailability, assertOrdinaryDebugAction } from './debug-policy.mjs';
import { loadWorkflowInputs, applyWorkflowInputs, mayRetryAction } from './workflow-inputs.mjs';
import { recoverLinkedInput } from './linked-dashboard.mjs';

// Only unambiguous standard progression; alternate paths require a separately planned instance.
export function selectAutomaticAction(actions) {
  const standard = /^(?:提交(?:\/Submit)?|审核通过(?:\/Approved)?|审批通过(?:\/Approved)?|重新提交(?:\/Submit again)?)$/iu;
  const matches = actions.filter(a => standard.test(a.label) && !a.remarkRequired);
  if (matches.length !== 1) return undefined;
  try { assertOrdinaryDebugAction(matches[0].label); return matches[0]; } catch { return undefined; }
}

export function transientDebugProbe(result) {
  const state=result?.entry?.state;
  if (state==='unavailable') {
    const http=result.entry.http;
    return http == null || http >= 500 && http <= 599;
  }
  // not-checked can also mean invalid project or version; retry only the explicit timeout/transport result.
  return state==='not-checked' && result.reason==='专用 Chrome 未能在时限内核对目标版本或 Debug 页面';
}

export async function retryDebugProbe(operation, retries) {
  let result;
  for (let attempt=0; attempt<=retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      result=await operation();
      if (!transientDebugProbe(result) || attempt===retries) return result;
    } catch(error) { if (attempt===retries) throw error; }
  }
  return result;
}

async function missingRequired(page) {
  return page.evaluate(() => Object.values(window.$$?.entity?.fields ?? {}).filter(f => {
    if (!f.bound || f.notNull !== true || !f.permission?.includes('w')) return false;
    const controls = [...document.querySelectorAll('[name]')].filter(e =>
      (e.name === f.name || e.name === 'radioList-' + f.name || e.name?.startsWith(f.name + '_')) &&
      e.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden');
    if (!controls.length) return false;
    return !controls.some(e => (e.type === 'checkbox' || e.type === 'radio') ? e.checked : String(e.value ?? '').trim());
  }).map(f => f.name));
}

async function matchingPages(context, project, instanceId) {
  const result=[];
  for (const page of context.pages()) {
    try { result.push({page,state:await readDebugStep(page,project,instanceId)}); } catch {}
  }
  return result;
}

export async function collectOnlineEvidence(context, directory, project, debug = undefined) {
  const policy=await loadDebugPolicy();
  debug ??= await retryDebugProbe(()=>probeDebug(context, project),policy.maxRetries);
  const availability=debugAvailability(debug.entry, policy);
  const scope=`${project.code}@${project.version}`;
  const configuredInputs=await loadWorkflowInputs(project);
  let prior=await readDebugRuns(directory, project);
  const runs=prior?.runs?.filter(run=>run.origin==='automatic-debug') ?? [];
  const auto={ attempted:false, resumed:0, launched:0, steps:0, blocks:[] };
  const callbackBlocked=policy.allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks===false && debug.boundary?.callbacks?.enabled !== 0;
  if (policy.preferred && policy.autoRun && availability.selectedMode==='debug' && !callbackBlocked) {
    auto.attempted=true;
    const linked = await recoverLinkedInput(context, project, configuredInputs);
    if (linked?.item) configuredInputs.push(linked.item);
    else if (linked) {
      auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-validation',reason:`缺少可靠的前置业务编号（${linked.status}）`});
      await saveDebugProbe(directory,project,{...debug,front:{attempted:false},auto});
      return {debug,front:{attempted:false},auto};
    }
    if (!runs.length && configuredInputs.some(item => item.requiredApplicant)) {
      auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-wait',reason:'请先用 IDE Debug 选择关联原申请的身份并登记该实例'});
    } else if (!runs.length && policy.maxInstancesPerWorkflow>0) {
      try {
        const result=await launchDebug(context,directory,project,scope,'normal');
        if (result.instanceId) { auto.launched++; prior=await readDebugRuns(directory,project); }
        else auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-wait', reason:result.reason || result.status});
      } catch(error) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'technical-failure',reason:redactDebugText(error.message)}); }
    }
    for (const run of (prior?.runs ?? []).filter(r=>r.origin==='automatic-debug')) {
      try {
        let pages=await matchingPages(context,project,run.instanceId);
        if (pages.length!==1) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'unverified',reason:'缺少唯一已登记实例页面'}); continue; }
        const page=pages[0].page; auto.resumed++;
        for(let i=0;i<12;i++) {
          let state=await readDebugStep(page,project,run.instanceId);
          const modeEvidence=await verifyDebugInstance(page,project,state);
          await appendDebugEvent(directory,project,run.instanceId,{kind:'debug-mode-verification',state,modeEvidence});
          if(state.status!==1 || !state.executable) {
            const tasks=await debugTaskLinks(page,project,run.instanceId);
            if(tasks.length!==1) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-wait',reason:`待办数量为 ${tasks.length}，未自动选择`}); break; }
            const result=await resumeDebugTask(page,directory,project,{instanceId:run.instanceId,scope,step:tasks[0].step});
            state=result.state;
          }
          await captureDebugStep(page,directory,project,run.instanceId);
          const action=selectAutomaticAction(state.actions ?? []);
          if(!policy.allowNormalWorkflowActions || !action) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'unverified',reason:'无唯一普通自动推进动作'}); break; }
          const applied=await applyWorkflowInputs(page,project,state,configuredInputs);
          const missing=await missingRequired(page);
          if(missing.length) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-validation',reason:`必填字段待填写：${missing.join('、')}`}); break; }
          const latest=await readDebugRuns(directory,project);
          const events=latest?.runs.find(r=>r.instanceId===run.instanceId)?.events ?? [];
          if(!mayRetryAction(events,state.flowStepId,applied.fingerprint)) {
            auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-wait',reason:'此步骤已有动作记录，避免重复提交'}); break;
          }
          if (applied.fingerprint) await appendDebugEvent(directory,project,run.instanceId,{kind:'input-snapshot',flowStepId:state.flowStepId,fields:applied.fields,fingerprint:applied.fingerprint});
          const result=await actDebugStep(page,directory,project,{instanceId:run.instanceId,scope,label:action.label});
          if(!result.submitted || result.http!==200 || result.errno!==0) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'business-validation',reason:'动作未获业务成功确认'}); break; }
          auto.steps++;
        }
      } catch(error) { auto.blocks.push({kind:'technical-failure',reason:redactDebugText(error.message)}); }
    }
  } else if(callbackBlocked) auto.blocks.push({kind:'policy',reason:'配置禁止调用现有流程回调'});
  const summary=runtimeSummary(await readDebugRuns(directory,project));
  if(summary.instances) debug={...debug,selectedMode:'debug',visitedNodes:summary.observedNodes,simulatedRoles:summary.roles,verifiedPaths:summary.verifiedPaths};
  let front={attempted:false,reason:'后台 Debug 技术可用，优先保留 Debug 证据'};
  if(policy.fallbackToFrontend && (availability.selectedMode==='front' || callbackBlocked ||
      (auto.launched===0 && !runs.length && auto.blocks.some(b=>b.kind==='technical-failure')))) {
    let stages,options;
    try { stages=await captureStagePages(context,directory,project); } catch { stages={captured:0,reason:'前台欢迎页补采未完成'}; }
    try { options=await collectLiveOptions(context,directory,project,process.env.INFOPLUS_FORM_URL); } catch { options={pages:0,captured:0,reason:'前台选项补采未完成'}; }
    front={attempted:true,stages,options};
  }
  await saveDebugProbe(directory,project,{...debug,front,auto});
  return {debug,front,auto};
}

=== END src/online-evidence.mjs
=== src/option-evidence.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, rename, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { isChoiceField, mergeOptions } from './field-options.mjs';

export const optionEvidence = 'raw/field-option-observations.json';
export const reviewedOptionEvidence = 'field-options-reviewed.json';
const fieldIdPattern = /^[\w.-]{1,128}$/u;
const endpoint = /^\/infoplus\/(?:[\w-]+\/)*suggest\/?$/i;
const fieldKeys = ['fieldName', 'field', 'fieldId', 'column', 'binding'];
const viewKeys = ['viewId', 'formViewId', 'templateId', 'formTemplateId'];
export const isSuggest = url => endpoint.test(url.pathname);

function parameters(request) {
  const params = Object.fromEntries(new URL(request.url).searchParams);
  const post = request.postData;
  if (!post?.text || post.text.length > 32768) return params;
  try {
    const type = post.mimeType?.split(';')[0].trim();
    const body = type === 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' ? Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(post.text)) :
      type === 'application/json' ? JSON.parse(post.text) : {};
    return { ...params, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(body ?? {}).filter(([, v]) =>
      typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number')) };
  } catch { return params; }
}

function validOptions(options, allowUnknownValue = false) {
  return Array.isArray(options) && options.length <= 500 && options.every(option => option &&
    (allowUnknownValue && option.value === null || ['string', 'number'].includes(typeof option.value)) &&
    typeof option.label === 'string' &&
    String(option.value).length <= 128 && option.label.trim().length > 0 && option.label.length <= 200 &&
    !/[\r\n\x00-\x1f]/.test(String(option.value) + option.label));
}

function suggestData(content) {
  if (!content?.text || content.text.length > 2000000) return;
  let data;
  try {
    const text = content.encoding === 'base64' ? Buffer.from(content.text, 'base64').toString('utf8') : content.text;
    data = JSON.parse(text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  } catch { return; }
  if (data?.errno != null && ![0, '0'].includes(data.errno) || data?.success === false) return;
  const envelope = data?.entities?.length === 1 ? data.entities[0] : undefined;
  const [shape, rows] = [
    ['array', data], ['entities', data?.entities], ['items', data?.items], ['data', data?.data],
    ['data.items', data?.data?.items], ['entities[0].items', envelope?.items],
    ['entities[0].rows', envelope?.rows], ['entities[0].data', envelope?.data],
  ].find(([, items]) => Array.isArray(items) && items.length &&
    items.every(row => row?.codeId != null && row?.codeName != null)) ?? [];
  if (!rows || rows.length > 500) return;
  const options = rows.map(row => ({ value: row.codeId, label: row.codeName }));
  if (!validOptions(options)) return;
  const total = [data?.total, data?.data?.total, envelope?.total].find(value =>
    Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= rows.length);
  return { options: mergeOptions(options), shape, total };
}

export function parseSuggestResponse(content) {
  return suggestData(content)?.options;
}

async function optional(path) {
  try { return JSON.parse((await readFile(path, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
}

export async function readFieldIndex(directory, network) {
  const item = network?.captured?.findLast(row => row.kind === 'fields');
  if (!item || basename(item.file) !== item.file) return { fields: [] };
  const source = `raw/network/${item.file}`;
  const data = await optional(join(directory, source));
  return { source, fields: (data?.fields ?? []).map(row => ({ ...row, source })) };
}

export async function readOptionEvidence(directory, project) {
  const results = [];
  for (const file of [optionEvidence, reviewedOptionEvidence]) {
    const data = await optional(join(directory, file));
    if (data?.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId || data?.version !== project.version ||
        !Array.isArray(data?.observations)) continue;
    data.observations.forEach((item, index) => {
      if (!fieldIdPattern.test(item.fieldId) ||
          (item.options && !validOptions(item.options, file === reviewedOptionEvidence))) return;
      results.push({ ...item, file, source: `${file}#/observations/${index}` });
    });
  }
  return results;
}

export async function saveOptionEvidence(directory, project, observations) {
  if (!observations.length) return { added: 0 };
  const file = join(directory, optionEvidence);
  const previous = await optional(file);
  const matching = previous?.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId && previous?.version === project.version;
  const kept = matching ? previous.observations : [];
  const unique = new Map(kept.map(item => [JSON.stringify(item), item]));
  for (const item of observations) unique.set(JSON.stringify(item), item);
  const added = unique.size - kept.length;
  if (added) {
    await mkdir(join(directory, 'raw'), { recursive: true });
    const temp = `${file}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;
    try {
      await writeFile(temp, JSON.stringify({
        definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId, version: project.version, observations: [...unique.values()],
      }, null, 2), { flag: 'wx' });
      await rename(temp, file);
    } finally { await rm(temp, { force: true }); }
  }
  return { added };
}

export function matchSuggest(entry, project, fields, interaction, pageBelongsToProject = false) {
  const url = new URL(entry.request.url);
  if (url.origin !== new URL(project.source).origin || !isSuggest(url) ||
      !['GET', 'POST'].includes(entry.request.method) || entry.response.status < 200 || entry.response.status >= 300) return;
  const params = parameters(entry.request);
  if (params.workflowDefinitionId && params.workflowDefinitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId) return;
  const explicit = fieldKeys.map(key => params[key]).filter(value => typeof value === 'string');
  const field = fields.find(item => explicit.includes(item.id) || (item.uuid && explicit.includes(item.uuid)));
  if (explicit.length && !field || field && interaction && field.id !== interaction.fieldId) return;
  const fieldId = field?.id ?? interaction?.fieldId;
  if (!fieldId || !fields.some(item => item.id === fieldId)) return;
  const response = suggestData(entry.response.content);
  if (!response) return;
  const { options, shape, total } = response;
  // Responses lacking a binding must also match the choices rendered by the clicked control.
  if (!field && !options.every(option => interaction?.labels.includes(option.label))) return;
  const views = new Set((project.views ?? []).map(view => view.id));
  const viewParams = viewKeys.map(key => params[key]).filter(value => typeof value === 'string' && value);
  const candidates = viewParams.filter(value => views.has(value));
  const verified = params.workflowDefinitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId || !!field?.uuid && explicit.includes(field.uuid);
  if (!interaction && !pageBelongsToProject && !candidates.length &&
      !verified) return;
  if (viewParams.length && !candidates.length) return;
  const viewId = interaction?.viewId ?? candidates[0];
  if (interaction?.viewId && candidates.some(value => value !== interaction.viewId)) return;
  const names = Object.keys(params).filter(key => /^[\w.-]{1,64}$/u.test(key) &&
    !/token|auth|session|cookie|password|secret/i.test(key)).sort();
  const query = ['q', 'term', 'keyword', 'query', 'search', 'prefix'].some(key => String(params[key] ?? '').trim());
  const table = ['codeTableId', 'tableName', 'codeTable', 'dictionary', ...(params.type === 'Code' ? ['code'] : [])]
    .map(key => params[key])
    .find(value => typeof value === 'string' && fieldIdPattern.test(value));
  return {
    fieldId, viewId, when: interaction?.when ?? [], options, kind: 'suggest',
    versionVerified: verified || !!interaction?.versionVerified,
    completeness: 'partial',
    request: { source: url.origin + url.pathname, method: entry.request.method, parameterNames: names,
      table, searchFiltered: query, responseShape: shape, total },
  };
}

export async function importOptionHar(file, directory, project, bundle) {
  const data = await optional(file);
  if (!Array.isArray(data?.log?.entries)) throw new Error('HAR 缺少 log.entries');
  const network = await optional(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', 'index.json'));
  const index = await readFieldIndex(directory, network);
  const fields = [
    ...index.fields.filter(row => !['User', 'Organize'].includes(row.type) && (row.type === 'Code' || isChoiceField(row))),
    ...(bundle?.fields ?? []).filter(field => isChoiceField(field) && !['User', 'Organize'].includes(field.apiType)),
  ];
  const entries = data.log.entries.filter(item => isSuggest(new URL(item.request.url)));
  const projectPageRefs = new Set((data.log.pages ?? []).filter(page =>
    typeof page.title === 'string' && page.title.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9_]+/).includes(project.code.toLowerCase()))
    .map(page => page.id));
  const observations = entries.map(entry => matchSuggest(entry, project, fields, undefined, projectPageRefs.has(entry.pageref)))
    .filter(Boolean);
  return { seen: entries.length, matched: observations.length, ...await saveOptionEvidence(directory, project, observations) };
}

=== END src/option-evidence.mjs
=== src/output-management.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, rename, open, cp } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve, join, sep } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

export function officialDirectory(code) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(code)) throw new Error('流程编号不能用于目录');
  return resolve(process.env.INFOPLUS_PRD_HOME || fileURLToPath(new URL('..',import.meta.url)),'output',code);
}

export async function prepareOfficial(input) {
  const source=resolve(input);
  // 隔离分析时保留在输入目录，禁止按 project.code 回写其他流程的正式目录。
  if (process.env.INFOPLUS_ISOLATED_OUTPUT === 'true' || !source.split(sep).includes('_verification')) return source;
  const project=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(source,'project.json'),'utf8'));
  const target=officialDirectory(project.code);
  if(source===target) return target;
  await mkdir(target,{recursive:true});
  try {
    const current=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(target,'project.json'),'utf8'));
    if(current.version!==project.version || current.workflowDefinitionId!==project.workflowDefinitionId) throw new Error('正式目录版本不同，需先核对迁移证据');
    // Existing canonical evidence is authoritative; never silently replace it with an old verification copy.
    return target;
  } catch(error) {if(error.code!=='ENOENT') throw error;}
  for(const name of ['project.json','raw','views','debug-evidence','reviewed-rules.json','field-options-reviewed.json','workflow-original.json','workflow-original.png','workflow-original.svg','workflow-map.json']) {
    try {await cp(join(source,name),join(target,name),{recursive:true});} catch(error){if(error.code!=='ENOENT') throw error;}
  }
  return target;
}

export async function writeWordAtomic(path, buffer) {
  if(buffer.length<100 || buffer.readUInt32LE(0)!==0x04034b50 || !buffer.includes(Buffer.from('word/document.xml'))) throw new Error('Word 内容校验失败，原文件保持不变');
  const pending=path+'.pending';
  await writeFile(pending,buffer);
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<6;attempt++) {
    try {
      const handle=await open(path,'r+').catch(error=>{if(error.code!=='ENOENT') throw error;});
      await handle?.close();
      await rename(pending,path);
      return path;
    } catch(error) {
      if(!['EBUSY','EPERM','EACCES'].includes(error.code)) throw error;
      if(attempt===5) throw new Error(`正式 Word 被占用，未更新：${path}；已保留同目录临时文件 ${pending}，解除占用后重新运行 generate 将自动安全替换。`);
      await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,1000));
    }
  }
}

=== END src/output-management.mjs
=== src/path-coverage.mjs
// Finite branch obligations, not exponential enumeration of all field combinations.
export function analyzePathCoverage(bundle) {
  const nodes=new Map(bundle.workflow.nodes.map(n=>[String(n.id),n]));
  const edges=bundle.workflow.transitions;
  const outgoing=id=>edges.filter(e=>String(e.source)===String(id));
  const ends=[...nodes.values()].filter(n=>!outgoing(n.id).length && n.type==='自动步骤').map(n=>String(n.id));
  function frontier(start) {
    const queue=[String(start)],seen=new Set(),result=[];
    while(queue.length && seen.size<=nodes.size) {
      const id=queue.shift();if(seen.has(id))continue;seen.add(id);
      const node=nodes.get(id);if(!node)continue;
      if(node.type==='办理'||ends.includes(id)){result.push({id,name:node.name,type:node.type});continue;}
      queue.push(...outgoing(id).map(e=>String(e.target)));
    }
    return result;
  }
  const runs=(bundle.debugRuns?.runs??[]).filter(r=>r.origin==='automatic-debug');
  const obligations=edges.filter(e=>e.source!==e.target && e.attributes?.hideOnForm!=='true').map(e=>{
    const source=nodes.get(String(e.source)),target=nodes.get(String(e.target));
    const evidence=[];
    const failures=[];
    for(const run of runs) for(const event of run.events) {
      if(String(event.action?.id??event.actionId)!==String(e.id))continue;
      const failure=event.kind==='technical-diagnostic'||event.kind==='identity-block'?event:
        event.responses?.find(r=>r.errno===22007&&/EVENT_MESSENGER_TIMEOUT/i.test(r.error||''));
      if(failure)failures.push({instanceId:run.instanceId,at:event.at,kind:event.kind==='identity-block'?'identity-block':'callback-timeout',errno:failure.errno,reason:failure.reason});
    }
    for(const run of runs) for(const event of run.events) {
      if(event.kind!=='action'||String(event.before?.nodeId)!==String(e.source))continue;
      const action=event.action;
      const id=typeof action==='object'?action.id:event.actionId;
      const label=typeof action==='object'?action.label:action;
      if(id!=null ? String(id)!==String(e.id) : label!==e.name || outgoing(e.source).filter(x=>x.name===label).length!==1)continue;
      if(event.responses?.some(r=>r.endpoint?.endsWith('/doAction')&&r.http===200&&r.errno===0))
        evidence.push({instanceId:run.instanceId,at:event.at,kind:'successful-action'});
      else if(event.submitted && !event.responses?.some(r=>r.endpoint?.endsWith('/doAction') && typeof r.errno==='number' && r.errno!==0) && run.events.some(later=>later.kind==='stage' && String(later.state.flowStepId)===String(event.nextRender) &&
        later.state.flowStepId!==event.before.flowStepId && frontier(e.target).some(n=>n.id===String(later.state.nodeId))))
        evidence.push({instanceId:run.instanceId,at:event.at,kind:'observed-next-step',note:'同实例后续页面已读取；不证明中间条件分支全部执行细节'});
    }
    return {id:String(e.id),source:String(e.source),target:String(e.target),name:`${source?.name}：${e.name} → ${target?.name}`,
      operation:e.name,kind:source?.type==='判断'?'条件分支':source?.type==='分流'?'并行分支':/退回|重新提交/.test(e.name)?'退回或重提':'节点操作',
      condition:e.condition||e.restrictScript||bundle.rules?.find(r=>r.id===e.source && r.kind==='判断')?.expression||'',conditionEvidence:e.evidence,nextHandling:frontier(e.target),
      status:evidence.length?'操作成功，后续路径需核对':failures.some(f=>f.kind==='identity-block')?'进入待办受阻，操作未执行':failures.length?'已尝试，受阻':'待验证',evidence,failures};
  });
  const instances=runs.map(run=>{
    const observations=run.events.flatMap(e=>e.after?[e.after]:e.state?[e.state]:e.before?[e.before]:[]);
    const current=observations.at(-1);
    const completed=[...new Set(observations.filter(s=>s.status===2).map(s=>String(s.nodeId)))];
    const identityBlock=run.events.at(-1)?.kind==='identity-block'?run.events.at(-1):undefined;
    const completedActions=run.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='after-action'&&e.completed);
    const pendingTasks=completedActions.at(-1)?.tasks??[];
    const pendingNode=identityBlock?nodes.get(String(identityBlock.nodeId)):undefined;
    const lastCompleted=completedActions.at(-1);
    const actualPendingFrontier=current?.status===2 && lastCompleted?.after.flowStepId===current.flowStepId && pendingTasks.length>0;
    const remaining=current&&!actualPendingFrontier?outgoing(pendingNode?.id??current.nodeId).filter(e=>e.source!==e.target).map(e=>({operation:e.name,target:String(e.target),next:frontier(e.target)})):[];
    const tail=run.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='action').at(-1);
    const response=tail?.responses?.findLast(r=>r.endpoint?.endsWith('/doAction'));
    const diagnostic=run.events.findLast(e=>e.kind==='technical-diagnostic');
    const technical=response?.http>=500 || response?.http===0 || /EVENT_MESSENGER_TIMEOUT|Read timed out/i.test(response?.error||'') ||
      diagnostic && String(diagnostic.nodeId)===String(current?.nodeId) && diagnostic.at>= (tail?.at||'');
    const queryBlocked=!technical && response?.http===200 && response.errno!==0 && /查询.{0,30}失败/.test(response.error??'');
    const business=!technical && !queryBlocked && response?.http===200 && typeof response.errno==='number' && response.errno!==0;
    const businessWaiting=business && /制作中|生成中|等待生成|等待.*办理|尚未就绪/.test(response.error??'');
    const terminal=current && ends.includes(String(current.nodeId)) && current.entryStatus===2 && !actualPendingFrontier;
    // A terminal neighbour proves remaining topology, not successful completion or every upstream rule.
    const closing=current && remaining.length>0 && remaining.every(e=>ends.includes(e.target));
    return {instanceId:run.instanceId,testPlan:run.events.find(e=>e.kind==='path-plan'),current,completedNodes:completed,remaining,
      pendingNode:pendingNode?.name||(actualPendingFrontier?pendingTasks.map(t=>t.name.trim()).join('、'):undefined),identityBlock:identityBlock?.reason,pendingTasks,
      completedActions:completedActions.map(e=>({operation:e.action.label,actionId:e.action.id,step:e.before.flowStepId,node:e.before.name,nextTasks:e.tasks??[]})),
      fieldComparisons:run.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='field-comparison'),
      materialChecks:run.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='material-check'),
      testPlans:run.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='path-plan'),
      reachedEnd:Boolean(terminal),status:terminal?'实例已完成':identityBlock?'待办身份未核实':technical?'系统故障':queryBlocked?'外部查询阻断，原因待核实':closing?'主要审批已到收尾，最终完成待验证':business?'业务条件阻断':'进行中',
      businessWaiting:businessWaiting?response.error:undefined,
      businessBlock:business&&!businessWaiting?response.error:undefined,queryBlock:queryBlocked?response.error:undefined,technicalFailure:technical?{http:response?.http??diagnostic?.http}:undefined,
      interpretation:closing?'当前节点的非自循环出口仅指向终点；不据此认定所有前序条件及完整路径已经验证。':undefined,
      unresolved:business||queryBlocked?'业务响应已确认，外部服务内部状态未取得；不能仅凭提示断言数据错误或服务故障。':undefined};
  });
  return {schemaVersion:2,definitionId:bundle.project.workflowDefinitionId,ends,obligations,instances,
    counting:'按非自循环、非隐藏连线统计有限路径验证项；不是完整起终点组合数。条件分支及并行汇合必须另有实测证据。',
    counts:{obligations:obligations.length,observedOperations:obligations.filter(o=>o.evidence.length).length,
      completedInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.reachedEnd).length,closingInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.status.startsWith('主要审批')).length,
      businessWaitingInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.businessWaiting).length,businessBlockedInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.businessBlock).length,queryBlockedInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.queryBlock).length,technicalBlockedInstances:instances.filter(i=>i.technicalFailure).length}};
}

=== END src/path-coverage.mjs
=== src/project-input.mjs
import { readdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { officialDirectory } from './output-management.mjs';

export function projectQuery(input) {
  const query=input.trim();
  return query.match(/^([A-Z]\d+)\s*(?:[:：]|$)/i)?.[1].toUpperCase() || query;
}

export async function findCachedProject(query, version=process.env.INFOPLUS_VERSION) {
  const output=dirname(officialDirectory('_'));
  const dirs=await readdir(output,{withFileTypes:true}).catch(error=>{
    if(error.code==='ENOENT')return [];
    throw error;
  });
  const matches=[];
  for(const dir of dirs.filter(dir=>dir.isDirectory()&&/^[A-Z]\d+$/i.test(dir.name))){
    if(/^[A-Z]\d+$/i.test(query)&&dir.name.toUpperCase()!==query.toUpperCase())continue;
    const root=join(output,dir.name);
    const candidates=[root];
    const entries=await readdir(root,{withFileTypes:true});
    for(const entry of entries)if(entry.isDirectory()&&/^\d{8}-\d{6}$/.test(entry.name))candidates.push(join(root,entry.name));
    for(const candidate of candidates){
      const metadata=await readFile(join(candidate,'project.json'),'utf8').then(JSON.parse,error=>{
        if(error.code!=='ENOENT')throw error;
      });
      if(!metadata)continue;
      if((!version||metadata.version===version) && [metadata.code,metadata.name,metadata.projectCode]
        .some(value=>String(value??'').toLowerCase()===query.toLowerCase()))matches.push(candidate);
      // The canonical project file is authoritative even when another version is requested.
      if(candidate===root)break;
    }
  }
  if(matches.length>1)throw new Error('缓存有多个匹配项目或版本，请使用编号并核对 INFOPLUS_VERSION');
  return matches[0];
}

=== END src/project-input.mjs
=== src/render.mjs
import { access, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { extname, join } from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';

const imageTypes = new Map([
  ['.png', 'image/png'], ['.jpg', 'image/jpeg'], ['.jpeg', 'image/jpeg'],
  ['.gif', 'image/gif'], ['.bmp', 'image/bmp'], ['.webp', 'image/webp'],
]);
const host = 'https://infoplus-preview.invalid';

export async function withRenderer(run) {
  const candidates = [
    process.env.INFOPLUS_CHROME,
    join(process.env.ProgramFiles ?? 'C:/Program Files', 'Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe'),
    join(process.env['ProgramFiles(x86)'] ?? 'C:/Program Files (x86)', 'Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe'),
  ].filter(Boolean);
  let executablePath;
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (await access(candidate).then(() => true, () => false)) {
      executablePath = candidate;
      break;
    }
  }
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath, timeout: 15000 });
  try {
    const context = await browser.newContext({
      javaScriptEnabled: false, serviceWorkers: 'block', acceptDownloads: false,
      viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 },
    });
    await run(async (html, destination, directory, members = [], options = {}) => {
      const page = await context.newPage();
      try {
        await page.route('**/*', async route => {
          const url = new URL(route.request().url());
          if (url.origin !== host) return route.abort();
          if (url.pathname === '/preview') {
            return route.fulfill({
              contentType: 'text/html; charset=utf-8', body: html,
              headers: { 'Content-Security-Policy':
                "default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; sandbox" },
            });
          }
          const name = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(1)).toLowerCase();
          const contentType = imageTypes.get(extname(name));
          if (!directory || !contentType || !members.includes(name)) return route.abort();
          return route.fulfill({ contentType, body: await readFile(join(directory, name)) });
        });
        await page.goto(host + '/preview', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 10000 });
        if (options.fitWorkflowSvg) return await fitWorkflowSvg(page, destination);
        const height = await page.locator('body').evaluate(el => el.scrollHeight);
        const width = await page.locator('body').evaluate(el => el.scrollWidth);
        if (height > 24000 || width > 10000 || height * width > 38000000) throw new Error('图片超过渲染上限');
        await page.screenshot({ path: destination, fullPage: true, timeout: 15000 });
      } finally {
        await page.close();
      }
    });
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

async function fitWorkflowSvg(page, destination) {
  const fitted = await page.locator('body > svg').evaluate(svg => {
    document.body.style.margin = '0';
    svg.style.display = 'block';
    svg.style.overflow = 'visible';
    const root = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = Infinity, top = Infinity, right = -Infinity, bottom = -Infinity;
    const selector = 'path,image,rect,circle,ellipse,polygon,polyline,line,text,foreignObject div,foreignObject span';
    for (const el of svg.querySelectorAll(selector)) {
      if (el.closest('defs') || getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') continue;
      if (el.closest('foreignObject') && (!el.textContent.trim() || el.children.length)) continue;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect.width && !rect.height) continue;
      left = Math.min(left, rect.left - root.left);
      top = Math.min(top, rect.top - root.top);
      right = Math.max(right, rect.right - root.left);
      bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom - root.top);
    }
    const pad = 24;
    const x = Math.floor(left) - pad, y = Math.floor(top) - pad;
    const width = Math.ceil(right) - x + pad, height = Math.ceil(bottom) - y + pad;
    if (![x,y,width,height].every(Number.isFinite) || width < 1 || height < 1 ||
        Math.max(width,height) > 10000 || width * height > 36000000) throw new Error('无法确定 IDE 画布完整边界');
    const scale = Math.min(3, 10000 / Math.max(width, height), Math.sqrt(36000000 / (width * height)));
    const pixels = { width: Math.floor(width * scale), height: Math.floor(height * scale) };
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `${x} ${y} ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute('width', String(pixels.width));
    svg.setAttribute('height', String(pixels.height));
    svg.removeAttribute('style');
    const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg);
    svg.style.display = 'block';
    return { svg: xml, bounds: { x, y, width, height }, pixels };
  });
  await page.setViewportSize(fitted.pixels);
  await page.screenshot({ path: destination, fullPage: false, timeout: 15000 });
  return fitted;
}

=== END src/render.mjs
=== src/scan.mjs
import { access, mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { importHarEntries, matchKind } from './har.mjs';
import { importXsn, importTemplateJson } from './xsn.mjs';
import { withRenderer } from './render.mjs';
import { collectEditorCanvas } from './workflow-original.mjs';
import { attachChrome } from './live-options.mjs';
import { probeDebug } from './debug-probe.mjs';
import { collectOnlineEvidence } from './online-evidence.mjs';

const pathSegment = value => {
  if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_-]{1,80}$/u.test(value) ||
      /^(?:con|prn|aux|nul|com[0-9¹²³]|lpt[0-9¹²³])$/iu.test(value)) {
    throw new Error('项目编号或版本无法作为缓存目录名');
  }
  return value;
};

function observeResponses(page, origin) {
  const pending = new Set();
  const entries = [];
  page.on('response', response => {
    const url = new URL(response.url());
    if (url.origin !== origin || !matchKind(url.pathname)) return;
    const promise = (async () => {
      let body;
      try { body = await response.body(); } catch { /* body unavailable */ }
      entries.push({
        request: { method: response.request().method(), url: url.href },
        response: {
          status: response.status(),
          content: body && body.length <= 32000000 ? { text: body.toString('base64'), encoding: 'base64' } : {},
        },
      });
    })();
    pending.add(promise);
    promise.finally(() => pending.delete(promise));
  });
  return { entries, drain: () => Promise.race([
    Promise.allSettled([...pending]),
    new Promise(resolveWait => { const timer = setTimeout(resolveWait, 8000); timer.unref(); }),
  ]) };
}

export async function scan(query, outRoot, { staticOnly = false, outputDirectory } = {}) {
  if (!process.env.INFOPLUS_IDE_URL) throw new Error('先设置 INFOPLUS_IDE_URL 为已获授权的 InfoPlus IDE 入口');
  const start = new URL(process.env.INFOPLUS_IDE_URL);
  if (start.protocol !== 'https:' || !start.pathname.includes('/ide/') || start.username || start.password) {
    throw new Error('INFOPLUS_IDE_URL 应是 HTTPS InfoPlus IDE 页面');
  }
  const { context, close } = await attachChrome();
  let page;
  let directory;
  try {
    page = await context.newPage();
    const network = observeResponses(page, start.origin);
    await page.goto(start.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 20000 });
    await page.locator('.fancytree-title').first().waitFor({ timeout: 85000 });
    if (new URL(page.url()).origin !== start.origin) throw new Error('登录后未返回指定的 InfoPlus 站点');
    const projectTitle = await page.title();
    const term = query.toLowerCase();
    if (!projectTitle.toLowerCase().includes(term)) {
      const titles = await page.locator('.fancytree-title').allTextContents();
      const candidates = [...new Set(titles.map(title => title.trim())
        .filter(title => /\([\w-]+\)$/.test(title) && title.toLowerCase().includes(term)))];
      if (candidates.length !== 1) throw new Error(`项目匹配到 ${candidates.length} 项，请使用唯一项目编号或名称`);
      await page.getByText(candidates[0], { exact: true }).click({ timeout: 8000 });
      await page.locator('a[href$="/editor"]').first().waitFor({ timeout: 10000 });
    }
    const projectPage = new URL(page.url());
    const name = await page.title();
    const projectCode = projectPage.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1);
    const code = name.match(/^([A-Z]\d+)[:：]/i)?.[1] ?? projectCode;
    const versions = await page.locator('a[href$="/editor"]').evaluateAll(links => links
      .filter(link => /^V-/.test(link.textContent.trim()))
      .map(link => ({
        name: link.textContent.trim().slice(2),
        path: link.getAttribute('href'),
        status: [...link.closest('tr')?.cells ?? []].map(cell => cell.innerText.trim()).find(text => text === '可用'),
      })));
    const selected = process.env.INFOPLUS_VERSION
      ? versions.find(version => version.name === process.env.INFOPLUS_VERSION)
      : versions.length === 1 ? versions[0]
        : versions.filter(version => version.status === '可用').length === 1
          ? versions.find(version => version.status === '可用') : undefined;
    if (!selected) {
      throw new Error(`正式版本需核实。请设置 INFOPLUS_VERSION。可见版本：${versions.map(version => version.name).join('、')}`);
    }
    const editor = new URL(selected.path, projectPage);
    if (editor.origin !== start.origin) throw new Error('编辑器不在指定站点');
    const workflowDefinitionId = editor.pathname.match(/\/project\/([^/]+)\/editor$/)?.[1];
    if (!workflowDefinitionId) throw new Error('未识别编辑器中的流程定义 ID');
    directory = outputDirectory || join(outRoot, pathSegment(code));
    const cached = await readFile(join(directory,'project.json'),'utf8').then(JSON.parse,error=>{
      if(error.code!=='ENOENT')throw error;
    });
    if(cached && (cached.version!==selected.name || cached.workflowDefinitionId!==workflowDefinitionId)) {
      throw new Error('目标版本与现有正式缓存不一致，请先核对版本与证据迁移');
    }
    await mkdir(join(directory, 'raw'), { recursive: true });
    await page.goto(editor.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 20000 });
    try { await collectEditorCanvas(page, directory); }
    catch { console.warn('Workflow 编辑器未提供可读取的 SVG，业务版将尝试使用已核对的缓存原图。'); }
    const viewLabel = page.getByText('Views', { exact: true });
    // The IDE loads its views table when the first view in the tree is selected.
    const viewsGroup = page.locator('li:has(> span > .fancytree-title:text-is("Views"))').first();
    const viewItems = viewsGroup.locator(':scope > ul > li .fancytree-title');
    const expandViews = async () => {
      // Collapsed fancytree nodes keep their children in the DOM but hidden.
      if (await viewItems.first().isVisible({ timeout: 1000 }).catch(() => false)) return;
      const expander = viewsGroup.locator(':scope > span > .fancytree-expander');
      if (await expander.count() === 1) await expander.click({ timeout: 5000 });
      else if (await viewLabel.count() === 1) await viewLabel.click({ timeout: 5000 });
      // Expanding navigates the IDE to its views route and re-renders the tree.
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    };
    // The XSN icon is a webfont glyph, so the anchor itself can be 0x0 and never "visible".
    const downloadRow = page.locator('tr:has(a[title="Download as XSN"])').first();
    for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      await expandViews();
      try { await viewItems.first().click({ timeout: 10000 }); } catch { /* route change replaces the node */ }
      try {
        await downloadRow.waitFor({ timeout: attempt < 2 ? 20000 : 45000 });
        break;
      } catch (error) {
        if (attempt >= 2) throw error;
        await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
      }
    }
    const views = await page.locator('tr').filter({ has: page.locator('a[title="Download as XSN"]') })
      .evaluateAll(rows => rows.map(row => ({
        id: row.cells[0].title, name: row.cells[0].innerText.trim(),
        created: row.cells[2].innerText, updated: row.cells[3].innerText,
        xsn: row.querySelector('a[title="Download as XSN"]').getAttribute('href'),
        json: row.querySelector('a[title="Download as JSON"]')?.getAttribute('href'),
      })));
    const project = {
      code, name, projectCode, version: selected.name, versionEvidence: selected.status,
      workflowDefinitionId, source: projectPage.origin + projectPage.pathname,
      editor: editor.origin + editor.pathname, expectedViews: views.length, views,
    };
    await writeFile(join(directory, 'project.json'), JSON.stringify(project, null, 2));
    await network.drain();
    await importHarEntries(network.entries, directory, project);
    const failures = [];
    const fieldsTitle = page.locator('.fancytree-title').filter({ hasText: /^Fields & Controls$/ });
    if (await fieldsTitle.count() === 1) {
      try { await fieldsTitle.click({ timeout: 5000 }); }
      catch { failures.push('Fields & Controls 打开失败'); }
    }
    await withRenderer(async render => {
      for (const view of views) {
        if (!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(view.id)) {
          failures.push(`「${view.name}」视图标识格式未知`);
          continue;
        }
        const xsnPath = join(directory, 'raw', `${view.id}.xsn`);
        for (const kind of ['xsn', 'json']) {
          try {
            if (!view[kind]) continue;
            const url = new URL(view[kind], editor);
            if (url.origin !== start.origin || matchKind(url.pathname) !== (kind === 'json' ? 'form' : 'xsn')) continue;
            if (kind === 'xsn' && await access(xsnPath).then(() => true, () => false)) continue;
            const response = await context.request.get(url.href, { timeout: 10000, maxRedirects: 0 });
            try {
              if (!response.ok()) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status()}`);
              const bytes = await response.body();
              if (bytes.length > 32000000) throw new Error('资源超过大小限制');
              if (kind === 'xsn') {
                if (bytes.toString('ascii', 0, 4) !== 'MSCF') throw new Error('下载内容不是 CAB');
                await writeFile(xsnPath, bytes, { flag: 'wx' });
              } else {
                network.entries.push({
                  request: { method: 'GET', url: url.href },
                  response: { status: response.status(), content: { text: bytes.toString('base64'), encoding: 'base64' } },
                });
              }
            } finally { await response.dispose(); }
          } catch {
            failures.push(`「${view.name}」${kind.toUpperCase()} 读取失败`);
          }
        }
        try { await importXsn(xsnPath, join(directory, 'views', view.id), render); }
        catch {
          const index = await importHarEntries(network.entries, directory, project);
          const template = index.captured.find(item => item.templateId === view.id &&
            item.kind === 'form' && item.source.endsWith('/json'));
          try {
            if (!template) throw new Error('无 JSON 模板');
            await importTemplateJson(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', template.file), join(directory, 'views', view.id), render);
          } catch { failures.push(`「${view.name}」模板解析失败`); }
        }
      }
    });
    await network.drain();
    await importHarEntries(network.entries, directory, project);
    await writeFile(join(directory, 'scan-issues.json'), JSON.stringify(failures, null, 2));
    if(!staticOnly){
      try {console.log(JSON.stringify(await collectOnlineEvidence(context,directory,project,await probeDebug(context,project))));}
      catch {console.warn('动态采集未完成，静态文件已保存');}
    }
    return directory;
  } finally {
    try { await page?.close(); } finally { await close(); }
  }
}


=== END src/scan.mjs
=== src/screenshot-evidence.mjs
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 真实 Debug 截图取证（通用）
 *
 * 将截图从「附录装饰」提升为一等证据：按节点采集完整页面、可读分段、
 * 底部操作按钮、特殊字段/成员控件，并与实例、身份、字段、按钮、来源和
 * 验证状态一起写入索引。历史步骤只读快照不增加新的已验证动作。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

export const screenshotSchemaVersion = 1;

export function pngInfo(file) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return null;
  const fd = fs.openSync(file, 'r');
  try {
    const header = Buffer.alloc(24);
    if (fs.readSync(fd, header, 0, 24, 0) < 24) return null;
    if (header.toString('hex', 0, 8) !== '89504e470d0a1a0a') return null;
    return { width: header.readUInt32BE(16), height: header.readUInt32BE(20), bytes: fs.statSync(file).size };
  } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
}

function hashFile(file) {
  return createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
}

async function shot(page, file, options = {}) {
  const base = { path: file, animations: 'allow', caret: 'hide', timeout: 45000, fullPage: false, ...options };
  try { await page.screenshot(base); }
  catch (error) {
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    await page.screenshot({ ...base, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 60000 });
  }
}

function safePart(value, fallback = 'node') {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim().replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '');
  return text || fallback;
}

export function nodeFolder(root, index, nodeId, nodeName) {
  return path.join(root, `${String(index).padStart(2, '0')}-${safePart(nodeName)}-${nodeId}`);
}

/** 关闭普通提示弹窗；业务错误弹窗保留给调用方单独取证。 */
export async function dismissNotice(page) {
  return page.evaluate(() => {
    const dialogs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog, .modal, [role=dialog]')]
      .filter(d => d.getClientRects().length);
    let closed = 0;
    for (const d of dialogs) {
      const text = (d.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      if (!/提示|注意|information|notice/i.test(text)) continue;
      const button = [...d.querySelectorAll('button, a')].find(b => /^(确定|确认|好|OK|Close|关闭)$/i.test((b.innerText || '').trim()));
      if (button) { button.click(); closed++; }
    }
    return closed;
  }).catch(() => 0);
}

/** 滚动整页，触发懒加载；历史快照只读，不点击任何办理动作。 */
export async function revealPage(page, { passes = 3 } = {}) {
  const metrics = await page.evaluate(() => ({ height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, viewport: innerHeight }));
  for (let i = 0; i <= passes; i++) {
    await page.evaluate(y => window.scrollTo(0, y), Math.round((metrics.height - metrics.viewport) * i / passes));
    await page.waitForTimeout(180);
  }
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
  await page.waitForTimeout(120);
  return await page.evaluate(() => ({ height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, viewport: innerHeight }));
}

function visibleSelector(selector) {
  return [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)].filter(e => e.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden');
}

/** 采集底部命令栏；找不到命令栏时退化为底部视口截图，并如实记录退化原因。 */
export async function captureActionButtons(page, file, options = {}) {
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.documentElement.scrollHeight));
  await page.waitForTimeout(250);
  const region = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const actions = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[name^="infoplus_action_"], #command_holder a, .commandBar a, .commandBar button')]
      .filter(e => e.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden');
    const text = actions.map(e => (e.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!actions.length) {
      return { found: false, labels: [], reason: '页面未暴露可见操作按钮（可能身份不匹配或命令栏由平台动态绘制）' };
    }
    const boxes = actions.map(e => e.getBoundingClientRect());
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.min(...boxes.map(b => b.left)) - 24);
    const right = Math.min(innerWidth, Math.max(...boxes.map(b => b.right)) + 24);
    const top = Math.max(0, Math.min(...boxes.map(b => b.top)) - 30);
    const bottom = Math.min(innerHeight, Math.max(...boxes.map(b => b.bottom)) + 30);
    return { found: true, labels: text, clip: { x: Math.floor(left), y: Math.floor(top), width: Math.floor(right - left), height: Math.floor(bottom - top) } };
  });
  const vp = page.viewportSize() || { width: 1275, height: 900 };
  const fallbackClip = { x: 0, y: Math.max(0, vp.height - 240), width: vp.width, height: Math.min(240, vp.height) };
  const clip = region.found && region.clip.width > 40 && region.clip.height > 30 ? region.clip : fallbackClip;
  try {
    await page.screenshot({ path: file, clip, animations: 'disabled', caret: 'hide', timeout: 45000 });
  } catch (error) {
    // 长页面中滚动后截图偶发超时：回到顶部再取底部视口，仍失败则保留明确原因。
    try {
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
      await page.waitForTimeout(200);
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.documentElement.scrollHeight));
      await page.waitForTimeout(300);
      await page.screenshot({ path: file, clip: fallbackClip, animations: 'allow', caret: 'hide', timeout: 45000 });
      region.fallbackSucceeded = true;
    } catch (retryError) {
      region.found = false;
      region.reason = `底部按钮截图失败：${String(retryError.message || '').slice(0, 120)}`;
    }
  }
  return region;
}

/** 采集可辨识的页面分段，避免把长页面压缩到 Word 中无法阅读。 */
export async function captureSegments(page, directory, prefix, options = {}) {
  const maxSegments = Number(options.maxSegments || 6);
  const info = await page.evaluate(() => ({ height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, viewport: innerHeight }));
  const maxScroll = Math.max(0, info.height - info.viewport);
  const files = [];
  if (info.height > info.viewport + 50) {
    const step = Math.max(400, info.viewport - 80);
    const positions = [];
    for (let y = 0; y < info.height && positions.length < maxSegments; y += step) {
      const pos = Math.min(y, maxScroll);
      if (positions.includes(pos)) continue;
      positions.push(pos);
      if (pos === maxScroll) break;
    }
    for (const [i, pos] of positions.entries()) {
      await page.evaluate(p => window.scrollTo(0, p), pos);
      await page.waitForTimeout(120);
      const file = path.join(directory, `${prefix}-segment-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.png`);
      await shot(page, file);
      files.push({ file, scrollY: pos });
    }
  }
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
  return files;
}

/** 特殊字段/成员控件局部图。只截图真实存在的控件，不为凑数量制造条件。 */
export async function captureSpecialFields(page, directory, prefix, options = {}) {
  const candidates = await page.evaluate(limit => {
    const fields = Object.values(window.$$?.entity?.fields ?? {});
    return fields.filter(f => f.bound && (f.fieldChanging === true || f.type === 'User' || f.type === 'Organize' || f.notNull === true))
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map(f => ({ id: f.name, name: f.label || f.description || f.name, type: f.type,
        reason: [f.fieldChanging ? '条件/联动字段' : '', f.type === 'User' || f.type === 'Organize' ? '成员或组织控件' : '', f.notNull ? '必填字段' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('、'),
        settings: f.settings && { userFilters: f.settings.userFilters, userTraversal: f.settings.userTraversal } }));
  }, Number(options.limit || 6));
  const items = [];
  for (const field of candidates) {
    if (!/^\w+$/.test(field.id)) continue;
    const control = page.locator(`[name="${field.id}"], [name^="${field.id}_"], [name="radioList-${field.id}"]`).filter({ visible: true }).first();
    let target = null;
    if (await control.count()) {
      const row = control.locator('xpath=ancestor::tr[1]').filter({ visible: true }).first();
      target = await row.count() ? row : control;
    }
    // 历史快照常把字段渲染成只读文本；此时用字段标签定位真实表格行，仍属于真实页面证据。
    if (!target && field.name) {
      const textRow = page.locator('tr').filter({ hasText: field.name }).filter({ visible: true }).first();
      if (await textRow.count()) target = textRow;
    }
    if (!target) continue;
    const file = path.join(directory, `${prefix}-field-${field.id}.png`);
    const clip = await target.boundingBox().catch(() => null);
    if (!clip) continue;
    try {
      await shot(page, file, { clip });
      items.push({ ...field, file });
    } catch { /* 局部不可截时保留整页与按钮证据 */ }
  }
  return items;
}

const MASK_SELECTOR = 'input,textarea,select,.select2-selection__rendered,.infoplus_labelControlContainer,.infoplus_labelControl,[id*=entrust],[id*=history],[id*=History],[id*=user],[id*=User],.form_remark_title,.color_b2';

/** 单节点完整取证：原始证据 + 脱敏文档图 + 分段 + 按钮 + 特殊字段 + 元数据。 */
export async function captureNodeScreenshots(page, meta, options = {}) {
  const root = options.root;
  const folder = nodeFolder(root, meta.index, meta.nodeId, meta.nodeName);
  const originalDir = path.join(folder, 'original');
  fs.mkdirSync(originalDir, { recursive: true });
  const prefix = safePart(meta.nodeName);
  await dismissNotice(page);
  const metrics = await revealPage(page);

  const rawFull = path.join(originalDir, 'full-page-original.png');
  const maskedFull = path.join(folder, 'full-page.png');
  await shot(page, rawFull, { fullPage: true });
  await shot(page, maskedFull, { fullPage: true, mask: [page.locator(MASK_SELECTOR)], maskColor: '#dce3eb' });

  const segments = await captureSegments(page, folder, prefix, { maxSegments: options.maxSegments });
  const actionFile = path.join(folder, 'action-buttons.png');
  const actionRegion = await captureActionButtons(page, actionFile);
  const specials = await captureSpecialFields(page, folder, prefix, { limit: options.specialLimit || 6 });

  const images = [];
  const seenHashes = new Set();
  const add = (record) => {
    const info = pngInfo(record.file);
    if (!info) return;
    const digest = hashFile(record.file);
    if (seenHashes.has(digest)) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(record.file); } catch {}
      return;
    }
    seenHashes.add(digest);
    images.push({ ...record, ...info, sha256: digest });
  };
  add({ category: 'full-page', sourceVariant: 'original', file: rawFull, purpose: '原始证据（按项目权限保存，不直接插入文档）' });
  add({ category: 'full-page', sourceVariant: 'masked', file: maskedFull, purpose: '文档展示：完整页面结构，字段值与身份信息已遮盖' });
  for (const [i, seg] of segments.entries()) add({ category: 'page-segment', sequence: i + 1, scrollY: seg.scrollY,
    file: seg.file, purpose: '文档展示：长页面分段，保证字段名称可读' });
  add({ category: 'action-buttons', sourceVariant: 'masked', file: actionFile,
    labels: actionRegion.labels || [], detection: actionRegion.found ? 'command-bar' : 'bottom-viewport-fallback',
    purpose: '文档展示：节点底部实际业务操作按钮' });
  for (const field of specials) add({ category: 'special-field', fieldId: field.id, fieldName: field.name,
    reason: field.reason, settings: field.settings, file: field.file,
    purpose: '文档展示：特殊字段、成员控件或必填项局部证据' });

  return {
    ...meta, folder, metrics, images,
    buttonsDetected: actionRegion.labels || [],
    buttonDetectionNote: actionRegion.reason || '已定位命令栏按钮',
    pageChecks: { nodeNamePresent: await page.evaluate(name => (document.body.innerText || '').includes(name), meta.nodeName).catch(() => false) },
  };
}

/**
 * 从同一实例的实时完整截图中裁剪底部按钮区。
 * 用于历史快照不暴露业务按钮时，避免用平台工具栏冒充业务操作按钮。
 */
export async function cropBottomRegion(browser, sourceFile, targetFile, options = {}) {
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  try {
    await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(sourceFile)).href, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 20000 });
    const dataUrl = await page.evaluate(async ({ height, excludeBottom }) => {
      const img = document.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) throw new Error('源图不可读取');
      await img.decode();
      const cropHeight = Math.min(height, img.naturalHeight);
      const y = Math.max(0, img.naturalHeight - cropHeight - excludeBottom);
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = img.naturalWidth;
      canvas.height = cropHeight;
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, y, img.naturalWidth, cropHeight, 0, 0, img.naturalWidth, cropHeight);
      return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    }, { height: Number(options.height || 420), excludeBottom: Number(options.excludeBottom || 0) });
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.resolve(targetFile)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(targetFile, Buffer.from(String(dataUrl).split(',')[1] || '', 'base64'));
    return pngInfo(targetFile);
  } finally { await page.close().catch(() => {}); }
}

/** 质量门禁：存在、可打开、尺寸、重复、DOM 匹配；不声称完成 OCR。 */
export function qualityCheck(screenshots) {
  const seen = new Map();
  const issues = [];
  const rows = [];
  for (const shot of screenshots) {
    for (const image of shot.images) {
      const relative = path.relative(path.dirname(shot.folder), image.file).replace(/\\/g, '/');
      const minWidth = image.category === 'special-field' ? 220 : image.category === 'action-buttons' ? 300 : 600;
      const minHeight = image.category === 'special-field' ? 40 : image.category === 'action-buttons' ? 60 : 300;
      const checks = {
        exists: Boolean(image.width),
        readableSize: image.width >= minWidth && image.height >= minHeight,
        nonEmpty: image.bytes > (image.category === 'special-field' ? 2000 : 10000),
      };
      if (seen.has(image.sha256)) {
        checks.unique = false;
        issues.push({ node: shot.nodeName, file: relative, issue: '与已有截图内容完全相同', duplicateOf: seen.get(image.sha256) });
      } else {
        checks.unique = true;
        seen.set(image.sha256, `${shot.nodeName}/${relative}`);
      }
      if (shot.pageChecks?.nodeNamePresent === false && image.category === 'full-page') {
        checks.nodeMatched = false;
        issues.push({ node: shot.nodeName, file: relative, issue: '页面文本未匹配节点名称' });
      } else checks.nodeMatched = true;
      const ok = Object.values(checks).every(Boolean);
      rows.push({ nodeId: shot.nodeId, nodeName: shot.nodeName, category: image.category,
        file: path.relative(path.dirname(shot.folder), image.file).replace(/\\/g, '/'),
        width: image.width, height: image.height, bytes: image.bytes, checks, ok });
    }
  }
  return { ok: issues.length === 0, issues, rows };
}

export function writeScreenshotIndex(root, screenshots, quality, extra = {}) {
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  const index = {
    schemaVersion: screenshotSchemaVersion,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...extra,
    statistics: {
      nodes: screenshots.length,
      fullPage: screenshots.filter(s => s.images.some(i => i.category === 'full-page' && i.sourceVariant === 'masked')).length,
      actionButtons: screenshots.filter(s => s.images.some(i => i.category === 'action-buttons')).length,
      specialFields: screenshots.reduce((n, s) => n + s.images.filter(i => i.category === 'special-field').length, 0),
      images: screenshots.reduce((n, s) => n + s.images.length, 0),
    },
    nodes: screenshots.map(shot => ({...shot,
      folder: path.relative(path.dirname(root), shot.folder).replace(/\\/g, '/'),
      images: shot.images.map(image => {
        const relative = path.relative(path.dirname(root), image.file);
        if (relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) throw Error('截图不属于当前输出目录');
        return {...image, file:relative.replace(/\\/g, '/')};
      })
    })),
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), JSON.stringify(index, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'screenshot-quality.json'), JSON.stringify(quality, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  const lines = ['# 真实 Debug 截图索引', '',
    `实例：\`${extra.instanceId || '—'}\`；来源：${extra.source || '—'}`, '',
    `节点 ${index.statistics.nodes} 个；完整页面 ${index.statistics.fullPage} 个；底部按钮 ${index.statistics.actionButtons} 个；特殊字段 ${index.statistics.specialFields} 个；图片 ${index.statistics.images} 张。`, '',
    '| 节点 | 来源 | 完整页面 | 分段 | 底部按钮 | 特殊字段 | 实际按钮 | 主要文档用途 |',
    '|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|'];
  for (const s of screenshots) {
    const count = category => s.images.filter(i => i.category === category).length;
    lines.push(`| ${s.nodeName} [${s.nodeId}] | ${s.pageType || '—'} | ${count('full-page') ? '有' : '无'} | ${count('page-segment')} | ${count('action-buttons') ? '有' : '无'} | ${count('special-field')} | ${(s.buttonsDetected || []).join(' / ') || '未暴露'} | ${path.relative(path.dirname(root), s.folder).replace(/\\/g, '/')} |`);
  }
  lines.push('', '完整页面原始图保存在各节点 `original/` 子目录；文档使用脱敏图。历史快照只证明页面结构，不增加新的已验证动作。');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.md'), lines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf-8');
  return index;
}

=== src/screenshot-quality.mjs
export function screenshotValue(image, page = {}) {
  const reject = (category, reason) => ({category, eligible:false, reason});
  if (image.sourceVariant === 'original') return reject('E','内部原始证据，不用于文档');
  if (/Required request parameter|CDP.*error|ERR_CONNECTION|模拟登录异常/i.test(page.errorText || image.errorText || '')) return reject('D','调试或请求错误');
  if (image.category === 'page-segment') return reject('E','旧滚动视口分段，未经完整内容核验');
  if (image.width < 600 || image.height < 45) return reject('E','分辨率不足');
  if (page.obscured || image.obscured) return reject('E','存在遮挡');
  if (!image.nodeId && !page.nodeId) return reject('E','未关联业务节点');
  if (image.category === 'full-page') {
    if (!page.complete || !page.businessContent) return reject('E','完整性或有效业务内容未核实');
    return {category:'A',eligible:true,reason:'完整业务表单区域，布局测量已核对'};
  }
  if (image.category === 'validation') return image.rule ? {category:'C',eligible:true,reason:image.rule} : reject('E','未关联业务规则');
  if (image.category === 'action-buttons' && !image.labels?.length) return reject('E','未识别实际业务按钮');
  if (!image.parentImage && !image.reviewed && image.detection !== 'live-full-page-bottom-crop') {
    return reject('E','未核实局部图来源');
  }
  return {category:'B',eligible:true,reason:image.title || image.purpose || '已关联业务局部证据'};
}

export function eligibleScreenshot(image) { return image.quality?.eligible === true && ['A','B','C'].includes(image.quality.category); }

=== src/stage-field-differences.mjs
import { memberScopeDescription } from './debug-runtime.mjs';
// Compare only recorded navigation edges within one Debug instance. A missing
// observation is not proof that a field does not exist in the template.
export function analyzeStageFields(data) {
  const stages = [], differences = [], byField = new Map();
  for (const run of data?.runs ?? []) {
    if (run.origin !== 'automatic-debug') continue;
    const latest = new Map();
    for (const e of run.events) if (e.kind === 'stage') latest.set(e.state.flowStepId, e);
    for (const e of latest.values()) {
      stages.push({ instanceId: run.instanceId, nodeId: e.state.nodeId, step: e.state.flowStepId,
        name: e.state.name.trim(), role: e.role, fields: e.fields, screenshot: e.screenshot });
      for (const field of e.fields) {
        if (!byField.has(field.id)) byField.set(field.id, []);
        byField.get(field.id).push({ field, stage: e.state.name.trim(), nodeId: e.state.nodeId,
          screenshot: e.screenshot, scope: e.memberScopes?.find(s => s.fieldId === field.id) });
      }
    }
    for (const e of run.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'resume')) {
      const from = latest.get(e.before.flowStepId), to = latest.get(e.after.flowStepId);
      if (!from || !to) continue;
      const a = new Map(from.fields.map(f => [f.id, f])), b = new Map(to.fields.map(f => [f.id, f]));
      for (const id of new Set([...a.keys(), ...b.keys()])) {
        const x = a.get(id), y = b.get(id), changes = [];
        if (!x || !y) changes.push(!x ? '前节点未采集到绑定，当前节点有绑定' : '当前节点未采集到绑定');
        else {
          if (x.visible !== y.visible) changes.push(y.visible ? '当前观测显示' : '当前观测隐藏');
          if (x.readOnly !== y.readOnly) changes.push(y.readOnly === true ? '当前只读' : y.readOnly === false ? '当前可编辑' : '编辑权限未明确');
          if (x.required !== y.required) changes.push(y.required ? '当前配置必填' : '当前配置非必填');
        }
        if (changes.length) differences.push({ instanceId: run.instanceId, fieldId: id,
          from: from.state.name.trim(), to: to.state.name.trim(), changes,
          cause: '仅确认节点观测差异；角色、业务条件或前序数据的因果关系未单独验证' });
      }
    }
  }
  const special = [];
  for (const [id, rows] of byField) {
    const visible = rows.filter(r => r.field.visible);
    if (!visible.length) continue;
    const states = new Set(rows.map(r => JSON.stringify([r.field.visible,r.field.readOnly,r.field.required])));
    if (!rows.some(r => r.scope?.settings?.userFilters || r.field.fieldChanging) && states.size < 2) continue;
    for (const row of visible) {
      if (special.some(s => s.fieldId === id && s.stage === row.stage)) continue;
      special.push({ fieldId: id, name: row.field.name, stage: row.stage,
        source: row.scope ? `人员选择服务；${memberScopeDescription(row.scope.settings)} 组织目录来源及上下级关系未单独验证。` :
          row.field.type === 'Code' ? '选项来源以已有字典或接口证据为准。' : '当前节点表单配置；自动带出来源未确认。',
        rule: `当前观测显示；${row.field.readOnly === true ? '只读' : row.field.readOnly === false ? '可编辑' : '编辑权限待确认'}；${row.field.required ? '配置必填，条件必填边界待核对' : '配置非必填'}。${states.size > 1 ? '跨节点状态存在差异，具体触发原因不能仅凭阶段变化推断。' : ''}`,
        screenshot: row.screenshot });
    }
  }
  return { schemaVersion: 2, stages, differences, special, exclusiveObservedFields: [...byField].filter(([,rows]) =>
    new Set(rows.filter(r => r.field.visible).map(r => r.nodeId)).size === 1).length,
    exclusiveMeaning: '仅在一个已观察节点显示，非全流程专属字段结论' };
}

=== src/stage-pages.mjs
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { DOMParser } from '@xmldom/xmldom';

export const stageAnalysisVersion = 1;
export const stageManifest = viewId => `views/${viewId}/live-stage.json`;
export const stageProfileUrl = code => new URL(`../config/business-profiles/${code}.json`, import.meta.url);
const optional = path => readFile(path, 'utf8').catch(error => {
  if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
});
const clean = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
const unique = values => [...new Set(values.filter(Boolean))];

export async function stageProfile(project) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(project.code)) return;
  const raw = await optional(stageProfileUrl(project.code));
  const profile = raw && JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  if (profile?.version === project.version && profile?.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId) return profile;
}

function classification(start, display, print, view) {
  const context = [view.name, ...display.map(node => node.name)].join(' ');
  if (start || /欢迎|办理须知|办事说明|办事指南|业务说明|申请须知/.test(view.name)) return '办事说明类';
  if (/批件下载|办理结果|办结|打印|回执|证书/.test(view.name) || !display.length && print.length) return '结果展示类';
  if (/身份选择|选择页面|申请类型选择|人员选择|单位选择|信息选择/.test(context)) return '信息选择类';
  if (/审核|审批|复核|会签|审查|办理意见|授权确认|党委确认/.test(context)) return '审批办理类';
  if (/填写|填报|填表|修改|申请|主表单/.test(context) || view.packageViews.some(panel => panel.controls?.length)) return '申请填写类';
  return '待确认';
}

function splitInstructions(text) {
  const sections = [];
  const headings = [
    ['申请条件', /申请条件|办理条件|申请资格|受理条件|适用范围/],
    ['适用人员', /适用人员|适用对象|服务对象|申请对象|办理对象/],
    ['办理材料', /办理材料|申请材料|所需材料|提交材料|材料清单/],
    ['办理步骤', /办理流程|办理步骤|办理方式|申办流程|申请流程/],
    ['注意事项', /办理须知|注意事项|温馨提示|特别提醒|填报须知/],
  ];
  let current;
  for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
    const heading = headings.find(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(line) &&
      (line.length <= 30 || /^(?:[一二三四五六七八九十\d]+[、.．]\s*)?(?:申请条件|办理条件|适用范围|适用人员|办理材料|办理流程|办理须知|注意事项)[：:]/.test(line)));
    if (heading) {
      current = { kind: heading[0], lines: [] };
      sections.push(current);
    }
    if (!current) {
      current = { kind: '页面说明', lines: [] };
      sections.push(current);
    }
    if (line.trim()) current.lines.push(line);
  }
  const excerpts = [
    ['申请条件', /(?:适用于|限于|出访前.*申请|不得事后补办)/],
    ['适用人员', /(?:仅限|适用人员|适用对象|外籍教职工.*申请)/],
    ['办理材料', /(?:上传|提交|携带|准备).*(?:材料|附件|邀请函|原件|证明|说明)/],
  ];
  for (const [kind, pattern] of excerpts) {
    if (sections.some(section => section.kind === kind)) continue;
    const lines = text.split('\n').filter(line => pattern.test(line));
    if (lines.length) sections.push({ kind, lines });
  }
  return sections.filter(section => section.lines.length);
}

async function staticDescription(directory, view) {
  const panel = view.packageViews.find(item => item.file && !/手机|mobile/i.test(item.name));
  if (!panel?.file || basename(panel.file) !== panel.file) return;
  const source = `views/${view.id}/source/${panel.file}`;
  const xml = await optional(join(directory, source));
  if (!xml || /<!DOCTYPE|<!ENTITY/i.test(xml)) return;
  let doc;
  try { doc = new DOMParser({ onError: () => {} }).parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml'); }
  catch { return; }
  const lines = [];
  const actions = [];
  let pending = '';
  const flush = () => { if (clean(pending)) lines.push(clean(pending)); pending = ''; };
  function walk(node) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3 || node.nodeType === 4) { pending += node.nodeValue; return; }
    if (node.nodeType !== 1 || /^(style|script|head|xsl:(?:attribute|comment|variable|param|value-of|output))$/i.test(node.tagName)) return;
    const block = /^(div|p|br|tr|li|h[1-6])$/i.test(node.tagName);
    if (block) flush();
    for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) walk(child);
    if (block) flush();
    if (/^(a|button)$/i.test(node.tagName)) {
      const label = clean(node.textContent);
      const href = URL.parse(node.getAttribute('href') ?? '');
      const address = href && /^(https?):$/.test(href.protocol) && !href.username && !href.password ? href.origin + href.pathname : undefined;
      if (label) actions.push({ label, kind: address ? '链接' : '按钮', address });
    }
  }
  walk(doc.documentElement);
  flush();
  return { text: lines.join('\n'), actions, source };
}

export async function buildStagePages(directory, project, workflow, topology, views, profile) {
  const bound = new Set(workflow.nodes.flatMap(node => [node.view, node.printView]).filter(Boolean));
  const starts = workflow.nodes.filter(node => node.attributes?.defaultInitial === 'true');
  const startNodes = starts.length ? starts : workflow.nodes.filter(node =>
    profile?.startNode ? node.id === profile.startNode : topology.entries.includes(node.id));
  const ordered = new Set([workflow.startView]);
  const queue = startNodes.slice();
  const seen = new Set();
  const nodes = new Map(workflow.nodes.map(node => [node.id, node]));
  const outgoing = new Map();
  for (const edge of workflow.transitions) {
    if (!outgoing.has(edge.source)) outgoing.set(edge.source, []);
    if (!/退回|返回|重新|刷新|否决/.test(edge.name)) outgoing.get(edge.source).push(edge);
  }
  for (const node of queue) {
    if (seen.has(node.id)) continue;
    seen.add(node.id);
    if (node.view) ordered.add(node.view);
    for (const edge of outgoing.get(node.id) ?? []) if (nodes.has(edge.target)) queue.push(nodes.get(edge.target));
  }
  for (const id of profile?.viewOrder ?? []) if (bound.has(id)) ordered.add(id);
  for (const view of views) if (bound.has(view.id)) ordered.add(view.id);
  for (const view of views) ordered.add(view.id);
  const viewMap = new Map(views.map(view => [view.id, view]));
  const stages = [];
  for (const id of ordered) {
    const view = viewMap.get(id);
    if (!view) continue;
    const start = workflow.startView === id;
    const display = workflow.nodes.filter(node => node.view === id);
    const print = workflow.nodes.filter(node => node.printView === id);
    const category = classification(start, display, print, view);
    const displayIds = new Set(display.map(node => node.id));
    const configuredActions = workflow.transitions.filter(edge => displayIds.has(edge.source)).map(edge => ({
      label: edge.name, from: nodes.get(edge.source)?.name, to: nodes.get(edge.target)?.name,
      nextView: nodes.get(edge.target)?.view || undefined, evidence: edge.evidence,
    }));
    const row = {
      viewId: id, name: view.name, category, binding: start ? '入口' : display.length ? '办理' : print.length ? '打印' : '模板',
      nodes: unique([...display, ...print].map(node => node.name)),
      staticScreenshot: view.screenshot, configuredActions,
      nextStages: start ? unique(startNodes.map(node => node.name)) : [],
      nextEvidence: start ? startNodes.map(node => node.evidence).filter(Boolean) : [],
    };
    if (category === '办事说明类') {
      const manifest = stageManifest(id);
      const raw = await optional(join(directory, manifest));
      let live;
      try { live = raw && JSON.parse(raw); }
      catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof SyntaxError)) throw error; }
      const match = live?.code === project.code && live?.version === project.version && live?.viewId === id &&
        live?.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId && /^live-stage-[a-f0-9-]+\.png$/i.test(live.screenshot ?? '');
      const description = match ? live : await staticDescription(directory, view);
      if (description) {
        const { title, text, actions, source } = description;
        Object.assign(row, { title, text, actions, source, instructionSections: splitInstructions(text ?? '') });
      }
      if (match) Object.assign(row, { screenshot: `views/${id}/${live.screenshot}`, screenshotSource: '前台完整截图', manifest });
      if (!row.screenshot) row.screenshotSource = 'XSN 静态预览';
    }
    stages.push(row);
  }
  return stages;
}

=== src/templates.mjs
import { copyFile, mkdir, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { constants } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { json } from './analyze.mjs';
import { withRenderer } from './render.mjs';
import { importTemplateJson, importXsn } from './xsn.mjs';

export async function importTemplates(sourceDirectory, versionDirectory) {
  const project = await json(join(versionDirectory, 'project.json'));
  const names = new Set((await readdir(sourceDirectory, { withFileTypes: true }))
    .filter(entry => entry.isFile()).map(entry => entry.name.toLowerCase()));
  const raw = join(versionDirectory, 'raw', 'templates');
  await mkdir(raw, { recursive: true });
  const result = { imported: [], unmatched: [], failed: [] };
  await withRenderer(async render => {
    for (const view of project.views) {
      if (!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(view.id)) throw new Error('视图 ID 格式错误');
      const keys = [view.id, view.name].filter(key => /^[^\\/:*?"<>|]+$/.test(key));
      const file = ['xsn', 'json'].flatMap(ext => keys.map(key => `${key}.${ext}`))
        .find(name => names.has(name.toLowerCase()));
      if (!file) {
        result.unmatched.push(view.name);
        continue;
      }
      const xsn = file.endsWith('.xsn');
      const saved = join(raw, `${view.id}.${xsn ? 'xsn' : 'json'}`);
      try {
        await copyFile(join(sourceDirectory, file), saved, constants.COPYFILE_EXCL).catch(error => {
          if (error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
        });
        const importer = xsn ? importXsn : importTemplateJson;
        await importer(saved, join(versionDirectory, 'views', view.id), render);
        result.imported.push(view.name);
      } catch {
        result.failed.push(view.name);
      }
    }
  });
  return result;
}
