=== src/workflow-inputs.mjs
import { readFile, mkdir, writeFile, rename } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

function validateInput(item) {
  return /^field\w+$/.test(item.fieldId ?? '') && typeof item.value === 'string' && !!item.value.trim() &&
    typeof item.fieldName === 'string' && !!item.fieldName && ['用户提供','历史实例','关联流程'].includes(item.source) &&
    ['待验证','已验证','失效'].includes(item.validationStatus) && Array.isArray(item.nodeIds) &&
    !!item.nodeIds.length && item.nodeIds.every(id => /^\d+$/.test(String(id))) &&
    (!item.requiredApplicant || (typeof item.requiredApplicant.account === 'string' &&
      !!item.requiredApplicant.account && /^field\w+$/.test(item.requiredApplicant.fieldId ?? '')));
}

// Business test inputs are data, not workflow rules. They are never included in
// generated requirements or runtime evidence; only a fingerprint is recorded.
export async function loadWorkflowInputs(project, directory = new URL('../config/workflow-inputs/', import.meta.url), includeInactive = false) {
  if (!/^Z[0-9]+$/i.test(project.code ?? '')) throw new Error('无效的流程编号');
  let config;
  const path = directory instanceof URL ? new URL(`${project.code.toUpperCase()}.json`, directory) : join(directory, `${project.code.toUpperCase()}.json`);
  try { config = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, 'utf8')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; }
  if (config.code !== project.code || config.version !== project.version || config.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId || !Array.isArray(config.inputs)) {
    throw new Error('测试输入与目标流程版本不匹配');
  }
  for (const item of config.inputs) {
    if (!validateInput(item)) throw new Error('业务测试输入配置无效');
  }
  if (new Set(config.inputs.map(i=>i.fieldId)).size !== config.inputs.length) throw new Error('测试输入字段重复');
  return includeInactive ? config.inputs : config.inputs.filter(i => i.validationStatus !== '失效');
}

export async function saveWorkflowInput(project, item, directory = new URL('../config/workflow-inputs/', import.meta.url)) {
  if (!validateInput(item)) throw new Error('业务测试输入配置无效');
  const items=await loadWorkflowInputs(project,directory,true);
  const next=items.filter(x=>x.fieldId!==item.fieldId);
  next.push(item);
  const folder=directory instanceof URL ? fileURLToPath(directory) : directory;
  const path=join(folder,`${project.code.toUpperCase()}.json`),temp=`${path}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;
  await mkdir(folder,{recursive:true});
  await writeFile(temp,JSON.stringify({code:project.code,version:project.version,definitionId:project.workflowDefinitionId,inputs:next},null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
  await rename(temp,path);
}

export function inputFingerprint(inputs) {
  return createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(inputs.map(({fieldId,value})=>[fieldId,value]).sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0])))).digest('hex');
}

export async function applyWorkflowInputs(page, project, state, inputs) {
  if (state.release !== false || state.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId || !state.executable || state.status !== 1) throw new Error('测试输入只可用于目标非发布可办理节点');
  const applicable=inputs.filter(item=>item.nodeIds.map(String).includes(String(state.nodeId)));
  if (!applicable.length) return { fields: [], fingerprint: undefined };
  const results=await page.evaluate(items => items.map(item => {
    const form = window.$$?.entity;
    if (item.requiredApplicant && (form?.data?._VAR_ACTION_ACCOUNT !== item.requiredApplicant.account ||
        form?.data?.[item.requiredApplicant.fieldId] !== item.requiredApplicant.account)) {
      return { fieldId:item.fieldId, applied:false, reason:'applicant-mismatch' };
    }
    const field=form?.fields?.[item.fieldId];
    const controls=[...document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea')].filter(e => e.name===item.fieldId && e.getClientRects().length &&
      getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden' && !e.disabled && !e.readOnly && ['text','search','textarea'].includes((e.type || e.tagName).toLowerCase()));
    if (!field?.bound || !field.permission?.includes('w') || !['string','text'].includes(String(field.type).toLowerCase()) || controls.length!==1 ||
        (field.label || field.description || field.name)!==item.fieldName) return {fieldId:item.fieldId, applied:false};
    const el=controls[0];
    if (String(el.value ?? '').trim() && el.value!==item.value) return {fieldId:item.fieldId,applied:false,reason:'existing-value-differs'};
    if (el.value!==item.value) { el.value=item.value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
    return {fieldId:item.fieldId,applied:el.value===item.value};
  }),applicable);
  if (results.some(r=>r.reason==='applicant-mismatch')) throw new Error('当前模拟办理身份或表单申请人与关联测试记录不匹配');
  if (results.some(r=>r.reason==='existing-value-differs')) throw new Error('已有非空业务输入与配置不同，需核对后手动更正');
  if (results.some(r=>!r.applied)) throw new Error('测试输入字段与当前可写控件不匹配');
  const used=applicable.filter(item=>results.some(result=>result.fieldId===item.fieldId && result.applied));
  return {fields:used.map(r=>r.fieldId),fingerprint:used.length ? inputFingerprint(used) : undefined};
}

// Only a confirmed business rejection followed by a different recorded input
// fingerprint can be retried; unknown delivery and successes remain blocked.
export function mayRetryAction(events, step, fingerprint) {
  const index=events.findLastIndex(e=>e.kind==='action' && String(e.before?.flowStepId)===String(step));
  if (index<0) return true;
  const action=events[index];
  if (!action.submitted || action.http!==200 || !Number.isInteger(action.errno) || action.errno===0 || action.success || !fingerprint) return false;
  const message=action.responses?.find(r=>r.endpoint==='/infoplus/interface/doAction')?.error ?? '';
  if (!/不存在|请(?:输入|填写|选择)|必填|格式不正确|校验(?:不通过|失败)/u.test(message) || /超时|timeout|网络|服务器异常|回调|连接|系统故障/i.test(message)) return false;
  const earlierAction=events.slice(0,index).findLastIndex(e=>e.kind==='action' && String(e.before?.flowStepId)===String(step));
  const prior=events.slice(earlierAction+1,index).findLast(e=>e.kind==='input-snapshot' && String(e.flowStepId)===String(step));
  return Boolean(prior?.fingerprint && prior.fingerprint!==fingerprint);
}

=== src/workflow-order.mjs
// Forward topology determines document order; return paths remain separate evidence.
export function workflowOrder(workflow) {
  const nodes = workflow.nodes || [];
  const ids = new Set(nodes.map(n => String(n.id)));
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map(n => [String(n.id), n]));
  const returns = /退回|重新|刷新|return|again/i;
  const edges = (workflow.transitions || []).filter(e =>
    ids.has(String(e.source)) && ids.has(String(e.target)) &&
    String(e.source) !== String(e.target) && !returns.test(e.name || '') &&
    !(byId.get(String(e.target))?.type === '办理' && /退回|修改/.test(byId.get(String(e.target))?.name || '')));
  const incoming = new Map(nodes.map(n => [String(n.id), 0]));
  const outgoing = new Map(nodes.map(n => [String(n.id), []]));
  for (const e of edges) {
    incoming.set(String(e.target), incoming.get(String(e.target)) + 1);
    outgoing.get(String(e.source)).push(String(e.target));
  }
  const rank = new Map(nodes.map(n => [String(n.id), 0]));
  const queue = nodes.filter(n => !incoming.get(String(n.id))).map(n => String(n.id));
  const visited = new Set();
  while (queue.length) {
    const id = queue.shift();
    if (visited.has(id)) continue;
    visited.add(id);
    for (const target of outgoing.get(id)) {
      rank.set(target, Math.max(rank.get(target), rank.get(id) + 1));
      incoming.set(target, incoming.get(target) - 1);
      if (!incoming.get(target)) queue.push(target);
    }
  }
  // Unresolved cycles never silently masquerade as a verified normal path.
  return nodes.map(n => ({ ...n, topologyLevel: n.type === '办理' && /退回|修改/.test(n.name) ? Infinity : visited.has(String(n.id)) ? rank.get(String(n.id)) : Infinity }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.topologyLevel - b.topologyLevel || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh'));
}

export function businessControl(field) {
  const hints = [field.type, field.apiType, ...(field.usages || []).map(u => u.kind)];
  if (hints.includes('FileAttachment') || /附件|上传/.test(field.name || '')) return '附件上传';
  if (hints.includes('User')) return '成员选择';
  if (hints.includes('Organize')) return '部门选择';
  if (hints.some(t => /^(date|dateTime|DatePicker|DTPicker)$/.test(t))) return '日期选择';
  if (hints.includes('OptionButton')) return '单选';
  if (hints.some(t => ['Code', 'DropDown'].includes(t))) return '下拉选择';
  if (hints.some(t => ['boolean', 'CheckBox'].includes(t))) return '复选框';
  if (hints.some(t => ['int', 'integer', 'decimal', 'double'].includes(t))) return '数字';
  if (hints.includes('RichText')) return '多行文本';
  return '单行文本';
}

=== END src/workflow-order.mjs
=== src/workflow-original.mjs
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { parseFragment, serializeOuter } from 'parse5';
import { withRenderer } from './render.mjs';

export const editorCanvas = 'iframe[src*="/editor-vue/"]';
export const originalSvgName = 'workflow-original.svg';
export const originalPngName = 'workflow-original.png';
const rawCanvas = 'workflow-editor-dom.svg';
const metadata = 'workflow-original.json';
const hash = data => createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
const tags = new Set([
  'svg', 'g', 'image', 'foreignObject', 'div', 'span', 'br', 'b', 'strong', 'i', 'em',
  'path', 'rect', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'polygon', 'polyline', 'line', 'text', 'tspan',
  'defs', 'clipPath', 'marker', 'linearGradient', 'radialGradient', 'stop', 'title', 'desc',
]);
const embeddedImage = /^data:image\/(?:png|jpeg|gif|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/i;

function* elements(node) {
  if (node.tagName) yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* elements(child);
}

const textOf = node => node.nodeName === '#text' ? node.value : (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textOf).join('');
const clean = text => (text ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

function checkCanvas(root, workflow) {
  const groups = [...elements(root)].filter(node => node.tagName === 'g');
  const edgeGroup = node => {
    const children = node.childNodes.filter(child => child.tagName);
    return children.length === 3 && children.every(child => child.tagName === 'path');
  };
  // mxGraph groups the drawing paths in one pane and overlays in a separate pane.
  const edgeCount = Math.max(0, ...groups.map(pane =>
    pane.childNodes.filter(node => node.tagName === 'g' && edgeGroup(node)).length));
  const labels = [...elements(root)].filter(node => node.tagName === 'foreignObject').map(node => clean(textOf(node)));
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const label of labels) counts.set(label, (counts.get(label) ?? 0) + 1);
  const expected = [...workflow.nodes.map(node => node.name), ...workflow.transitions.map(edge =>
    edge.attributes?.displayName ?? edge.name)].map(clean).filter(Boolean);
  const missing = expected.filter(label => {
    const count = counts.get(label) ?? 0;
    counts.set(label, count - 1);
    return count <= 0;
  });
  if (!workflow.nodes.length || !workflow.transitions.length || edgeCount !== workflow.transitions.length || missing.length) {
    throw new Error(`IDE 画布与此版本定义不符（连线 ${edgeCount}/${workflow.transitions.length}，未匹配标签 ${missing.length}）`);
  }
  return { nodes: workflow.nodes.length, edges: edgeCount, labels: labels.length };
}

async function icon(href, origin) {
  const url = new URL(href, origin);
  if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || url.origin !== origin || url.username || url.password ||
      url.search || url.hash || !/\/static\/editor-vue\/(?:img|assets)\/.+\.(?:png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$/i.test(url.pathname)) {
    throw new Error('IDE 画布包含未识别的图标来源');
  }
  const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000), redirect: 'error' });
  const type = response.headers.get('content-type')?.split(';')[0];
  if (!response.ok || !/^image\/(?:png|jpeg|gif|webp)$/.test(type ?? '')) throw new Error('无法读取 IDE 画布图标');
  const data = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
  if (!data.length || data.length > 1_000_000) throw new Error('IDE 画布图标尺寸异常');
  return `data:${type};base64,${data.toString('base64')}`;
}

export async function prepareOriginalWorkflow(raw, bundle, directory) {
  if (Buffer.byteLength(raw) > 15_000_000) throw new Error('原始画布文件过大');
  const parsed = parseFragment(raw);
  const roots = parsed.childNodes.filter(node => node.tagName);
  const root = roots[0];
  if (roots.length !== 1 || root?.tagName !== 'svg') throw new Error('未找到完整 Workflow SVG');
  const stats = checkCanvas(root, bundle.workflow);
  const origin = new URL(bundle.project.editor).origin;
  const images = new Map();
  for (const node of elements(root)) {
    if (!tags.has(node.tagName)) throw new Error(`IDE 画布包含不支持的元素 ${node.tagName}`);
    for (const attr of node.attrs ?? []) {
      if (/^on|^src|^xml:base/i.test(attr.name) ||
          /url\s*\(\s*[^#]/i.test(attr.value.replace(/url\(#[^)]*\)/gi, '')) ||
          (attr.name === 'style' && /url\s*\(|@import|expression\s*\(/i.test(attr.value))) {
        throw new Error('IDE 画布包含不支持的活动内容');
      }
      if (attr.name !== 'href') continue;
      if (node.tagName !== 'image') throw new Error('IDE 画布包含不支持的链接');
      if (embeddedImage.test(attr.value)) continue;
      if (!images.has(attr.value)) images.set(attr.value, []);
      images.get(attr.value).push(attr);
    }
  }
  await Promise.all([...images].map(async ([href, attrs]) => {
    const data = await icon(href, origin);
    for (const attr of attrs) attr.value = data;
  }));
  root.attrs = root.attrs.filter(attr => !['style', 'width', 'height', 'viewBox'].includes(attr.name));
  root.attrs.push({ name: 'width', value: '4096' }, { name: 'height', value: '4096' });
  const outputPng = join(directory, originalPngName);
  let result;
  await withRenderer(async render => {
    result = await render(serializeOuter(root), outputPng, undefined, [], { fitWorkflowSvg: true });
  });
  await writeFile(join(directory, originalSvgName), result.svg);
  const provenance = {
    source: 'InfoPlus IDE Workflow canvas SVG',
    editor: bundle.project.editor,
    workflowDefinitionId: bundle.project.workflowDefinitionId,
    ...stats, icons: images.size, bounds: result.bounds, pixels: result.pixels,
    pngSha256: hash(await readFile(outputPng)), svgSha256: hash(result.svg),
  };
  await writeFile(join(directory, metadata), JSON.stringify(provenance, null, 2) + '\n');
  return provenance;
}

export async function originalWorkflowImage(bundle, directory) {
  try {
    const record = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, metadata), 'utf8'));
    if (record.workflowDefinitionId !== bundle.project.workflowDefinitionId ||
        record.editor !== bundle.project.editor || record.edges !== bundle.workflow.transitions.length ||
        record.nodes !== bundle.workflow.nodes.length) return;
    const [png, svg] = await Promise.all([
      readFile(join(directory, originalPngName)), readFile(join(directory, originalSvgName)),
    ]);
    if (hash(png) === record.pngSha256 && hash(svg) === record.svgSha256) return png;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
  }
}

export async function originalWorkflowSource(directory) {
  try { return await readFile(join(directory, 'raw', rawCanvas), 'utf8'); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
}

export async function collectEditorCanvas(page, directory) {
  const canvas = page.frameLocator(editorCanvas).locator('svg:has(foreignObject)').first();
  const markup = await canvas.evaluate(svg => svg.outerHTML, undefined, { timeout: 6500 });
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'raw', rawCanvas), markup);
}

=== END src/workflow-original.mjs
=== src/xsn.mjs
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { copyFile, mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { basename, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const exec = promisify(execFile);
const limit = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const psScript = fileURLToPath(new URL('./xsn.ps1', import.meta.url));
const windows = process.env.SystemRoot ?? 'C:\\Windows';
const safeMember = name => name.length > 0 && name.length <= 180 &&
  !/[\\/:<>|?*"\x00-\x1f\uFFFD]|[. ]$|^(?:con|prn|aux|nul|com[0-9¹²³]|lpt[0-9¹²³])(?:\.|$)/iu.test(name);

// Validate names and expanded sizes before invoking the Windows CAB extractor.
export function cabinetMembers(buffer) {
  if (buffer.length < 36 || buffer.toString('ascii', 0, 4) !== 'MSCF' ||
      buffer.readUInt32LE(8) !== buffer.length || buffer.readUInt16LE(30) & 3) {
    throw new Error('不支持的 CAB 或多卷 XSN');
  }
  const count = buffer.readUInt16LE(28);
  let position = buffer.readUInt32LE(16);
  let bytes = 0;
  const names = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (position < 36 || position + 16 >= buffer.length) throw new Error('XSN 文件表截断');
    bytes += buffer.readUInt32LE(position);
    const end = buffer.indexOf(0, position + 16);
    if (bytes > limit || end < 0 || end - position > 200) throw new Error('XSN 文件表超出限制');
    const name = buffer.toString('utf8', position + 16, end);
    if (!safeMember(name) || names.has(name.toLowerCase())) throw new Error('XSN 文件名不安全或重复');
    names.add(name.toLowerCase());
    position = end + 1;
  }
  if (!names.has('manifest.xsf')) throw new Error('缺少 manifest.xsf');
  return [...names];
}

export async function importXsn(file, output, render) {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') throw new Error('XSN 解包需要 Windows expand.exe');
  if ((await stat(file)).size > limit) throw new Error('XSN 超出大小限制');
  const bytes = await readFile(file);
  const members = cabinetMembers(bytes);
  await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
  const temp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'infoplus-xsn-'));
  try {
    const source = join(temp, 'source.cab');
    const extracted = join(temp, 'extracted');
    await mkdir(extracted);
    await writeFile(source, bytes, { flag: 'wx' });
    await exec(join(windows, 'System32', 'expand.exe'), ['-F:*', source, extracted], { timeout: 30000 });
    return await parseTemplate(file, extracted, members, output, render);
  } finally {
    await rm(temp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

export async function importTemplateJson(file, output, render) {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') throw new Error('模板解析需要 Windows PowerShell');
  if ((await stat(file)).size > limit) throw new Error('模板超出大小限制');
  const data = JSON.parse((await readFile(file, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('模板 JSON 必须是文件名到内容的对象');
  const members = Object.keys(data);
  const lower = members.map(name => name.toLowerCase());
  if (!lower.includes('manifest.xsf') || new Set(lower).size !== members.length ||
      !members.every(name => safeMember(name) && typeof data[name] === 'string')) {
    throw new Error('模板 JSON 缺少清单或包含不支持的文件');
  }
  const temp = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'infoplus-template-'));
  try {
    for (const name of members) await writeFile(join(temp, name), data[name], { flag: 'wx' });
    return await parseTemplate(file, temp, lower, output, render);
  } finally {
    await rm(temp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

async function parseTemplate(file, extracted, members, output, render) {
  const { stdout } = await exec(join(windows, 'System32', 'WindowsPowerShell', 'v1.0', 'powershell.exe'), [
    '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', psScript, '-Directory', extracted,
  ], { timeout: 45000, maxBuffer: limit });
  const result = JSON.parse(stdout);
  result.source = basename(file);
  result.members = members;
  const sources = join(output, 'source');
  await mkdir(sources, { recursive: true });
  for (const name of members) await copyFile(join(extracted, name), join(sources, name));
  for (const [index, view] of result.views.entries()) {
    const html = view.html;
    delete view.html;
    if (!html || !render) continue;
    try {
      view.screenshot = `view-${index + 1}.png`;
      await render(html, resolve(output, view.screenshot), sources, members);
    } catch {
      delete view.screenshot;
      view.issue = '静态预览截图失败';
    }
  }
  await writeFile(join(output, 'xsn.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

=== END src/xsn.mjs
=== src/xsn.ps1
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Directory)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$settings = [System.Xml.XmlReaderSettings]::new()
$settings.DtdProcessing = 'Prohibit'
$settings.XmlResolver = $null
$settings.MaxCharactersInDocument = 20000000

function Read-Xml([string]$Path) {
    $reader = [System.Xml.XmlReader]::Create($Path, $settings)
    try {
        $xml = [System.Xml.XmlDocument]::new()
        $xml.XmlResolver = $null
        $xml.Load($reader)
        return ,$xml
    } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
}

$manifestPath = Join-Path $Directory 'manifest.xsf'
$manifest = Read-Xml $manifestPath
$xsf = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/infopath/2003/solutionDefinition'
$manifestNs = [System.Xml.XmlNamespaceManager]::new($manifest.NameTable)
$manifestNs.AddNamespace('xsf', $xsf)
$schemaNs = 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'
$bindingNs = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/infopath/2003'
$xslNs = 'http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform'
$templatePath = Join-Path $Directory 'template.xml'
$defaults = @{}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templatePath) {
    $template = Read-Xml $templatePath
    foreach ($element in $template.SelectNodes('//*[not(*)]')) {
        if ($element.InnerText -and -not $defaults.ContainsKey($element.LocalName)) {
            $defaults[$element.LocalName] = $element.InnerText
        }
    }
}
$fields = @(
    foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Directory -File -Filter '*.xsd') {
        $schema = Read-Xml $file.FullName
        foreach ($element in $schema.GetElementsByTagName('element', $schemaNs)) {
            $name = $element.GetAttribute('name')
            $reference = $element.GetAttribute('ref')
            if (-not $name -and -not $reference) { continue }
            [ordered]@{
                name = $name
                ref = $reference
                type = $element.GetAttribute('type')
                restriction = @($element.GetElementsByTagName('restriction', $schemaNs) | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('base') })
                enumeration = @($element.GetElementsByTagName('enumeration', $schemaNs) | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('value') })
                minOccurs = $element.GetAttribute('minOccurs')
                maxOccurs = $element.GetAttribute('maxOccurs')
                parent = $element.SelectSingleNode('ancestor::*[local-name()="element"][1]').name
                defaultValue = $defaults[$name]
                file = $file.Name
            }
        }
    }
)
$index = 0
$views = @(
    foreach ($view in $manifest.SelectNodes('//xsf:views/xsf:view', $manifestNs)) {
        $index++
        $fileName = $view.SelectSingleNode('xsf:mainpane', $manifestNs).transform
        $viewData = [ordered]@{name = $view.GetAttribute('name'); file = $fileName; controls = @(); expressions = @(); html = $null; issue = $null}
        if (-not $fileName -or [IO.Path]::GetFileName($fileName) -ne $fileName) {
            $viewData.issue = 'Missing or unsupported transform path'
            $viewData
            continue
        }
        try {
            $path = Join-Path $Directory $fileName
            $stylesheet = Read-Xml $path
            $viewData.controls = @(
                foreach ($control in $stylesheet.SelectNodes('//*[@*]')) {
                    $binding = $control.GetAttribute('binding', $bindingNs)
                    if ($binding) {
                        [ordered]@{ binding = $binding; kind = $control.GetAttribute('xctname', $bindingNs); id = $control.GetAttribute('CtrlId', $bindingNs); title = $control.GetAttribute('title') }
                    }
                }
            )
            $viewData.expressions = @(
                foreach ($operation in $stylesheet.GetElementsByTagName('*', $xslNs)) {
                    foreach ($key in 'test','select','match') {
                        if ($operation.HasAttribute($key)) {
                            [ordered]@{ operation = $operation.LocalName; attribute = $key; expression = $operation.GetAttribute($key) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            )
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templatePath) {
                $engine = [System.Xml.Xsl.XslCompiledTransform]::new()
                $engine.Load($stylesheet, [System.Xml.Xsl.XsltSettings]::Default, $null)
                $inputReader = [System.Xml.XmlReader]::Create($templatePath, $settings)
                $buffer = [IO.StringWriter]::new()
                $writer = [System.Xml.XmlWriter]::Create($buffer, $engine.OutputSettings)
                try {
                    $engine.Transform($inputReader, $null, $writer, $null)
                } finally {
                    $inputReader.Dispose()
                    $writer.Dispose()
                }
                $viewData.html = $buffer.ToString()
            }
        } catch {
            $viewData.issue = $_.Exception.Message
        }
        $viewData
    }
)
[ordered]@{
    fields = $fields
    views = $views
    rules = @($manifest.SelectNodes('//*[local-name()="ruleSet" or local-name()="customValidation"]') | ForEach-Object { $_.OuterXml })
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress

=== END src/xsn.ps1
=== start-infoplus-chrome.ps1
param([switch]$Check)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$profile = if ($env:INFOPLUS_CHROME_PROFILE) { $env:INFOPLUS_CHROME_PROFILE } else { Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'chrome-profile' }
$profile = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($profile)
$port = 9222
$endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:$port"

if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $profile) -and
    ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $profile -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) {
    throw "The Chrome profile must be a local directory: $profile"
}

function Get-DebugListeners {
    Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

function Confirm-DedicatedChrome($listeners) {
    $ipv4 = @($listeners | Where-Object LocalAddress -eq '127.0.0.1')
    $owners = @($listeners.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($ipv4.Count -eq 0 -or $owners.Count -ne 1 -or
        @($listeners | Where-Object { $_.LocalAddress -notin '127.0.0.1', '::1' }).Count) {
        throw "Port $port is occupied by a listener other than the dedicated local Chrome."
    }
    $owner = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($owners[0])"
    $escapedProfile = [regex]::Escape($profile)
    $profileFlag = '(?:^|\s)--user-data-dir=(?:"' + $escapedProfile + '"|' + $escapedProfile + ')(?=\s|$)'
    if ($owner.Name -ne 'chrome.exe' -or $owner.CommandLine -notmatch $profileFlag -or
        $owner.CommandLine -notmatch "(?:^|\s)--remote-debugging-port=$port(?=\s|$)") {
        throw "Port $port is occupied. Release it before starting the dedicated Chrome."
    }
    $debug = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$endpoint/json/version" -TimeoutSec 2
    if ($debug.webSocketDebuggerUrl -notlike "ws://127.0.0.1:$port/devtools/browser/*") {
        throw 'Dedicated Chrome did not return a local browser debugging endpoint.'
    }
}

$listeners = @(Get-DebugListeners)
if ($listeners.Count) {
    Confirm-DedicatedChrome $listeners
    if (-not $Check) { Write-Host "Dedicated Chrome is ready at $endpoint" }
    exit 0
}
if ($Check) { exit 2 }

$chrome = @($env:ProgramFiles, ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}, $env:LOCALAPPDATA) |
    Where-Object { $_ } |
    ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe' } |
    Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf } |
    Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $chrome) { throw 'Google Chrome was not found.' }

$chromeArgs = @(
    '--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1'
    "--remote-debugging-port=$port"
    ('--user-data-dir="' + $profile + '"')
    '--no-first-run'
    'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/ide/project/ZD_YGCGJSCS'
)
Start-Process -FilePath $chrome -ArgumentList $chromeArgs -WindowStyle Normal

$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)
do {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
    $listeners = @(Get-DebugListeners)
} until ($listeners.Count -or (Get-Date) -ge $deadline)
if (-not $listeners.Count) { throw "Dedicated Chrome did not open port $port." }
Confirm-DedicatedChrome $listeners
Write-Host "Dedicated Chrome is ready at $endpoint"

=== END start-infoplus-chrome.ps1
=== tests/business-content.test.mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { buildBusinessContent } from '../src/business-content.mjs';

test('业务版按表单证据合并字段，并将未核实的条件标为待确认', () => {
  const result = buildBusinessContent({
    project: { code: 'OTHER', name: '物品领取' },
    workflow: {
      nodes: [{ id: 'a', name: '是否复核', type: '判断' }, { id: 'b', name: '部门复核', type: '办理' }],
      transitions: [{ source: 'a', target: 'b', name: '是' }],
    },
    rules: [{ id: 'a', name: '是否复核', kind: '判断', expression: 'unknown()' }],
    views: [{ id: 'v1', name: '填写' }, { id: 'v2', name: '审核' }],
    fields: [
      { id: 'name', name: '领用人', apiType: 'User', view: '填写', required: true, usages: [{}] },
      { id: 'name', name: 'name', view: '审核', readOnly: true, usages: [{}] },
      { id: '_VAR_OWNER', name: '内部变量', view: '填写', usages: [{}] },
      { id: 'hidden', name: '辅助：分流', view: '填写', usages: [{}] },
    ],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(result.fields.flatMap(group => group.rows), [['领用人', '成员选择', '填写模板标记必填（实际阶段规则待核实） 审核只读']]);
  assert.match(result.approvals[0][1], /部门复核.*触发条件待确认/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(result.approvals[0][1], /unknown/);
  assert.match(result.questions[0], /是否复核/);
});

test('业务版把可识别的字段比较映射到实际连线目标', () => {
  const result = buildBusinessContent({
    project: { code: 'OTHER', name: '物品领取' },
    workflow: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', name: '是否复核', type: '判断' },
        { id: 'b', name: '部门复核', type: '办理' },
        { id: 'c', name: '领取完成', type: '自动步骤' },
      ],
      transitions: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b', code: 'yes', name: '是' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c', code: 'no', name: '否' },
      ],
    },
    rules: [{
      id: 'a', name: '是否复核', kind: '判断',
      expression: 'String value = ${"fieldReview"}; if ("是".equals(value)) { return "yes"; } return "no";',
    }],
    views: [],
    fields: [{ id: 'fieldReview', name: '需要复核', usages: [] }],
  });
  assert.deepEqual(result.approvals, [['是否复核', '「需要复核」为「是」时进入部门复核，其余进入领取完成。']]);
  assert.deepEqual(result.questions, []);
});

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { buildBusinessContent, mergeEquivalentFields } from '../src/business-content.mjs';

test('相同规则合并字段名，不同必填或选项规则不可合并',()=>{
 const result=mergeEquivalentFields([['甲','文本','必填'],['乙','文本','必填'],['丙','文本','可选'],['甲','文本','必填']]);
 assert.deepEqual(result,[['甲','文本','必填'],['乙','文本','必填'],['丙','文本','可选'],['甲','文本','必填']]);
});
test('成员接口仅解析白名单过滤配置，不保留凭据或人员编号',()=>{
 const params=new URLSearchParams({settings:JSON.stringify({userFilters:':FACULTY',userTraversal:true,csrfToken:'secret',account:'1234567'})});
 assert.deepEqual(safeMemberFilters(params),{userFilters:':FACULTY',userTraversal:true});
 assert.deepEqual(safeMemberFilters(new URLSearchParams({settings:'broken'})),{});
 assert.match(memberScopeDescription({userFilters:'*:FACULTY'}),/尚未实测/);
});

 const result=buildBusinessContent(bundle);

});

test('字段原子化：不同 ID 不合并，同名不同 ID 保留，跨阶段汇总状态',()=>{
 const records=[
  {id:'a',name:'意见：说明',type:'富文本',view:'申请',required:true,rule:'必填'},
  {id:'b',name:'意见：说明',type:'富文本',view:'申请',required:true,rule:'必填'},
  {id:'c',name:'访问成果',type:'单行文本',view:'审核',required:false,rule:'只读'},
  {id:'a',name:'意见：说明',type:'富文本',view:'审核',required:false,rule:'只读'},
 ];
 const fields=atomicFieldRows(records,{groupName:'回国信息'});
 assert.equal(fields.length,3);
 assert.deepEqual(fields.find(f=>f.fieldId==='a').stages,['申请','审核']);
 assert.match(fields.find(f=>f.fieldId==='a').required,/申请必填/);
 assert.match(fields.find(f=>f.fieldId==='a').required,/审核可选/);
 const rows=atomicRowsForWord(fields);
 assert.equal(rows.length,3);
 assert.ok(rows.every(row=>row[0]==='回国信息'));
});

test('字段名称中的顿号和冒号不被文本拆分',()=>{
 const fields=atomicFieldRows([{id:'x',name:'是否安排打前站或团外团：说明',type:'富文本',view:'申请'}]);
 assert.deepEqual(fields.map(f=>f.fieldName),['是否安排打前站或团外团：说明']);
});

=== tests/debug-autorun.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { selectAutomaticAction, retryDebugProbe } from '../src/online-evidence.mjs';
import { ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement } from '../src/debug-launch.mjs';

test('automatic actions require exactly one standard non-remark action', () => {
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'审核通过'},{label:'退回修改'}]).label,'审核通过');
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'提交/Submit'}]).label,'提交/Submit');
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'审核通过/Approved'}]).label,'审核通过/Approved');
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'提交'},{label:'审核通过'}]),undefined);
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'删除'}]),undefined);
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'提交并发起报销'}]),undefined);
  assert.equal(selectAutomaticAction([{label:'提交',remarkRequired:true}]),undefined);
});
test('only read-only operations are retried a bounded number of times', async () => {
  let calls=0;
  const result=await retryDebugProbe(async()=>{ if(++calls<3) throw Error('temporary'); return 'ok'; },2);
  assert.equal(result,'ok'); assert.equal(calls,3);
  calls=0;
  await assert.rejects(retryDebugProbe(async()=>{ calls++; throw Error('down'); },1));
  assert.equal(calls,2);
});
test('transient probe results are retried but permission and stable business states are not', async () => {
  let calls=0;
  let result=await retryDebugProbe(async()=>++calls===1 ? {entry:{state:'unavailable',http:503}} : {entry:{state:'identity-ready'}},2);
  assert.equal(calls,2); assert.equal(result.entry.state,'identity-ready');
  calls=0;
  result=await retryDebugProbe(async()=>{calls++;return {entry:{state:'not-checked'},reason:'专用 Chrome 未能在时限内核对目标版本或 Debug 页面'};},2);
  assert.equal(calls,3); assert.equal(result.entry.state,'not-checked');
  for (const entry of [{state:'permission-denied'}, {state:'login-required'}, {state:'not-deployed'}, {state:'unavailable',http:403}, {state:'not-checked'}]) {
    calls=0;
    await retryDebugProbe(async()=>{calls++;return {entry,reason:'未找到与该版本匹配的非发布 Debug 入口'};},2);
    assert.equal(calls,1,entry.state);
  }
});
test('welcome acknowledgement only accepts explicit reading confirmation', () => {
  assert.equal(ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement('我已认真阅读'),true);
  assert.equal(ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement('本人已阅读以上须知'),true);
  assert.equal(ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement('我同意自动删除所有记录'),false);
  assert.equal(ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement(''),false);
});

=== tests/debug-policy.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { loadDebugPolicy, debugAvailability, assertOrdinaryDebugAction, assertCallbacksAllowed } from '../src/debug-policy.mjs';
import { ordinaryConfirmation } from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
import { probeDebug } from '../src/debug-probe.mjs';

test('默认优先 Debug，共享回调不是回退条件', () => {
  const policy = loadDebugPolicy();
  assert.equal(policy.preferred, true);
  assert.equal(policy.autoRun, true);
  assert.equal(policy.allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks, true);
  assert.equal(debugAvailability({ state: 'identity-ready', boundary: { status: 'shared-callback' } }, policy).selectedMode, 'debug');
  assert.equal(debugAvailability({ state: 'not-deployed' }, policy).selectedMode, 'front');
  assert.equal(debugAvailability({ state: 'permission-denied' }, { ...policy, fallbackToFrontend: false }).selectedMode, 'unavailable');
});

test('禁用回调时仅接受已核实零启用回调', () => {
  const policy = { ...loadDebugPolicy(), allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks: false };
  assert.throws(() => assertCallbacksAllowed(policy));
  assert.throws(() => assertCallbacksAllowed(policy, { callbacks: { enabled: 1 } }));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertCallbacksAllowed(policy, { callbacks: { enabled: 0 } }));
});

test('前期版本地址校验失败也遵循关闭前台回退配置', async () => {
  const policy = { ...loadDebugPolicy(), fallbackToFrontend: false };
  const result = await probeDebug(null, { source: 'https://invalid.test/not-ide', editor: '' }, policy);
  assert.equal(result.selectedMode, 'unavailable');
});

test('只允许常规 Debug 动作，普通确认可处理，危险动作仍拒绝', () => {
  for (const label of ['提交', '审核通过', '退回修改', '重新提交']) assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertOrdinaryDebugAction(label));
  for (const label of ['提交/Submit', '审核通过/Approved', '退回修改/Return for Modification', '重新提交/Submit again']) assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertOrdinaryDebugAction(label));
  for (const label of ['删除记录', '发布流程', '部署', '终止流程', '注销账户', '同步真实数据', '提交付款', '其他未知操作', '提交/Delete', '提交/Submit and synchronize data', '审核通过/Submit']) assert.throws(() => assertOrdinaryDebugAction(label));
  assert.throws(() => assertOrdinaryDebugAction('提交', { allowNormalWorkflowActions: false }));
  assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation('确定提交吗？', '申请人提交并打印'), true);
  assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation('确认删除记录？', '删除记录'), false);
});

=== END tests/debug-policy.test.mjs
=== tests/debug-probe.test.mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { debugBoundary, debugEntry } from '../src/debug-probe.mjs';
import { buildNodeEvidence } from '../src/node-evidence.mjs';
import { debugAvailability } from '../src/debug-policy.mjs';
import { requireDebugPage } from '../src/debug-verification.mjs';

const project = {
  source: 'https://example.test/infoplus/ide/project/Test', projectCode: 'Test',
  workflowDefinitionId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
};

test('探测只接受目标版本的同源非发布 Debug 入口', () => {
  const path = `/infoplus/form/${project.workflowDefinitionId}/start`;
  const query = '?release=false&entrust=true';
  assert.equal(debugEntry(path + query, project).pathname, path);
  assert.equal(debugEntry(path + query + '&release=true', project), undefined);
  assert.equal(debugEntry(path + '?release=true&entrust=true', project), undefined);
  assert.equal(debugEntry('https://other.test' + path + query, project), undefined);
  assert.equal(debugEntry(path.replace('001', '002') + query, project), undefined);
});

test('正式和测试共用回调应记录，不保存地址和凭据', () => {
  const check = dev => debugBoundary({ success: true, released: true,
    guiDefinition: `<workflow code="Test"><events><applicationEvent enabled="true"
      address="https://example.test/events?token=private" addressDev="${dev}"/></events></workflow>` }, project);
  const shared = check('https://example.test/events?token=test');
  assert.equal(shared.status, 'shared-callback');
  assert.equal(shared.callbacks.sharedEndpoints, 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(shared), /example\.test|private/);
  assert.equal(check('https://staging.test/events').status, 'unverified');
});

test('委托中转页只有经过 IDE 启动入口才可继续核验，普通页面和正式实例不能执行动作', () => {
  assert.equal(debugAvailability({ state: 'delegation-interstitial' }).selectedMode, 'front');
  assert.match(debugAvailability({ state: 'delegation-interstitial', ideDebugEntry: true }).reason, /仍须核对/);
  const page = { release: false, entryId: 123, debugMarker: true, identityMatched: true, status: 1, executable: true };
  for (const fields of [{ release: true }, { debugMarker: false }, { entryId: undefined }, { identityMatched: false }, { executable: false }]) {
    assert.throws(() => requireDebugPage({ ...page, ...fields }, { writable: true }));
  }
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => requireDebugPage(page, { writable: true }));
});

test('前台视图观测不会把审批节点和退回路径标为已验证', () => {
  const [node] = buildNodeEvidence({
    nodes: [{ id: '1', name: '审批', view: 'v', actor: '主管' }, { id: '2', name: '填报' }],
    transitions: [{ id: 'e', source: '1', target: '2', name: '退回修改' }],
  }, [{ viewId: 'v', staticScreenshot: 'view.png' }], [], [{
    viewId: 'v', file: 'raw/field-option-observations.json', versionVerified: true,
    source: 'raw/field-option-observations.json#/observations/1', fieldId: 'reason', options: [{ label: '补充资料' }],
  }]);
  assert.deepEqual(node.optionFields, ['reason']);
  assert.equal(node.verification.page, 'front-view');
  assert.equal(node.verification.transition, 'not-verified');
  assert.equal(node.returns[0].nodeName, '填报');
  assert.equal(node.returns[0].verified, false);
});

=== END tests/debug-probe.test.mjs
=== tests/debug-session.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {matchesDebugAction, ordinaryConfirmation, requireDebugAuthorization} from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
import {runtimeSummary, memberScopeDescription} from '../src/debug-runtime.mjs';

test('办理请求必须匹配同源实例步骤和唯一动作，不接受重复参数或跨节点', () => {
  const request = {url:'https://example.test/infoplus/interface/doAction', method:'POST',body:'stepId=123&actionId=5'};
  assert.equal(matchesDebugAction(request,'https://example.test',123,5),true);
  for(const patch of [{body:'stepId=124&actionId=5'},{body:'stepId=123&actionId=5&actionId=6'},
    {url:'https://other.test/infoplus/interface/doAction'},{method:'GET'}])
    assert.equal(matchesDebugAction({...request,...patch},'https://example.test',123,5),false);
  assert.throws(()=>requireDebugAuthorization({code:'A',version:'v1'},'B@v1'));
});

test('实际备注确认可以继续，删除配置和校验错误不能当作审批确认', () => {
  assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation('如有其它相关说明，请点击备注，或直接批注在填表内容处\n好\n取消','审核通过'),true);
  assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation('确定提交吗？','提交'),true);
  for(const text of ['确定删除记录？','确定部署新版本？','请确保填写内容完整及格式正确！\n确定','已公示网站链接和上传公示内容截图，至少需要填写一个。\n确定'])
    assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation(text,'提交'),false);
});

test('阶段观察和待办候选不等于完成审批，手动实例不计入自动覆盖', () => {
  const data={runs:[{origin:'user-manual-debug',events:[{kind:'action',success:true}]},
    {origin:'automatic-debug',instanceId:'test',events:[{kind:'stage',state:{nodeId:7,executable:true},role:'审批人'}]}]};
  const summary=runtimeSummary(data);
  assert.deepEqual(summary.observedNodes,[7]);assert.deepEqual(summary.completedNodes,[]);
  assert.deepEqual(summary.verifiedPaths,[]);assert.equal(summary.instances,1);
  assert.match(memberScopeDescription(),/不能据此认定/);
  assert.match(memberScopeDescription({userFilters:':FACULTY'}),/尚不能确定/);
});

=== tests/field-options.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { enrichField, extractStaticControls } from '../src/field-options.mjs';
import { matchSuggest, parseSuggestResponse } from '../src/option-evidence.mjs';
import { permittedProbeRequest } from '../src/live-options.mjs';

test('静态选项保留显示名、编码和条件，默认值不借用当前申请值', () => {
  const source = 'view.xsl';
  const controls = extractStaticControls(`
    <xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
      xmlns:xd="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/infopath/2003">
      <select xd:binding="my:fieldA" required="required">
        <option value="1" selected="selected">甲</option>
        <xsl:if test="my:fieldB='yes'"><option value="2">乙</option></xsl:if>
      </select>
    </xsl:stylesheet>`, source);
  const field = enrichField({ id: 'fieldA', name: '甲类' }, {
    panels: [{ controls, source, name: '填写' }], runtime: [], schemaSource: 'xsn.json',
  });
  assert.equal(field.defaultValue, '1');
  assert.equal(field.required, true);
  assert.equal(field.readOnly, null);
  assert.deepEqual(field.optionSets.map(set => [set.when, set.options]), [
    [[], [{ value: '1', label: '甲' }]],
    [[{ fieldId: 'fieldB', operator: '=', value: 'yes' }], [{ value: '2', label: '乙' }]],
  ]);
  assert.equal(field.optionStatus, 'partial');
});

test('suggest 仅在来源和字段有对应证据时保存编码和显示名称', () => {
  const project = {
    source: 'https://example.test/infoplus/ide/project/P',
    workflowDefinitionId: 'definition', views: [{ id: 'view' }],
  };
  const fields = [{ id: 'fieldA', uuid: 'field-uuid' }];
  const entry = {
    request: {
      url: 'https://example.test/infoplus/internal/suggest?token=secret',
      method: 'POST', postData: { mimeType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', text: 'fieldId=field-uuid&viewId=view&q=x' },
    },
    response: { status: 200, content: { text: '{"errno":0,"entities":[{"codeId":"1","codeName":"甲","extra":"discard"}]}' } },
  };
  const result = matchSuggest(entry, project, fields);
  assert.equal(result.viewId, 'view');
  assert.equal(result.versionVerified, true);
  assert.equal(result.completeness, 'partial');
  assert.deepEqual(result.options, [{ value: '1', label: '甲' }]);
  assert.equal(result.request.searchFiltered, true);
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(result), /token|secret|discard/);
  assert.equal(matchSuggest(entry, project, [{ id: 'other' }]), undefined);
  assert.equal(parseSuggestResponse({ text: '{"errno":2,"entities":[{"codeId":"1","codeName":"甲"}]}' }), undefined);
});

test('隔离探测只允许已有申请页面和明确的读取请求', () => {
  const page = new URL('https://example.test/infoplus/form/1/render?theme=x');
  const allowed = (path, method, type) => permittedProbeRequest(new URL(path, page), method, type, page);
  assert.ok(allowed(page.href, 'GET', 'document'));
  assert.ok(allowed('/infoplus/interface/suggest', 'POST', 'xhr'));
  assert.equal(allowed('/infoplus/form/1/start', 'GET', 'document'), false);
  assert.equal(allowed('/infoplus/form/1/save', 'POST', 'xhr'), false);
  assert.equal(allowed('https://other.test/infoplus/interface/suggest', 'POST', 'xhr'), false);
  const render = new URL('/infoplus/interface/render', page);
  const instanceId = '12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc';
  const progress = new URL(`/infoplus/interface/instance/${instanceId}/progress`, page);
  assert.ok(permittedProbeRequest(render, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=1&admin=false' }));
  assert.equal(permittedProbeRequest(render, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=2&admin=false' }), false);
  assert.equal(permittedProbeRequest(render, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=1&admin=true' }), false);
  assert.equal(permittedProbeRequest(render, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=1&stepId=2&admin=false' }), false);
  assert.ok(permittedProbeRequest(progress, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=1', instanceId }));
  assert.equal(permittedProbeRequest(progress, 'POST', 'xhr', page, { formBody: 'stepId=1' }), false);
  assert.equal(permittedProbeRequest(progress, 'POST', 'xhr', page,
    { formBody: 'stepId=1', instanceId: '22345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc' }), false);
});

=== tests/linked-dashboard.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { checkLinkedDetail, linkedFieldCandidates, selectDashboardRecord } from '../src/linked-dashboard.mjs';

test('办事中心筛选完成记录并拒绝多条相符记录', () => {
  const row = { serial: '42', path: '/infoplus/form/e42/render', status: '已完成' };
  assert.equal(selectDashboardRecord([row], { serial: '42' }).status, 'matched');
  assert.equal(selectDashboardRecord([row, { ...row }], {}).status, 'ambiguous');
  assert.equal(selectDashboardRecord([{ ...row, status: '进行中' }], {}).status, 'not-found');
  assert.equal(selectDashboardRecord([{ ...row, path: '/infoplus/form/e43/render' }], {}).status, 'not-found');
});

test('历史详情须核对发布模式、版本、人员和实际字符串业务字段', () => {
  const predecessor = { workflowDefinitionId: 'expected' };
  const criteria = { applicantAccount: '000123' };
  const detail = { serial: 42, definitionId: 'expected', release: true, status: 4, account: '000123', value: '77001000000000001' };
  assert.equal(checkLinkedDetail(detail, predecessor, criteria, '42'), true);
  for (const mismatch of [{ account: '123' }, { value: '42' }, { value: Number(detail.value) }, { definitionId: 'other' }, { release: false }]) {
    assert.equal(checkLinkedDetail({ ...detail, ...mismatch }, predecessor, criteria, '42'), false);
  }
});

test('关联字段识别保留候选状态并合并跨视图重复项', () => {
  const fields = [{ id: 'fieldPrevious', name: '原申请编号' }, { id: 'fieldItem', name: '当前标题' }];
  assert.deepEqual(linkedFieldCandidates({ fields: fields.concat(fields) }).map(item => item.fieldId), ['fieldPrevious']);
});

=== tests/linked-instances.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { selectLinkedInstance, extractLinkedBusinessValue, discoverLinkedBusinessValue } from '../src/linked-instances.mjs';

const criteria={predecessorCode:'PREV',applicant:'authorized-user',name:'业务名称',status:'已完成',fieldId:'fieldBusinessNo',release:false};
const row={applicant:'authorized-user',name:'业务名称',status:'已完成',dataPath:'/infoplus/form/123/data'};
test('关联数据必须同时匹配前置流程、申请人、业务名称和状态，多个候选不自动选取',()=>{
  assert.equal(selectLinkedInstance([row],criteria).status,'matched');
  assert.equal(selectLinkedInstance([row,row],criteria).status,'ambiguous');
  assert.equal(selectLinkedInstance([{...row,applicant:'someone-else'}],criteria).status,'not-found');
  assert.equal(selectLinkedInstance([row],{...criteria,predecessorCode:''}).status,'needs-context');
});
test('业务编号只从指定字段提取为字符串，不能用实例 ID 代替',()=>{
  assert.deepEqual(extractLinkedBusinessValue([{id:'instanceId',value:'123'}],'fieldBusinessNo'),{status:'field-unavailable'});
  assert.equal(extractLinkedBusinessValue([{id:'fieldBusinessNo',value:'33001920265590408'}],'fieldBusinessNo').value,'33001920265590408');
  assert.equal(extractLinkedBusinessValue([{id:'fieldBusinessNo',value:'1'},{id:'fieldBusinessNo',value:'2'}],'fieldBusinessNo').status,'ambiguous-field');
});
test('缺少明确可信前置流程或匹配上下文时不会打开浏览器',async()=>{
  let called=false;
  const result=await discoverLinkedBusinessValue({newPage(){called=true;}},{source:'https://example.test/infoplus/ide/project/A',code:'PREV',workflowDefinitionId:'bad'},criteria);
  assert.equal(result.status,'needs-context'); assert.equal(called,false);
});
test('只在唯一匹配后读取指定字段，并封锁写请求和外站请求',async()=>{
  let guard, current, evalCount=0, closed=false;
  const page={route:async (_pattern,fn)=>guard=fn, goto:async url=>(current=url,{ok:()=>true}), url:()=>current,
    evaluate:async ()=>++evalCount===1?[row]:[{id:'fieldBusinessNo',value:'33001920265590408'}], close:async()=>{closed=true;}};
  const predecessor={source:'https://example.test/infoplus/ide/project/PREV',code:'PREV',workflowDefinitionId:'12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc'};
  const result=await discoverLinkedBusinessValue({newPage:async()=>page},predecessor,criteria);
  assert.equal(result.status,'found'); assert.equal(result.value,'33001920265590408'); assert.equal(closed,true);
  for (const [method,url] of [['POST',current],['GET','https://other.test/infoplus/form/123/data']]) {
    let aborted=false; await guard({request:()=>({method:()=>method,url:()=>url,resourceType:()=> 'document'}),abort:()=>{aborted=true;},continue:()=>{}});
    assert.equal(aborted,true);
  }
});

=== tests/output-management.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {mkdtemp,readFile,writeFile,rm} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {officialDirectory,writeWordAtomic} from '../src/output-management.mjs';
test('正式路径按编号隔离，拒绝路径穿越',()=>{
 assert.match(officialDirectory('Z1778'),/output[\\/]Z1778$/);
 assert.throws(()=>officialDirectory('../other'));
});
test('无效 Word 不损坏旧文件',async()=>{
 const dir=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'infoplus-output-'));const path=join(dir,'requirements.docx');
 try {await writeFile(path,'original');await assert.rejects(writeWordAtomic(path,Buffer.from('invalid')));assert.equal(await readFile(path,'utf8'),'original');}
 finally{await rm(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

=== tests/path-coverage.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {analyzePathCoverage} from '../src/path-coverage.mjs';
test('收尾邻接终点不等于实例结束，自循环不生成无限路径',()=>{
 const b={project:{},workflow:{nodes:[{id:'a',type:'办理',name:'结果'},{id:'z',type:'自动步骤',name:'结束'}],transitions:[{id:'1',source:'a',target:'a'},{id:'2',source:'a',target:'z',name:'完成'}]},debugRuns:{runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',instanceId:'one',events:[{kind:'stage',state:{nodeId:'a',entryStatus:1}}]}]}};
 const c=analyzePathCoverage(b);assert.equal(c.obligations.length,1);assert.equal(c.counts.completedInstances,0);assert.equal(c.counts.closingInstances,1);assert.equal(c.counts.observedOperations,0);
});
test('HTTP 500 只作为技术问题，不作为业务阻断',()=>{
 const c=analyzePathCoverage({project:{},workflow:{nodes:[{id:'a',type:'办理'}],transitions:[]},debugRuns:{runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',events:[{kind:'action',before:{nodeId:'a'},responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',http:500,error:'broken'}]}]}]}});
 assert.equal(c.instances[0].status,'系统故障');assert.equal(c.instances[0].businessBlock,undefined);
});
test('HTTP 200 的事件回调超时仍是技术故障',()=>{
 const c=analyzePathCoverage({project:{},workflow:{nodes:[{id:'a',type:'办理'}],transitions:[]},debugRuns:{runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',events:[{kind:'action',before:{nodeId:'a'},responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',http:200,errno:22007,error:'EVENT_MESSENGER_TIMEOUT: Read timed out'}]}]}]}});
 assert.equal(c.instances[0].status,'系统故障');assert.equal(c.instances[0].businessBlock,undefined);
});
test('材料仍在制作属于业务等待，不计入校验失败或实例完成',()=>{
 const bundle={project:{},workflow:{nodes:[{id:'a',type:'办理'},{id:'z',type:'自动步骤'}],transitions:[{id:'1',source:'a',target:'z'}]},debugRuns:{runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',events:[{kind:'action',before:{nodeId:'a',entryStatus:1},responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',http:200,errno:22001,error:'材料制作中'}]}]}]}};
 const coverage=analyzePathCoverage(bundle);
 assert.equal(coverage.counts.closingInstances,1);
 assert.equal(coverage.counts.businessWaitingInstances,1);
 assert.equal(coverage.counts.businessBlockedInstances,0);
 assert.equal(coverage.counts.completedInstances,0);
});
test('外部查询失败原因未知，不断言业务数据或系统故障',()=>{
 const c=analyzePathCoverage({project:{},workflow:{nodes:[{id:'a',type:'办理'}],transitions:[]},debugRuns:{runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',events:[{kind:'action',before:{nodeId:'a'},responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',http:200,errno:22001,error:'查询护照状态失败，请联系技术人员检查！'}]}]}]}});
 assert.equal(c.instances[0].status,'外部查询阻断，原因待核实');assert.equal(c.counts.businessBlockedInstances,0);assert.equal(c.counts.queryBlockedInstances,1);
});

=== tests/skill-knowledge.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = path.resolve('.agents/skills/infoplus-prd');
const skill = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'SKILL.md'),'utf8');
const refs = [
  'references/issue-index.md',
  'references/troubleshooting.md',
  'references/debug-playbook.md',
  'references/cross-flow-identity.md',
  'references/field-button-screenshot.md',
  'references/document-output.md',
  'references/capability-matrix.md',
];

test('Skill 主文件引用的知识库全部存在且可读取',()=>{
  for(const ref of refs){
    assert.ok(skill.includes(`](${ref})`),`SKILL.md 未引用 ${ref}`);
    const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,ref),'utf8');
    assert.ok(text.trim().length>200,`${ref} 内容过短`);
  }
});

test('问题索引条目链接和锚点可被解析',()=>{
  const index=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'references/issue-index.md'),'utf8');
  const links=[...index.matchAll(/\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#([^)]+))?\)/g)];
  assert.ok(links.length>=15);
  const slug=value=>value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s-]/gu,'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,'-');
  for(const [,file,anchor] of links){
    const target=path.resolve(root,'references',file);
    const text=fs.readFileSync(target,'utf8');
    if(anchor){
      const headings=[...text.matchAll(/^#{1,6}\s+(.+)$/gm)].map(m=>slug(m[1]));
      assert.ok(headings.includes(slug(anchor)),`${file}#${anchor} 锚点不存在`);
    }
  }
});

test('关键执行规则在 Skill 与手册中保持一致',()=>{
  for(const text of [skill,fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'references/debug-playbook.md'),'utf8')]){
    assert.match(text,/Debug/);
    assert.match(text,/校验|必填/);
    assert.match(text,/恢复|中断/);
  }
  assert.match(skill,/只输出命名业务 Word|只交付/);
  assert.match(skill,/先读.*debug-playbook|执行决策手册/);
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'references/capability-matrix.md'),'utf8'),/待实现|部分实现/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(skill,/默认生成两份 Word/);
});

=== END tests/skill-knowledge.test.mjs
=== tests/stage-field-differences.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {analyzeStageFields} from '../src/stage-field-differences.mjs';
test('仅比较同实例实际跳转，缺少绑定和显隐权限分别记录',()=>{
 const stage=(step,fields)=>({kind:'stage',state:{flowStepId:step,nodeId:step,name:String(step)},fields});
 const a={id:'x',name:'审核意见',visible:true,readOnly:true,required:false};
 const events=[stage(1,[a]),stage(2,[{...a,readOnly:false,required:true},{id:'y',name:'审批人',visible:true}]),
 {kind:'resume',before:{flowStepId:1},after:{flowStepId:2}}];
 const out=analyzeStageFields({runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',instanceId:'one',events}]});
 assert.equal(out.differences.length,2);
 assert.deepEqual(out.differences[0].changes,['当前可编辑','当前配置必填']);
 assert.match(out.differences[1].changes[0],/未采集到绑定/);
 assert.equal(analyzeStageFields({runs:[{origin:'automatic-debug',events:events.slice(0,2)}]}).differences.length,0);
 assert.equal(analyzeStageFields({runs:[{origin:'user-manual-debug',events}]}).stages.length,0);
});

test('七类弹窗独立判断，校验和危险提示绝不成为提交确认',()=>{
 const cases=[['调试说明：仅供调试','information'],['确定提交吗？','submission-confirmation'],
 ['请选择一个选项。确定','required-validation'],['请填写姓名','required-validation'],
 ['请输入正确的联系方式。确定','format-validation'],['请确保填写内容完整及格式正确。确定','format-validation'],
 ['至少需要填写一个。确定','business-validation'],['业务编号不存在','business-validation'],
 ['外部回调超时','external-service'],['删除记录前请填写原因，确定','unknown'],['未知提示 确定','unknown']];
 for(const [text,kind] of cases){assert.equal(classifyDialog(text,'提交'),kind);assert.equal(ordinaryConfirmation(text,'提交'),['information','submission-confirmation'].includes(kind));}
});

 assert.equal(submissionOutcome(null),'unknown');
 assert.equal(submissionOutcome({...base,responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',errno:0}]}),'accepted');
 assert.equal(submissionOutcome({...base,responses:[{endpoint:'/doAction',errno:1,error:'回调超时'}]}),'external-service');
});

 }))})};

=== tests/v121-image-layout.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { dedupeSectionImages, dedupeSectionRules, imageCropSegments } from '../src/image-layout.mjs';

const page = { width: 11906, height: 16838, top: 1134, bottom: 1134, left: 1418, right: 1418 };

test('超长附录图片按可用页面高度分段，并保留完整纵向范围', () => {
  const segments = imageCropSegments({ width: 1440, height: 5219 }, page, 130);
  assert.ok(segments.length > 1);
  assert.equal(segments[0].crop.top, 0);
  assert.equal(segments.at(-1).crop.bottom, 0);
  for (let index = 1; index < segments.length; index++) {
    assert.ok(Math.abs(
      100 - segments[index - 1].crop.bottom - segments[index].crop.top,
    ) < 1e-9);
  }
  const availableHeight = (page.height - page.top - page.bottom) / 15 - 130;
  assert.ok(segments.every(segment => segment.height <= availableHeight));
});

test('普通页面图片保持单图，不生成伪分段', () => {
  const segments = imageCropSegments({ width: 1440, height: 1000 }, page, 130);
  assert.equal(segments.length, 1);
  assert.equal(segments[0].crop, undefined);
});

test('跨节点相同的业务模块图只保留首次放置，节点内容仍保留', () => {
  const same = Buffer.from('same-image');
  const other = Buffer.from('other-image');
  const sections = [
    { name: 'A', screenshots: [{ title: '共同模块', image: { data: same } }] },
    { name: 'B', screenshots: [
      { title: '共同模块', image: { data: same } },
      { title: '专属按钮', image: { data: other } },
    ] },
  ];
  dedupeSectionImages(sections, value => value.toString('hex'));
  assert.deepEqual(sections.map(section => section.screenshots.map(image => image.title)), [
    ['共同模块'],
    ['专属按钮'],
  ]);
  assert.equal(sections[1].name, 'B');
});

test('跨节点相同业务规则只保留首次说明，节点专有规则仍保留', () => {
  const sections = [
    { rules: ['单位：只读', '节点甲：允许退回申请人'] },
    { rules: ['单位：只读', '节点乙：允许提交国合处审核'] },
  ];
  dedupeSectionRules(sections);
  assert.deepEqual(sections.map(section => section.rules), [
    ['单位：只读', '节点甲：允许退回申请人'],
    ['节点乙：允许提交国合处审核'],
  ]);
});

=== tests/v13-document.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { workflowOrder, businessControl } from '../src/workflow-order.mjs';
import { buildButtonMap, parseWorkflowMermaid } from '../src/node-button-map.mjs';
import { chooseFields } from '../src/node-evidence-content.mjs';
import { businessTextFormatter, businessAssociation } from '../src/business-presentation.mjs';
import fs2 from 'node:fs/promises';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import os from 'node:os';

test('V1.3 顺序来自拓扑，汇合晚于两个并行节点，退回不形成排序循环', () => {
  const nodes = ['end','b','start','join','a'].map(id => ({id,name:id,type:'办理'}));
  const transitions = [['start','a'],['start','b'],['a','join'],['b','join'],['join','end']]
    .map(([source,target])=>({source,target,name:'通过'}));
  transitions.push({source:'end',target:'start',name:'退回修改'});
  const ordered=workflowOrder({nodes,transitions});
  assert.equal(ordered[0].id,'start');
  assert.equal(ordered.at(-1).id,'end');
  assert.equal(ordered.find(n=>n.id==='a').topologyLevel,ordered.find(n=>n.id==='b').topologyLevel);
  assert.ok(ordered.findIndex(n=>n.id==='join')>ordered.findIndex(n=>n.id==='b'));
  assert.deepEqual(workflowOrder({nodes:[...nodes].reverse(),transitions:[...transitions].reverse()}).map(n=>n.id),ordered.map(n=>n.id));
});

test('V1.3 业务控件不退化为 string',()=>{
  for(const [field,want] of [[{type:'string',name:'上传附件'},'附件上传'],
    [{type:'User'},'成员选择'],[{apiType:'Organize'},'部门选择'],
    [{usages:[{kind:'DatePicker'}]},'日期选择']]) assert.equal(businessControl(field),want);
});

test('V1.3 同动作副本合并，同名不同动作保留，未知提交不标成功',()=>{
  const parsed=parseWorkflowMermaid('n1["入口 [1]"]\nn2["甲 [2]"]\nn3["乙 [3]"]\nn1 --> |"提交 [10]"| n2\nn1 --> |"提交 [11]"| n3');
  const map=buildButtonMap(parsed,{observedButtons:{1:[
    {text:'提交',actionId:'action_123_10'}, {text:'提交',actionId:'action_123_10'},
    {text:'终止终止流程',actionId:'action_123_kill',kill:true,tip:'终止流程'},
    {text:'终止 终止流程',actionId:'action_123_kill',kill:true,tip:'终止流程'},
  ]},verifiedActions:[{nodeId:1,label:'提交',instanceId:'test',actualTargetNodeId:2}]});
  const buttons=map.nodes[0].buttons;
  assert.equal(buttons.length,3);
  assert.equal(buttons.filter(b=>b.label==='终止').length,1);
  assert.equal(buttons.filter(b=>b.verification==='actual-verified').length,0);
});

test('V1.3 节点字段不重复通用只读字段，也不漏可编辑附件',()=>{
  const bundle={fields:[{id:'a',name:'继承姓名'},{id:'b',name:'上传附件'}]};
  const rows=chooseFields(bundle,{fields:['a','b']},[{fields:[
    {id:'a',readOnly:true,required:true,visible:true,permission:'r'},
    {id:'b',readOnly:false,required:true,visible:true,permission:'rw',type:'string'},
  ]}]);
  assert.equal(rows.length,1);
  assert.equal(rows[0][0].name,'上传附件');
});

test('V1.3 固定章节顺序与单 Word 发布入口',()=>{
  const config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('config/requirements-custom.json','utf8'));
  assert.deepEqual(config.sections.map(s=>s.key),['scope','association','flow','roles','fields','nodeEvidence','approvals','questions']);
  const source=fs.readFileSync('src/generate.mjs','utf8');
  assert.doesNotMatch(source,/writeWordAtomic\(/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(fs.readFileSync('src/cli.mjs','utf8'),/documents = \{ detailed/);
});

test('V1.3 受控身份及实例数据不进入业务正文，原始证据不改写',()=>{
  const bundle={fields:[{id:'fieldNumber',name:'申请人工号'}],
    crossFlow:{summary:['前置流程确认为 TEST（测试业务），定义 ID 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012。',
    '姓名测试甲。登录身份测试乙(A123456)。验证关联关系成立。'],
    fields:[['fieldNumber','binding','姓名测试甲 工号1234567','只读']],limits:[]}};
  const before=JSON.stringify(bundle);
  const fmt=businessTextFormatter(bundle);
  assert.doesNotMatch(fmt(bundle.crossFlow.summary.join(' ')),/测试甲|测试乙|A123456|12345678-1234/);
  assert.equal(fmt('fieldNumber'),'申请人工号');
  assert.deepEqual(businessAssociation(bundle).fields[0].labels,['申请人工号']);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(bundle),before);
});

test('V1.3.1 字段清单六列原子化，DOCX 表格实际保持一字段一行',async()=>{
 const config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('config/requirements-custom.json','utf8'));
 assert.equal(config.word.fieldsColumns.length,6);
 const bundle={
  project:{code:'ZTEST',name:'测试流程',version:'v1'},
  workflow:{nodes:[],transitions:[],startView:'v1'},
  views:[{id:'v1',name:'01流程视图'}],
  fields:[
   {id:'f1',name:'出访单位审核意见',view:'01流程视图',required:true,usages:[{kind:'RichText'}]},
   {id:'f2',name:'访问成果',view:'01流程视图',required:true,usages:[{kind:'RichText'}]},
   {id:'f3',name:'未归还原因',view:'01流程视图',required:true,usages:[{kind:'RichText'}]},
  ],
  rules:[],stageFieldAnalysis:{special:[]},
 };
 const {buildBusinessContent}=await import('../src/business-content.mjs');
 const content=buildBusinessContent(bundle);
 assert.ok(content.fields.some(group=>group.fields.length>=3));
 const dir=await fs2.mkdtemp(join(os.tmpdir(),'infoplus-v131-'));
 try{
  await fs2.mkdir(join(dir,'views'));
  const custom=await import('../src/generate-custom.mjs');
  const docs=await custom.generateCustom(bundle,dir);
  const docPath=resolve(dir,typeof docs==='string'?docs:docs.docxPath);
  const out=join(dir,'rendered');
  execFileSync(process.execPath,['scripts/inspect-docx.mjs',docPath,out],{stdio:'pipe'});
  const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(join(out,'report.json'),'utf8'));
  assert.ok(report.tables.some(table=>table.headers.join('|').includes('字段名称|字段类型|必填|出现阶段|数据来源/规则')),JSON.stringify(report.tables.map(t=>t.headers)));
  const expected=new Set(content.fields.flatMap(group=>group.fields.map(field=>field.fieldName)));
  const globalTables=report.fieldTables.filter(table=>table.rows.length>1);
  for(const table of globalTables) for(const row of table.rows) {
    if(!row[1] || /、/.test(row[1]) && !expected.has(row[1])) assert.fail(`字段表出现非原子字段名称：${row[1]}`);
  }
  assert.ok([...expected].some(name=>name==='出访单位审核意见'));
 }finally{await fs2.rm(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

=== END tests/v13-document.test.mjs
=== tests/workflow-inputs.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtemp, writeFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { loadWorkflowInputs, saveWorkflowInput, inputFingerprint, mayRetryAction, applyWorkflowInputs } from '../src/workflow-inputs.mjs';

test('测试输入保留字符串精度并绑定流程版本与定义',async()=>{
 const dir=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'infoplus-inputs-'));
 try {
  const project={code:'Z1',version:'v1',workflowDefinitionId:'d1'};
  const input={fieldId:'fieldNumber',fieldName:'编号',value:'900719925474099312345',source:'用户提供',validationStatus:'待验证',nodeIds:['1']};
  await writeFile(join(dir,'Z1.json'),JSON.stringify({code:'Z1',version:'v1',definitionId:'d1',inputs:[input]}));
  assert.equal((await loadWorkflowInputs(project,dir))[0].value,'900719925474099312345');
  await saveWorkflowInput(project,{...input,value:'00001234567890123456'},dir);
  assert.equal((await loadWorkflowInputs(project,dir))[0].value,'00001234567890123456');
  await assert.rejects(loadWorkflowInputs({...project,version:'v2'},dir),/不匹配/);
  input.value=900719925474099312345;
  await writeFile(join(dir,'Z1.json'),JSON.stringify({code:'Z1',version:'v1',definitionId:'d1',inputs:[input]}));
  await assert.rejects(loadWorkflowInputs(project,dir),/无效/);
 } finally { await rm(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}); }
});

test('仅明确的业务校验失败且已记录输入改变才允许重试',()=>{
 const snapshot={kind:'input-snapshot',flowStepId:3,fingerprint:'old'};
 const fail={kind:'action',before:{flowStepId:3},submitted:true,http:200,errno:22001,success:false,responses:[{endpoint:'/infoplus/interface/doAction',error:'团组编号不存在'}]};
 assert.equal(mayRetryAction([snapshot,fail],3,'new'),true);
 assert.equal(mayRetryAction([snapshot,fail],3,'old'),false);
 assert.equal(mayRetryAction([fail],3,'new'),false);
 assert.equal(mayRetryAction([snapshot,{...fail,errno:0}],3,'new'),false);
 assert.equal(mayRetryAction([snapshot,{...fail,responses:[{endpoint:'/infoplus/interface/doAction',error:'回调超时'}]}],3,'new'),false);
 assert.notEqual(inputFingerprint([{fieldId:'f',value:'1'}]),inputFingerprint([{fieldId:'f',value:'2'}]));
});

test('不在目标可执行非发布节点写入',async()=>{
 await assert.rejects(applyWorkflowInputs({}, {workflowDefinitionId:'d'}, {release:true,definitionId:'d',status:1,executable:true}, []),/非发布/);
});

test('保留不同的既有业务输入，空值才填入并仅保存指纹',async()=>{
 const original={window:globalThis.window,document:globalThis.document,getComputedStyle:globalThis.getComputedStyle};
 const control={name:'fieldNumber',value:'existing',type:'text',disabled:false,readOnly:false,getClientRects:()=>[{}],dispatchEvent:()=>{}};
 globalThis.window={$$:{entity:{fields:{fieldNumber:{bound:true,permission:'rw',type:'string',label:'编号'}}}}};
 globalThis.document={querySelectorAll:()=>[control]}; globalThis.getComputedStyle=()=>({visibility:'visible'});
 const page={evaluate:async(fn,arg)=>fn(arg)},project={workflowDefinitionId:'d'},state={release:false,definitionId:'d',status:1,executable:true,nodeId:1};
 const inputs=[{fieldId:'fieldNumber',fieldName:'编号',value:'different',nodeIds:['1']}];
 try {
  await assert.rejects(applyWorkflowInputs(page,project,state,inputs),/已有非空/);
  assert.equal(control.value,'existing');
  control.value=''; const result=await applyWorkflowInputs(page,project,state,inputs);
  assert.equal(control.value,'different'); assert.deepEqual(result.fields,['fieldNumber']);
  assert.equal(result.fingerprint,inputFingerprint(inputs)); assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(result),/different/);
 } finally { for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(original)) { if(value===undefined) delete globalThis[key]; else globalThis[key]=value; } }
});

=== END tests/workflow-inputs.test.mjs
